”کیا تم میرے ساتھ میری بہن اور اس کے شوہر سے ملنے چل سکتے ہو؟“ ایک دوست نے میرے شوہر سے پوچھا۔ ”ان کی شادی میں سنگین مسائل ہیں۔ میرے بہنوئی نے دیکھا کہ خدا ہماری شادی میں کیسے کام کر رہا ہے اور مجھ سے پوچھا کہ یہ کیسے ہوا۔ کیا تم انہیں بتا سکتے ہو کہ خدا ان کی شادی کو بھی کیسے بدل سکتا ہے؟“

اس شام ڈھلتے وقت، میں اور میرا شوہر اپنے دوست کے ساتھ اس کی بہن کے گھر کے باہر انتظار کر رہے تھے۔ آدھے گھنٹے بعد ایک خستہ حال سرخ پک اَپ گھرگھراتی ہوئی آئی اور جھٹکے سے رک گئی۔ چکنائی سے داغ دار کپڑوں میں ملبوس، ہمیشہ مسکراتا رہنے والا ایک فربہ آدمی اسٹیئرنگ وہیل کے پیچھے سے بڑی مشکل سے باہر نکلا، جبکہ اس کی خوب صورت، فیشن ایبل لباس پہنے بیوی مسافر والی نشست سے پھرتی سے باہر کود گئی۔

”اندر آئیے! اندر آئیے!“ انہوں نے ہمارا استقبال کرتے ہوئے ہمیں اس سیڑھی کی طرف رہنمائی کی جو ان کے رہائشی حصے تک جاتی تھی۔

”بکھرے ہوئے گھر کے لیے معاف کیجیے گا،“ بیوی نے معذرت کرتے ہوئے صوفوں سے کپڑے سمیٹے تاکہ ہم بیٹھ سکیں۔ کمرہ بڑی نفاست سے سجایا گیا تھا، مگر گندا تھا۔ بڑی اسکرین والے ٹیلی وژن، چھوٹی میزوں… غرض ہر چیز پر گرد کی موٹی تہہ جمی ہوئی تھی۔

جب ہم اس جوڑے کے سامنے بیٹھے تو میں نے خاموشی سے التجا کی، ”اے خداوند، ہمیں حکمت عطا فرما۔“ ہم ایسے لوگوں سے کیسے رابطہ قائم کرتے جنہیں ہم بمشکل جانتے تھے اور جن کی زندگیوں میں خدا نہیں تھا؟

شوہر بولتا رہا۔ اس کی بیوی نے اسے بری طرح مایوس کیا تھا اور کئی بار اس سے بے وفائی کی تھی۔ اس وقت وہ ایک نئے دوست سے مل رہی تھی، ایک نوجوان سے جس سے اس کی جان پہچان سڑک پر ہوئی تھی۔ شوہر نے وعدہ کیا، ”لیکن میں تمہاری ان سب باتوں کو معاف کر دوں گا، اگر تم نئے سرے سے شروع کرنے، میری بیوی بننے اور ہمارے بچوں کی ماں بننے پر تیار ہو۔ مجھے معلوم ہے تم سے غلطی ہوئی ہے، لیکن ہم سب سے غلطی ہوتی ہے۔ آؤ، عزیزہ، نئے سرے سے شروع کریں۔“

بیوی پتھر کی طرح خاموش بیٹھی رہی۔ ہمارے دوست نے بات کی اور اپنی بہن اور بہنوئی سے صلح کرنے کی التجا کی۔ میرے شوہر نے خدا اور شادی کے لیے اُس کے منصوبے کے بارے میں بات کی اور انہیں خدا کی طرف رجوع کرنے کی تاکید کی۔

آخرکار بیوی نے منہ کھولا۔ تلخی ابل پڑی؛ بے عزتی؛ پرانی کدورتیں۔ ”تم کبھی مجھے یہ نہیں جتاتے کہ تمہیں میری پروا ہے۔ تم میرے لیے کبھی کچھ نہیں خریدتے۔ اب میں تمہیں خوش کرنے کی کوشش کیوں کروں؟“

شوہر بھی اس تکرار میں شامل ہو گیا۔ دونوں ایک ساتھ بولتے رہے، مسلسل، اور بلند سے بلند تر آواز میں۔

ہم بوجھل دلوں کے ساتھ بیٹھے، سنتے، دعا کرتے، سوچتے رہے۔ میں نے تصور کرنے کی کوشش کی کہ بیوی کیسا محسوس کرتی ہوگی۔ وہ خوب صورت اور جوان تھی۔ گھر میں صفائی کرنے، کھانا پکانے اور کپڑے دھونے کے لیے کیوں رہتی، ایسے بھاری بھرکم شوہر کے لیے جو اپنے دن چکنائی بھرے موٹروں پر جھک کر اور گندی گاڑیوں کے نیچے رینگ کر گزارتا تھا؟ کیوں، جب وہ سڑک پر ایک خوش مزاج نوجوان کے ساتھ لطف اٹھا سکتی تھی جو اسے بے حد خاص ہونے کا احساس دلاتا تھا؟

آخرکار اس جوڑے کی بولنے کی ہمت جواب دے گئی۔ ہم غمگین خاموشی میں بیٹھے رہے۔ آخر میں میرے شوہر نے کہا، ”مجھے افسوس ہے، لیکن ہم آپ کی مدد نہیں کر سکتے۔ صرف خدا ہی آپ کی مدد کر سکتا ہے۔ اور اگر آپ اس کی مدد نہیں چاہتے تو آپ کی شادی کے لیے کوئی امید نہیں۔“

شوہر نے بڑبڑاتے ہوئے کہا، ”ہاں، مجھے واقعی کلیسیا جانا چاہیے۔“

بیوی نے طنزیہ انداز میں کہا، ”ہا، ہا، دیکھنا، تم بھی آخرکار مینونائٹ بن جاؤ گے!“ ہم اٹھے، مصافحہ کیا، اپنی دعاؤں کا وعدہ کیا اور چلے گئے۔

اس شام ہمارے جانے کے بعد، اس جوڑے کے درمیان مزید سخت کلامی ہوئی۔ ان کے دونوں بچے وہاں آ پہنچے اور اپنے باپ کا ساتھ دیتے ہوئے اپنی ماں کو گھر سے نکال دیا۔

دور کہیں سے موسیقی کی آواز آئی—اور کیا؟ گانا۔ خوشی سے بلند آوازیں۔ سڑک کی طرف کھڑکی کا تختہ کھول کر ایک بیوی نے باہر جھانکا اور راستے پر نظر دوڑائی۔ ہاں، آج ہی کا دن ہے جب میرا شوہر عہد کا صندوق گھر لانے گیا ہے۔ لیکن اس کے لیے اتنا شور کیوں مچا رہے ہیں؟

جلوس گاتے، خوشی سے پکارتے اور نرسنگے بجاتے شہر میں داخل ہوا۔ داؤد اپنی پوری قوت سے ناچ رہا تھا، اس کا دل خدا کے شکر سے لبریز تھا۔ ساؤل سے برسوں اذیت ناک طور پر بھاگتے رہنے کے بعد، خدا نے اسے بادشاہ مقرر کیا تھا۔ اور اب خداوند کا صندوق آخرکار اپنی مناسب جگہ پر واپس آ رہا تھا… خدا کی حمد ہو!

جب داؤد اچھلتا اور پکارتا ہوا سڑک پر آگے بڑھا، تو اس کی بیوی کھڑکی میں اپنی جگہ سے اسے گھور رہی تھی، اس کے چہرے پر سخت تیوری چڑھی ہوئی تھی۔ ذرا دیکھو، ناچتے ہوئے اس کا چوغہ کیسے لہرا رہا ہے۔ کیا اسے ذرا بھی شرم نہیں؟! اور اس طرح چلّانا… بادشاہ کے شایانِ شان تو بالکل نہیں! کیا اسے اس بات کی پروا نہیں کہ دوسرے کیا سوچیں گے؟!

کئی گھنٹوں بعد داؤد گھر واپس آیا—تھکا ہوا، مگر خوش—تاکہ اپنے گھرانے کو برکت دے۔ دن اچھا گزرا تھا۔ وہ کھانے کی میز پر اپنی بیوی میکل کو اس دن کی ساری باتیں بتا سکتا تھا۔

لیکن اس نے پہلے ہی بات چھیڑ دی۔ [”واہ، آج تو آپ نے بڑی شان دکھائی،“] اس کے سرد لہجے والے الفاظ تھے۔ داؤد ضرور الجھن میں نظر آیا ہوگا۔ [”میرا مطلب ہے، لونڈیوں کے سامنے اس طرح اچھل کود کرنا، بالکل سڑک چھاپ مغرور آدمی کی طرح!“]

داؤد کو ضرور صدمہ پہنچا ہوگا۔ [”میں یہ خداوند کے لیے کر رہا تھا، اُس کے لیے جس نے تمہارے باپ کے بجائے مجھے بادشاہ چنا۔“]

میں تصور کرتی ہوں کہ میکل کو یہ سن کر تکلیف ہوئی ہوگی۔ آہ! [”تمہیں یہ بات میرے منہ پر مارنے کی کیا ضرورت ہے؟“]

[”مجھے معلوم ہے کہ تمہاری نظر میں میری کوئی قدر نہیں،“]* داؤد نے بات جاری رکھی، [”لیکن جن لونڈیوں کا تم نے ذکر کیا ہے، وہ میری قدر کرتی ہیں۔“]

میں شہر کی اس بے راہ رو عورت کے بارے میں سوچتی ہوں جسے اس کے بچوں نے گھر سے نکال دیا، اور حیران ہوتی ہوں کہ اب سے چالیس سال بعد، جب اس کا خوب صورت چہرہ جھریوں سے بھر جائے گا اور اس کی کمر جھک جائے گی، اس کی دیکھ بھال کون کرے گا۔

میں میکل کے تنہا بڑھاپے کا تصور کرتی ہوں۔ بیان کے آخر میں کہا گیا ہے کہ اپنی موت کے دن تک اس کی کوئی اولاد نہ ہوئی۔ مجھے شک ہے کہ اس کا بادشاہ شوہر اب اس کے پاس آنا بھی گوارا کرتا ہوگا۔ وہ کیوں آتا؟ اسے دوسروں سے بے حد عزت ملتی تھی۔ میں یہ بھی سوچتی ہوں کہ کیا میکل کی بے عزتی اور ان کے درمیان پیدا ہونے والی دراڑ نے بادشاہ داؤد کو کمزور کیا۔ کئی ابواب بعد بتایا گیا ہے کہ اس کی نگاہیں ایک پڑوسی کی بیوی پر پڑیں اور اس کے نتیجے میں گناہ ہوا۔

تمام بیویوں کو اپنے شوہروں کی بے عزتی کرنے کی آزمائش پیش آتی ہے۔ ہمیں بے عزتی کرنے کی آزمائش ہوتی ہے، خواہ ہمارا شوہر بادشاہ ہو یا مکینک، خدا پرست ہو یا بے خدا۔

ہر روز میں یہ انتخاب کرتی ہوں کہ خدا کے دیے ہوئے اپنے شوہر کی عزت کروں یا بے عزتی۔ میں جوش سے اس کے ساتھ چل کر اس کی حمایت کر سکتی ہوں، یا کھڑکی میں کھڑی رہ کر دل میں حقارت لیے اسے دیکھ سکتی ہوں۔ میں اس بات پر توجہ دے سکتی ہوں کہ وہ کیا اچھا کرتا ہے اور اس کی تعریف کر سکتی ہوں، یا اس کی غلطیوں پر اسے ٹوک سکتی ہوں۔ میرا انتخاب طے کرتا ہے کہ جواب میں مجھے احسان ملے گا یا نقصان۔ میرے انتخاب کا اثر صرف مجھ پر اور میرے شوہر پر ہی نہیں بلکہ گواہوں کے ایک بڑے انبوہ پر بھی پڑتا ہے… میرے بچوں، مسیح میں میری بہنوں اور میرے پڑوسیوں پر۔

”اور بیوی دیکھے کہ اپنے شوہر کی تعظیم کرے۔“
(افسیوں 5:33ب)

* ہسپانوی بائبل میں یہی الفاظ ہیں؛ اس کا مفہوم انگریزی ترجمے کے مقابلے میں زیادہ واضح ہے۔

“Dr. Waldron,” the woman said to me as I prepared to leave the exam room. “I have one more question. How can I lose this extra weight?”

I sighed inaudibly as I sat down to discuss the situation with her. Dealing with weight gain is not the sort of thing that is easy to tack onto the end of an office visit and there have been many lengthy books written on the subject.

Americans seem to struggle with this. They spend an average of 33 billion dollars on weight loss products every year and 65 percent of Americans are either overweight or obese.

The whole discussion is a challenging one. We want a quick fix—to take a pill or add in a fat-burning food or do a simple exercise that will melt the extra weight away simply and quickly. The reality is that while we gain weight quite easily, it is much more difficult to lose that same weight. Maintaining weight loss is harder yet.

In the Beginning

We don’t know much about life before the fall in Genesis 3. We do know that …God saw every thing that he had made, and, behold, it was very good… –Genesis 1:31.

It is safe to assume that Adam and Eve did not struggle with their weight before sin entered the world. They were created perfectly which meant that they would not have struggled with metabolism issues. They also did not have the uncontrolled appetites for food that their descendants deal with today.

Two things happened with the fall of man in the Garden of Eden. First, humans started to have physical ailments—their bodies did not work as well as they did before. Adam and Eve were still able to live much longer lives than humans today, but metabolic diseases and other illnesses began to develop. The second thing that happened was that they began to have a sin nature.

Those two things have led to a lot of problems… Among them are metabolism and weight issues.

What the Bible Says About Food

Our bodies need to eat nutritious food—without eating they would deteriorate and eventually die. There is nothing better for a man, than that he should eat and drink, and that he should make his soul enjoy good in his labour. This also I saw, that it was from the hand of God –Ecclesiastes 2:24.

The Old Testament law was restrictive regarding what the Jewish people could eat. Under Kosher Law, the number of clean animals was far outweighed by the numbers of unclean animals. More than that, the book of Proverbs mentions several times that overeating is dangerous. Be not among winebibbers; among riotous eaters of flesh: For the drunkard and the glutton shall come to poverty: and drowsiness shall clothe a man with rags –Proverbs 23:20-21.

From the New Testament we find the early church no longer required Gentile Christians to follow Jewish laws regarding their diets. The Jerusalem council specifically required …that they abstain from pollutions of idols, and from fornication, and from things strangled, and from blood –Acts 15:20. Otherwise, it seems that they were free to eat whatever they wanted.

What did not change in the New Testament was the idea of self-control. The Fruit of the Spirit lists temperance as one of the things Christians should have and Paul made it clear that he was focused on controlling his desires, lest he become a castaway (see 1 Corinthians 9:27).

What? know ye not that your body is the temple of the Holy Ghost which is in you, which ye have of God, and ye are not your own? For ye are bought with a price: therefore glorify God in your body, and in your spirit, which are God’s –1 Corinthians 6:19-20.

Know ye not that ye are the temple of God, and that the Spirit of God dwelleth in you? If any man defile the temple of God, him shall God destroy; for the temple of God is holy, which temple ye are –1 Corinthians 3:16-17.

Scripture is clear that Christians should take care of their bodies, put their desires under the control of God, and avoid things that have anything to do with idolatry.

Reasons People Gain Weight

It is easy to break down reasons for weight gain into two big categories:

  1. problems with metabolism
  2. problems with excessive calories.

When we think about metabolic issues, these include things like thyroid problems and diabetes. These disorders affect the rate at which our bodies burn calories. One of the main ways we have to increase our metabolism is to increase our activity levels, particularly exercise that increases the heart rate—cardiovascular exercise.

Excess calories mainly come from overeating. It is important to remember that people eat for lots of reasons other than because they are hungry. People eat because they are bored, lonely, sad, and yes, sometimes because they are hungry. Some medications, particularly steroids, can increase appetite and negatively affect the metabolic rate.

We call the number of calories our bodies burn while at rest, the body’s metabolic rate. There are a couple of different formulas used to calculate our basal metabolic rates. They use height, weight, age, and gender to determine how many calories your body will burn in an average day. There are a few applications and websites that will do this calculation for you. https://www.active.com/fitness/calculators/bmr The important thing to know is that this is the number of calories you should consume to maintain your current body weight. Eat fewer calories than this number and you will tend to lose weight, take in more calories than this number and you will gain weight.

Is Weight Important?

From a medical standpoint, being overweight is associated with several different things. It tends to increase insulin resistance and it can lead to diabetes. It increases blood pressure. It can lead to obstructive sleep apnea, and it worsens arthritis in the back and legs.

Being overweight is not necessarily an indication of a spiritual problem and depending on a person’s genetics, it can be difficult to get it where it should be according to the charts. Even though most people feel much better when they are close to their ideal weight, Scripture does not indicate that there is a specific weight or body mass index (BMI) that Christians should not go over.

The important thing is that our lives are to be under the control of God if we have yielded ourselves, appetites, and all, to Him. We should try to be healthy in order that we can best participate in Kingdom building. More than that, we should attempt to set an example for others of a life that is yielded to God.

Myths About Weight Loss…

There are many things that people believe about weight loss. We will look at a list of things which people repeat. While there may be a grain of truth in them, they are not completely true and may discourage activities that can help a person who is struggling with his weight.

…Vigorous exercise is the only way to lose weight.

Many people believe that the reason that they can’t lose weight is because they can’t do enough exercise. They struggle with pain, arthritis, or some heart or lung condition that makes them unable to do vigorous athletic endeavors.

Maybe they know someone who took up running and lost a bunch of weight and that seems like the right way to do it. They just don’t feel able to take that path and feel hopeless about the whole endeavor.

Exercise is important. Most medical societies recommend that people exercise at least 150 minutes a week. While exercise does boost our metabolism and helps our hearts and lungs, it still may not change a person’s weight very much.

Most people burn between 200 and 300 calories with a half hour of exercise. While this may sound like a lot, a body must burn 3500 calories to lose one pound. In addition, most of us are hungrier after we exercise, and it is awfully easy to eat an extra 200 calories that basically negates whatever was burned during the exercise time.

…Carbohydrates make you gain weight.

Carbohydrate is the medical term for sugars. The calories we consume in our diets come from one of three sources: carbohydrates, fats, and proteins. Carbohydrates are present in desserts, but they are also present in many starchy foods like rice, corn, pasta, bread, and lots of other things.

There are several diets, like the Atkins Diet and the Keto Diet, that push those who follow them to cut out as many carbohydrates as possible. People often do lose weight on these sorts of diets. Unfortunately, these diets are difficult to maintain long term as they are quite restrictive.

The healthiest thing is to eat carbohydrates moderately and steer towards the healthier options. Using whole grains and more complex carbohydrates is important. A bowl of oatmeal may have a similar number of grams of carbohydrates as compared to a sugary breakfast cereal, but it will be broken down more slowly by our bodies and is easier for them to deal with.

…Starvation is the only way to lose weight.

Starvation does result in weight loss—there were no heavy-set people who came out of the concentration camps in World War II. This certainly is not the only way to lose weight, nor is it a healthy way to lose weight.

We know that when people starve for extended periods of time, they will begin to lose muscle mass, their bones will get weaker, and their metabolism will decrease. Most people who starve themselves will end up regaining all of the weight they lost within a few years and because their metabolism has been downgraded, in the long run it will be harder for them to keep weight off.

…You just need to eat ‘___’ fat burning food to lose weight!

I specifically left the food blank above because it seems that this is always changing. Maybe you’ve read that Greek yogurt, or cinnamon, or goji berry juice will help you lose weight. Studies indicate that there is no magic food that will melt fat away.

If these foods work, it is because you have replaced something unhealthy and rich in calories with something healthier. For example, if your normal breakfast consists of 5 strips of bacon, a glass of orange juice, 2 slices of toast, and two eggs and you replace that with a glass of water and a bowl of oatmeal, you will probably lose weight. It is not because the oatmeal is “burning fat,” but rather that it has significantly fewer calories than the breakfast you were eating before.

Some foods have almost no calories and probably take as much energy to eat and digest as humans get from them. Celery, iceberg lettuce, and mushrooms all fall into this category. The problem is that if you put peanut butter on the celery, salad dressing on the lettuce, and fry the mushrooms in butter or oil, then suddenly they aren’t the low-calorie foods they purport to be. We humans are very good at fixing low-cal foods so that they both taste better and are no longer low-calorie.

…Fat free and diet foods are the key to weight loss.

There are many foods and condiments on the market that have reduced fat and claim to be lower calorie than the normal versions of themselves. These often have a lot of different chemicals and sugar substitutes in them to get the taste and texture as similar to the regular versions as possible.

Sugar substitutes seem to be healthier than sugar when used moderately, but they also seem to encourage people to crave sweeter foods. Studies have linked artificial sweeteners with the onset of glucose intolerance—something that could lead to diabetes. https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC3095502/ Dieticians seem to think that of the various sugar substitutes, Stevia is the safest.

All in all, our goal should not be to try to eat all the same foods, just with fewer calories, but rather to eat a variety of healthy foods and moderate-sized portions. This is what will lead to a better metabolism and not simply getting reduced fat versions of our favorite foods.

…The solution is diet pills.

Over time I have seen many people take medications and supplements, both prescription and over the counter varieties, to try to help them lose weight. These medications and supplements are supposed to do a number of things—reduce appetite and increase the metabolic rate are several of these.

They often work in the short term. People lose quite a bit of weight in the first few weeks and think that they have conquered their struggles. The problem is that over time, they usually get used to whatever it is that they are taking, their appetite returns, and their metabolism goes back to normal.

While these sorts of solutions may give short-term help, being healthy in the long term, means figuring out a healthy eating plan and exercise schedule, then sticking with it long term. The goal should never be simply to “take off ten pounds,” but rather to be as healthy as possible.

We’ve covered a lot of things not to do and probably reading between the lines you can see some of the things that are helpful to do as well. A second part (Lord willing) will be coming with the next issue to discuss positive things that we can do to achieve a healthy weight.

With all of this, it is important to remember that our goal is not about achieving some sort of earthly beauty. The aim, rather, is to treat our body as the Temple of the Holy Ghost (1 Corinthians 6:19). I have heard this verse used to explain why we shouldn’t drink, smoke, or get tattoos, but we need to treat it with respect when it comes to eating and exercise, as well.

As we care for our bodies, we will be better able to meet the needs of the people around us and we will be prepared to meet whatever plan God has for our lives.

«Δρ. Γουόλντρον», μου είπε η γυναίκα καθώς ετοιμαζόμουν να φύγω από την αίθουσα εξέτασης. «Έχω ακόμη μία ερώτηση. Πώς μπορώ να χάσω αυτά τα περιττά κιλά;»

Αναστέναξα σιωπηλά καθώς καθόμουν για να συζητήσω μαζί της την κατάσταση. Η αντιμετώπιση της αύξησης του βάρους δεν είναι κάτι που μπορεί εύκολα να προστεθεί στο τέλος μιας επίσκεψης στο ιατρείο, και έχουν γραφτεί πολλά εκτενή βιβλία για το θέμα.

Οι Αμερικανοί φαίνεται να δυσκολεύονται με αυτό. Ξοδεύουν κατά μέσο όρο 33 δισεκατομμύρια δολάρια τον χρόνο σε προϊόντα αδυνατίσματος, ενώ το 65 τοις εκατό των Αμερικανών είναι είτε υπέρβαροι είτε παχύσαρκοι.

Το όλο ζήτημα είναι δύσκολο. Θέλουμε μια γρήγορη λύση—να πάρουμε ένα χάπι ή να προσθέσουμε στη διατροφή μας κάποια τροφή που καίει λίπος ή να κάνουμε μια απλή άσκηση που θα εξαφανίσει εύκολα και γρήγορα τα περιττά κιλά. Η πραγματικότητα είναι ότι, ενώ παίρνουμε βάρος αρκετά εύκολα, είναι πολύ δυσκολότερο να χάσουμε το ίδιο βάρος. Και η διατήρηση της απώλειας βάρους είναι ακόμη δυσκολότερη.

Στην αρχή

Δεν γνωρίζουμε πολλά για τη ζωή πριν από την πτώση, στη Γένεση 3. Γνωρίζουμε όμως ότι …ο Θεός είδε όλα όσα είχε δημιουργήσει, και ιδού, ήταν πολύ καλά… –Γένεση 1:31.

Μπορούμε εύλογα να υποθέσουμε ότι ο Αδάμ και η Εύα δεν αντιμετώπιζαν προβλήματα βάρους πριν εισέλθει η αμαρτία στον κόσμο. Δημιουργήθηκαν τέλειοι, πράγμα που σημαίνει ότι δεν θα αντιμετώπιζαν προβλήματα με τον μεταβολισμό τους. Επίσης, δεν είχαν τις ανεξέλεγκτες ορέξεις για φαγητό που αντιμετωπίζουν σήμερα οι απόγονοί τους.

Με την πτώση του ανθρώπου στον Κήπο της Εδέμ συνέβησαν δύο πράγματα. Πρώτον, οι άνθρωποι άρχισαν να έχουν σωματικές παθήσεις—το σώμα τους δεν λειτουργούσε τόσο καλά όσο πριν. Ο Αδάμ και η Εύα εξακολουθούσαν να μπορούν να ζουν πολύ περισσότερο από τους ανθρώπους σήμερα, αλλά άρχισαν να εμφανίζονται μεταβολικές ασθένειες και άλλες παθήσεις. Το δεύτερο που συνέβη ήταν ότι άρχισαν να έχουν αμαρτωλή φύση.

Αυτά τα δύο πράγματα οδήγησαν σε πολλά προβλήματα… Ανάμεσά τους είναι τα προβλήματα μεταβολισμού και βάρους.

Τι λέει η Αγία Γραφή για το φαγητό

Το σώμα μας χρειάζεται να τρέφεται με θρεπτικές τροφές—χωρίς φαγητό θα φθειρόταν και τελικά θα πέθαινε. Δεν υπάρχει τίποτε καλύτερο για τον άνθρωπο από το να τρώει και να πίνει και να ευφραίνει την ψυχή του με τον κόπο του. Αυτό επίσης είδα, ότι είναι από το χέρι του Θεού –Εκκλησιαστής 2:24.

Ο νόμος της Παλαιάς Διαθήκης ήταν περιοριστικός ως προς το τι μπορούσε να τρώει ο εβραϊκός λαός. Σύμφωνα με τους κανόνες του Κοσέρ, ο αριθμός των καθαρών ζώων ήταν πολύ μικρότερος από τον αριθμό των ακάθαρτων. Επιπλέον, το βιβλίο των Παροιμιών αναφέρει αρκετές φορές ότι η υπερφαγία είναι επικίνδυνη. Μη συναναστρέφεσαι με οινοπότες, ούτε με λαίμαργους κρεοφάγους· διότι ο μέθυσος και ο λαίμαργος θα καταντήσουν φτωχοί, και η νύστα θα ντύσει τον άνθρωπο με κουρέλια –Παροιμίες 23:20-21.

Από την Καινή Διαθήκη μαθαίνουμε ότι η πρώτη εκκλησία δεν απαιτούσε πλέον από τους Χριστιανούς εθνικής καταγωγής να τηρούν τους εβραϊκούς διατροφικούς νόμους. Η σύνοδος της Ιερουσαλήμ απαίτησε συγκεκριμένα …να απέχουν από τα μολύσματα των ειδώλων, και από την πορνεία, και από τα πνιγμένα, και από το αίμα –Πράξεις 15:20. Κατά τα άλλα, φαίνεται πως ήταν ελεύθεροι να τρώνε ό,τι ήθελαν.

Αυτό που δεν άλλαξε στην Καινή Διαθήκη ήταν η ιδέα της εγκράτειας. Ο καρπός του Πνεύματος περιλαμβάνει την εγκράτεια ως ένα από τα χαρακτηριστικά που πρέπει να έχουν οι Χριστιανοί, και ο Παύλος κατέστησε σαφές ότι επικεντρωνόταν στον έλεγχο των επιθυμιών του, μήπως αποδοκιμαστεί (βλ. 1 Κορινθίους 9:27).

Δεν γνωρίζετε ότι το σώμα σας είναι ναός του Αγίου Πνεύματος που είναι μέσα σας, το οποίο έχετε από τον Θεό, και ότι δεν ανήκετε στον εαυτό σας; Διότι αγοραστήκατε με τίμημα· δοξάστε, λοιπόν, τον Θεό με το σώμα σας και με το πνεύμα σας, που ανήκουν στον Θεό –1 Κορινθίους 6:19-20.

Δεν γνωρίζετε ότι είστε ναός του Θεού και ότι το Πνεύμα του Θεού κατοικεί μέσα σας; Αν κάποιος φθείρει τον ναό του Θεού, ο Θεός θα τον καταστρέψει· διότι ο ναός του Θεού είναι άγιος, και τέτοιοι είστε εσείς –1 Κορινθίους 3:16-17.

Η Γραφή είναι σαφής: οι Χριστιανοί πρέπει να φροντίζουν το σώμα τους, να θέτουν τις επιθυμίες τους υπό τον έλεγχο του Θεού και να αποφεύγουν πράγματα που έχουν οποιαδήποτε σχέση με την ειδωλολατρία.

Γιατί παίρνουν βάρος οι άνθρωποι

Οι λόγοι για την αύξηση του βάρους μπορούν εύκολα να χωριστούν σε δύο μεγάλες κατηγορίες:

  1. προβλήματα με τον μεταβολισμό
  2. προβλήματα με τις υπερβολικές θερμίδες.

Όταν σκεφτόμαστε τα μεταβολικά προβλήματα, σε αυτά περιλαμβάνονται καταστάσεις όπως τα προβλήματα του θυρεοειδούς και ο διαβήτης. Αυτές οι διαταραχές επηρεάζουν τον ρυθμό με τον οποίο το σώμα μας καίει θερμίδες. Ένας από τους βασικούς τρόπους με τους οποίους μπορούμε να αυξήσουμε τον μεταβολισμό μας είναι να αυξήσουμε τα επίπεδα δραστηριότητάς μας, και ιδιαίτερα να κάνουμε άσκηση που αυξάνει τους καρδιακούς παλμούς—καρδιαγγειακή άσκηση.

Οι επιπλέον θερμίδες προέρχονται κυρίως από την υπερφαγία. Είναι σημαντικό να θυμόμαστε ότι οι άνθρωποι τρώνε για πολλούς λόγους εκτός από την πείνα. Τρώνε επειδή βαριούνται, νιώθουν μοναξιά ή λύπη, και ναι, μερικές φορές επειδή πεινούν. Ορισμένα φάρμακα, ιδιαίτερα τα στεροειδή, μπορούν να αυξήσουν την όρεξη και να επηρεάσουν αρνητικά τον μεταβολικό ρυθμό.

Ονομάζουμε βασικό μεταβολικό ρυθμό τον αριθμό των θερμίδων που καίει το σώμα μας όταν βρίσκεται σε ηρεμία. Υπάρχουν μερικοί διαφορετικοί τύποι για τον υπολογισμό του βασικού μεταβολικού ρυθμού μας. Χρησιμοποιούν το ύψος, το βάρος, την ηλικία και το φύλο για να προσδιορίσουν πόσες θερμίδες θα κάψει το σώμα σας κατά μέσο όρο μέσα σε μία ημέρα. Υπάρχουν ορισμένες εφαρμογές και ιστοσελίδες που κάνουν αυτόν τον υπολογισμό για εσάς. https://www.active.com/fitness/calculators/bmr Το σημαντικό είναι να γνωρίζετε ότι αυτός είναι ο αριθμός των θερμίδων που πρέπει να καταναλώνετε για να διατηρήσετε το τωρινό σας βάρος. Αν τρώτε λιγότερες θερμίδες από αυτόν τον αριθμό, θα έχετε την τάση να χάνετε βάρος· αν προσλαμβάνετε περισσότερες, θα παίρνετε βάρος.

Έχει σημασία το βάρος;

Από ιατρική άποψη, το υπερβολικό βάρος συνδέεται με διάφορα προβλήματα. Τείνει να αυξάνει την αντίσταση στην ινσουλίνη και μπορεί να οδηγήσει σε διαβήτη. Αυξάνει την αρτηριακή πίεση. Μπορεί να οδηγήσει σε αποφρακτική άπνοια ύπνου και επιδεινώνει την αρθρίτιδα στην πλάτη και στα πόδια.

Το υπερβολικό βάρος δεν αποτελεί απαραίτητα ένδειξη πνευματικού προβλήματος και, ανάλογα με τη γενετική προδιάθεση του ανθρώπου, μπορεί να είναι δύσκολο να φτάσει εκεί όπου θα έπρεπε σύμφωνα με τους πίνακες. Παρόλο που οι περισσότεροι άνθρωποι νιώθουν πολύ καλύτερα όταν πλησιάζουν το ιδανικό τους βάρος, η Γραφή δεν υποδεικνύει κάποιο συγκεκριμένο βάρος ή δείκτη μάζας σώματος (BMI) που οι Χριστιανοί δεν πρέπει να υπερβαίνουν.

Το σημαντικό είναι να βρίσκονται οι ζωές μας υπό τον έλεγχο του Θεού, εφόσον έχουμε παραδώσει σε Εκείνον τον εαυτό μας, μαζί και τις ορέξεις μας. Πρέπει να προσπαθούμε να είμαστε υγιείς, ώστε να μπορούμε να συμμετέχουμε όσο το δυνατόν καλύτερα στο έργο της οικοδόμησης της Βασιλείας. Επιπλέον, πρέπει να προσπαθούμε να αποτελούμε για τους άλλους παράδειγμα ζωής παραδομένης στον Θεό.

Μύθοι για την απώλεια βάρους…

Οι άνθρωποι πιστεύουν πολλά πράγματα σχετικά με την απώλεια βάρους. Θα εξετάσουμε έναν κατάλογο με πράγματα που επαναλαμβάνουν. Μπορεί να υπάρχει κάποια αλήθεια σε αυτά, όμως δεν είναι απολύτως αληθινά και μπορεί να αποθαρρύνουν δραστηριότητες που θα μπορούσαν να βοηθήσουν κάποιον που παλεύει με το βάρος του.

…Η έντονη άσκηση είναι ο μόνος τρόπος να χάσει κανείς βάρος.

Πολλοί άνθρωποι πιστεύουν ότι δεν μπορούν να χάσουν βάρος επειδή δεν μπορούν να ασκηθούν αρκετά. Αντιμετωπίζουν πόνο, αρθρίτιδα ή κάποια πάθηση της καρδιάς ή των πνευμόνων που δεν τους επιτρέπει να κάνουν έντονες αθλητικές δραστηριότητες.

Ίσως γνωρίζουν κάποιον που άρχισε να τρέχει και έχασε πολλά κιλά, και αυτό τους φαίνεται ο σωστός τρόπος. Απλώς δεν αισθάνονται ικανοί να ακολουθήσουν αυτή την πορεία και νιώθουν απελπισμένοι για όλη την προσπάθεια.

Η άσκηση είναι σημαντική. Οι περισσότερες ιατρικές εταιρείες συνιστούν οι άνθρωποι να ασκούνται τουλάχιστον 150 λεπτά την εβδομάδα. Παρόλο που η άσκηση ενισχύει τον μεταβολισμό μας και βοηθά την καρδιά και τους πνεύμονές μας, μπορεί και πάλι να μην αλλάξει ιδιαίτερα το βάρος ενός ανθρώπου.

Οι περισσότεροι άνθρωποι καίνε 200 έως 300 θερμίδες με μισή ώρα άσκησης. Μπορεί αυτό να ακούγεται πολύ, όμως το σώμα πρέπει να κάψει 3500 θερμίδες για να χάσει μία λίβρα. Επιπλέον, οι περισσότεροι πεινάμε περισσότερο μετά την άσκηση, και είναι τρομερά εύκολο να φάμε 200 επιπλέον θερμίδες, ακυρώνοντας ουσιαστικά όσες κάψαμε στη διάρκεια της άσκησης.

…Οι υδατάνθρακες σε παχαίνουν.

Υδατάνθρακας είναι ο ιατρικός όρος για τα σάκχαρα. Οι θερμίδες που καταναλώνουμε προέρχονται από μία από τρεις πηγές: υδατάνθρακες, λίπη και πρωτεΐνες. Οι υδατάνθρακες υπάρχουν στα επιδόρπια, αλλά και σε πολλές αμυλούχες τροφές, όπως το ρύζι, το καλαμπόκι, τα ζυμαρικά, το ψωμί και πολλά άλλα.

Υπάρχουν αρκετές δίαιτες, όπως η δίαιτα Άτκινς και η δίαιτα κέτο, που παροτρύνουν όσους τις ακολουθούν να περιορίσουν όσο το δυνατόν περισσότερο τους υδατάνθρακες. Οι άνθρωποι συχνά χάνουν πράγματι βάρος με αυτού του είδους τις δίαιτες. Δυστυχώς, είναι δύσκολο να τις διατηρήσει κανείς μακροπρόθεσμα, καθώς είναι αρκετά περιοριστικές.

Το πιο υγιεινό είναι να τρώμε υδατάνθρακες με μέτρο και να προτιμούμε τις πιο υγιεινές επιλογές. Είναι σημαντικό να χρησιμοποιούμε δημητριακά ολικής άλεσης και πιο σύνθετους υδατάνθρακες. Ένα μπολ βρόμης μπορεί να έχει περίπου τόσα γραμμάρια υδατανθράκων όσα και ένα ζαχαρούχο δημητριακό πρωινού, αλλά το σώμα μας θα το διασπάσει πιο αργά και θα μπορέσει να το διαχειριστεί ευκολότερα.

…Η ασιτία είναι ο μόνος τρόπος να χάσει κανείς βάρος.

Η ασιτία πράγματι οδηγεί σε απώλεια βάρους—κανένας άνθρωπος με πολλά κιλά δεν βγήκε από τα στρατόπεδα συγκέντρωσης του Β΄ Παγκοσμίου Πολέμου. Αυτό ασφαλώς δεν είναι ο μόνος τρόπος να χάσει κανείς βάρος, ούτε είναι υγιεινός τρόπος.

Γνωρίζουμε ότι όταν οι άνθρωποι μένουν νηστικοί για παρατεταμένες περιόδους, αρχίζουν να χάνουν μυϊκή μάζα, τα οστά τους εξασθενούν και ο μεταβολισμός τους επιβραδύνεται. Οι περισσότεροι που λιμοκτονούν θα ξαναπάρουν μέσα σε λίγα χρόνια όλο το βάρος που έχασαν και, επειδή ο μεταβολισμός τους έχει επιβραδυνθεί, μακροπρόθεσμα θα δυσκολεύονται περισσότερο να διατηρήσουν το χαμηλότερο βάρος.

…Απλώς πρέπει να τρως «___», μια τροφή που καίει λίπος, για να χάσεις βάρος!

Άφησα επίτηδες κενό το είδος της τροφής παραπάνω, επειδή φαίνεται πως αυτό αλλάζει διαρκώς. Ίσως έχετε διαβάσει ότι το ελληνικό γιαούρτι, η κανέλα ή ο χυμός από γκότζι μπέρι θα σας βοηθήσουν να χάσετε βάρος. Οι μελέτες δείχνουν ότι δεν υπάρχει μαγική τροφή που να εξαφανίζει το λίπος.

Αν αυτές οι τροφές έχουν αποτέλεσμα, είναι επειδή αντικαταστήσατε κάτι ανθυγιεινό και πλούσιο σε θερμίδες με κάτι πιο υγιεινό. Για παράδειγμα, αν το συνηθισμένο πρωινό σας αποτελείται από 5 φέτες μπέικον, ένα ποτήρι χυμό πορτοκάλι, 2 φέτες ψωμί του τοστ και δύο αυγά, και το αντικαταστήσετε με ένα ποτήρι νερό και ένα μπολ βρόμη, πιθανότατα θα χάσετε βάρος. Όχι επειδή η βρόμη «καίει λίπος», αλλά επειδή έχει σημαντικά λιγότερες θερμίδες από το πρωινό που τρώγατε προηγουμένως.

Ορισμένες τροφές έχουν σχεδόν μηδενικές θερμίδες και πιθανότατα απαιτούν τόση ενέργεια για να τις φάμε και να τις χωνέψουμε όση παίρνουμε από αυτές. Το σέλινο, το μαρούλι άισμπεργκ και τα μανιτάρια ανήκουν σε αυτή την κατηγορία. Το πρόβλημα είναι πως, αν βάλετε φυστικοβούτυρο στο σέλινο, σάλτσα σαλάτας στο μαρούλι και τηγανίσετε τα μανιτάρια σε βούτυρο ή λάδι, ξαφνικά παύουν να είναι οι τροφές με λίγες θερμίδες που ισχυρίζονται ότι είναι. Εμείς οι άνθρωποι είμαστε πολύ καλοί στο να μετατρέπουμε τις τροφές με λίγες θερμίδες σε κάτι πιο νόστιμο, αλλά που δεν έχει πια λίγες θερμίδες.

…Οι τροφές χωρίς λιπαρά και οι διαιτητικές τροφές είναι το κλειδί για την απώλεια βάρους.

Στην αγορά υπάρχουν πολλές τροφές και καρυκεύματα με μειωμένα λιπαρά, που ισχυρίζονται ότι έχουν λιγότερες θερμίδες από τις συνηθισμένες εκδοχές τους. Συχνά περιέχουν πολλά διαφορετικά χημικά και υποκατάστατα ζάχαρης, ώστε η γεύση και η υφή τους να μοιάζουν όσο γίνεται περισσότερο με τις κανονικές εκδοχές.

Τα υποκατάστατα ζάχαρης φαίνεται να είναι πιο υγιεινά από τη ζάχαρη όταν χρησιμοποιούνται με μέτρο, αλλά φαίνεται επίσης να ενθαρρύνουν τους ανθρώπους να λαχταρούν πιο γλυκές τροφές. Μελέτες έχουν συνδέσει τα τεχνητά γλυκαντικά με την εμφάνιση δυσανεξίας στη γλυκόζη—κάτι που θα μπορούσε να οδηγήσει σε διαβήτη. https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC3095502/ Οι διαιτολόγοι φαίνεται να θεωρούν ότι από τα διάφορα υποκατάστατα ζάχαρης, η στέβια είναι η ασφαλέστερη.

Συνολικά, στόχος μας δεν πρέπει να είναι να προσπαθούμε να τρώμε τα ίδια φαγητά, απλώς με λιγότερες θερμίδες, αλλά να τρώμε ποικιλία υγιεινών τροφών και μέτριες μερίδες. Αυτό θα οδηγήσει σε καλύτερο μεταβολισμό, όχι απλώς στην επιλογή εκδοχών των αγαπημένων μας τροφών με μειωμένα λιπαρά.

…Η λύση είναι τα χάπια αδυνατίσματος.

Με τα χρόνια έχω δει πολλούς ανθρώπους να παίρνουν φάρμακα και συμπληρώματα, τόσο συνταγογραφούμενα όσο και μη, σε μια προσπάθεια να χάσουν βάρος. Αυτά τα φάρμακα και τα συμπληρώματα υποτίθεται ότι κάνουν διάφορα πράγματα—μερικά από αυτά είναι η μείωση της όρεξης και η αύξηση του μεταβολικού ρυθμού.

Συχνά έχουν αποτέλεσμα βραχυπρόθεσμα. Οι άνθρωποι χάνουν αρκετό βάρος τις πρώτες εβδομάδες και πιστεύουν ότι ξεπέρασαν τις δυσκολίες τους. Το πρόβλημα είναι πως, με τον καιρό, συνήθως συνηθίζουν ό,τι κι αν παίρνουν, η όρεξή τους επιστρέφει και ο μεταβολισμός τους επανέρχεται στο φυσιολογικό.

Αυτού του είδους οι λύσεις μπορεί να προσφέρουν βραχυπρόθεσμη βοήθεια, όμως για να είμαστε υγιείς μακροπρόθεσμα πρέπει να βρούμε ένα υγιεινό πρόγραμμα διατροφής και άσκησης και ύστερα να το τηρήσουμε σε βάθος χρόνου. Ο στόχος δεν πρέπει ποτέ να είναι απλώς «να χάσουμε δέκα λίβρες», αλλά να είμαστε όσο το δυνατόν πιο υγιείς.

Καλύψαμε πολλά πράγματα που δεν πρέπει να κάνουμε και, διαβάζοντας ανάμεσα στις γραμμές, πιθανότατα μπορείτε να δείτε και μερικά από όσα είναι χρήσιμο να κάνουμε. Το δεύτερο μέρος (αν θέλει ο Κύριος) θα δημοσιευτεί στο επόμενο τεύχος και θα εξετάσει θετικά πράγματα που μπορούμε να κάνουμε για να πετύχουμε ένα υγιές βάρος.

Μέσα σε όλα αυτά, είναι σημαντικό να θυμόμαστε ότι στόχος μας δεν είναι να πετύχουμε κάποιο είδος επίγειας ομορφιάς. Στόχος είναι, αντίθετα, να μεταχειριζόμαστε το σώμα μας ως ναό του Αγίου Πνεύματος (1 Κορινθίους 6:19). Έχω ακούσει αυτό το εδάφιο να χρησιμοποιείται για να εξηγηθεί γιατί δεν πρέπει να πίνουμε, να καπνίζουμε ή να κάνουμε τατουάζ, αλλά πρέπει να το εφαρμόζουμε με σεβασμό και στο φαγητό και στην άσκηση.

Καθώς φροντίζουμε το σώμα μας, θα μπορούμε καλύτερα να ανταποκρινόμαστε στις ανάγκες των ανθρώπων γύρω μας και θα είμαστε έτοιμοι να ακολουθήσουμε όποιο σχέδιο έχει ο Θεός για τη ζωή μας.

“Let’s ask my mom if we can go on a walk to the creek. I want to go wading.” Angie told her friend Melissa.

“That sounds like fun,” Melissa said, following Angie to the kitchen. There was always something fun to do whenever Melissa visited her friend’s house.

After getting permission, the two girls stepped out into the hot, humid, sunny day. They had to cross a pasture to get to the creek, so Angie pushed apart the fence wires and stepped through. Then she held the wires apart so Melissa could also get through the fence into the goat pasture.

The girls walked across the pasture, through another fence, and into the woods. They walked down a dirt path to the stream. They lifted their skirts and stepped into the gurgling water. The two friends talked and laughed as they walked further downstream to a special spot in the creek where they always loved to go.

It was at this spot that the creek bed was filled with some unusual rocks. When these rocks were dry, they were grey, but when they got wet, they turned a very pretty blue.

After spending some time admiring the blue rocks, Melissa turned to Angie and said, “Let’s go walk through that big culvert under the road.”

“Yes, let’s do that and then we can walk along the road back to the driveway.”

They stepped out of the cool water and walked through the woods to the tunnel-like culvert. The girls went through the dark tunnel to the other side and Melissa scrambled up the steep bank to the gravel road.

Suddenly, realizing she was alone, Melissa turned around and saw that Angie was still at the entrance of the tunnel looking into a pool of water. She moved a rock, then screamed and scrambled up the bank to join Melissa. “There was a crayfish under there!” she exclaimed.

The girls’ dress hems were damp from the creek but soon dried in the hot sun as they walked back towards the house. When they were halfway in the lane, Angie said, “Do you want to take the boat out on the pond? We have some oars that are fun to use.”

Melissa grinned in excitement, “That would be lots of fun!” She followed Angie into the barn to help get the oars and life jackets.

The girls snapped on their orange life jackets and pushed the boat out into the pond water. Soon they had paddled out to the middle of the pond and sat there, watching the water slowly ripple around them.

“Hey, I know what we should do now!” Angie said. “Let’s bang the water with our oars to make splashes. Like this.” Angie slapped the surface of the pond with her oar. Melissa followed her example and began splashing on her side of the boat.

Their splashes got bigger and bigger. They were having a lot of fun seeing who could make the biggest splash. Melissa lifted her oar into the air and hit the water extra hard. As expected, the water splashed, but when Melissa lifted her oar, all she had was the handle. The paddle end had broken off and was floating just under the surface of the water next to the boat. She reached into the water, grabbed the broken paddle, and placed both pieces of the oar in the boat.

For a moment, Angie and Melissa looked at each other in silence. Melissa felt guilty for breaking the oar and Angie felt bad for suggesting that they splash in the water.

“Let’s go back to shore and put the oars in the barn,” Angie said. “It doesn’t matter that it broke. They’re just old ones anyway,” she finished, somewhat uncertainly.

Melissa thought that was a good idea and helped Angie pull the boat out of the water. They picked up the life jackets and the oars and carried them into the barn.

Melissa felt bad but she did not want to tell anyone that she had broken the oar. They passed the pile of sweet-smelling hay bales and the noisy goat pen, but Melissa hardly noticed them. All she could think about was that she had broken the oar and that she was going to hide what she had done. Her conscience was bothering her because she knew that her parents and God wanted her to always be honest and to never hide anything.

Just as the girls stepped out of the barn onto the lawn, Angie’s big brother jumped out from behind the barn where he had been hiding. “I saw you and I know what you did!” he told them. “You broke the oar. And guess what!? I followed you the whole time you were in the creek and down by the road too. I’m going to tell Mom that you broke the oar.” He grinned, then ran toward the basement door, disappearing inside.

Angie and Melissa were a little upset that he had been sneaking around watching them (it wasn’t the first time he had done that). But in a strange way, Melissa felt a lot better. She did not need to worry anymore about someone finding out that she had broken the oar, because someone knew already. When Angie’s parents were told about the broken oar, they forgave Melissa for breaking it. Melissa was always very glad that it had not been kept a secret after all.

«La oss spørre mamma om vi kan gå en tur til bekken. Jeg har lyst til å vasse.» Angie sa det til venninnen Melissa.

«Det høres gøy ut», sa Melissa og fulgte etter Angie inn på kjøkkenet. Det var alltid noe morsomt å gjøre når Melissa var på besøk hos venninnen sin.

Da de hadde fått lov, gikk de to jentene ut i den varme, fuktige og solrike dagen. De måtte krysse et beite for å komme til bekken, så Angie skjøv gjerdetrådene fra hverandre og gikk gjennom. Så holdt hun trådene fra hverandre slik at Melissa også kunne komme seg gjennom gjerdet og inn på geitebeitet.

Jentene gikk over beitet, gjennom et nytt gjerde og inn i skogen. De fulgte en jordsti ned til bekken. De løftet opp skjørtene og gikk ut i det klukkende vannet. De to venninnene pratet og lo mens de gikk lenger nedover bekken til et spesielt sted der de alltid likte å være.

På dette stedet var bekkebunnen full av noen uvanlige steiner. Når steinene var tørre, var de grå, men når de ble våte, fikk de en nydelig blå farge.

Etter å ha brukt en stund på å beundre de blå steinene, snudde Melissa seg mot Angie og sa: «La oss gå gjennom den store kulverten under veien.»

«Ja, la oss gjøre det, og så kan vi gå langs veien tilbake til innkjørselen.»

De gikk opp av det kjølige vannet og gjennom skogen til den tunnellignende kulverten. Jentene gikk gjennom den mørke tunnelen til den andre siden, og Melissa klatret opp den bratte skråningen til grusveien.

Plutselig skjønte Melissa at hun var alene. Hun snudde seg og så at Angie fortsatt sto ved inngangen til tunnelen og så ned i en vannpytt. Angie flyttet på en stein, skrek og klatret opp skråningen for å komme bort til Melissa. «Det var en kreps under der!» utbrøt hun.

Skjørtekantene til jentene var fuktige etter turen i bekken, men snart tørket de i den varme sola mens de gikk tilbake mot huset. Da de var halvveis nede på veien, sa Angie: «Har du lyst til å ta båten ut på dammen? Vi har noen årer som er morsomme å bruke.»

Melissa smilte begeistret. «Det hadde vært kjempegøy!» Hun fulgte etter Angie inn i låven for å hjelpe til med å hente årene og redningsvestene.

Jentene tok på seg de oransje redningsvestene og skjøv båten ut på dammen. Snart hadde de rodd ut til midten av dammen. Der satt de og så på vannet som langsomt kruset seg rundt dem.

«Hei, jeg vet hva vi kan gjøre nå!» sa Angie. «La oss slå årene i vannet så det spruter. Sånn her.» Angie slo åra mot vannflaten. Melissa gjorde det samme og begynte å lage sprut på sin side av båten.

Sprutene ble større og større. De syntes det var kjempegøy å se hvem som kunne lage den største spruten. Melissa løftet åra opp i lufta og slo ekstra hardt i vannet. Vannet sprutet, som forventet, men da Melissa løftet åra, hadde hun bare håndtaket igjen. Årebladet hadde brukket av og fløt rett under vannflaten ved siden av båten. Hun stakk hånden ned i vannet, tok opp det avbrukne årebladet og la begge delene av åra i båten.

Et øyeblikk så Angie og Melissa på hverandre uten å si noe. Melissa følte seg skyldig for å ha ødelagt åra, og Angie syntes det var leit at hun hadde foreslått at de skulle plaske i vannet.

«La oss dra tilbake til land og legge årene i låven», sa Angie. «Det gjør ikke noe at den gikk i stykker. De er jo bare noen gamle årer likevel», la hun til, litt usikkert.

Melissa syntes det var en god idé og hjalp Angie med å dra båten opp av vannet. De plukket opp redningsvestene og årene og bar dem inn i låven.

Melissa følte seg ille til mote, men hun ville ikke fortelle noen at hun hadde ødelagt åra. De gikk forbi haugen med velduftende høyballer og den bråkete geitebingen, men Melissa la knapt merke til dem. Hun kunne bare tenke på at hun hadde ødelagt åra, og at hun skulle holde det hun hadde gjort, skjult. Samvittigheten plaget henne, for hun visste at foreldrene hennes og Gud ville at hun alltid skulle være ærlig og aldri skjule noe.

Akkurat da jentene gikk ut av låven og ut på plenen, hoppet Angies storebror fram fra bak låven, der han hadde gjemt seg. «Jeg så dere, og jeg vet hva dere gjorde!» sa han til dem. «Dere ødela åra. Og vet dere hva? Jeg fulgte etter dere hele tiden mens dere var i bekken og nede ved veien også. Jeg skal fortelle mamma at dere ødela åra.» Han gliste og løp mot kjellerdøra, før han forsvant inn.

Angie og Melissa var litt irritert over at han hadde sneket seg rundt og sett på dem (det var ikke første gang han hadde gjort det). Men på en merkelig måte følte Melissa seg mye bedre. Nå trengte hun ikke lenger å bekymre seg for at noen skulle oppdage at hun hadde ødelagt åra, for det var allerede noen som visste det. Da Angies foreldre fikk høre om den ødelagte åra, tilga de Melissa for at hun hadde ødelagt den. Melissa var veldig glad for at det ikke hadde blitt holdt hemmelig likevel.

Wherefore, holy brethren, partakers of the heavenly calling… –Hebrews 3:1.

True wisdom dawns in gradual rays,
Minute degrees observed as nil.
Beyond the books of youthful days,
It beckons thee to yonder hill.
Forbear and press in patient ways...
“Forward! Upward! Higher still!”

At times we fret with downcast soul,
Our courage wanes in blasting chill.
We’ve failed the earthly honor roll,
Diminished hope, dejected will.
But hark the sound, the ringing toll...
“Forward! Upward! Higher still!”

Temptations rise and pleasures call,
They barter truth for empty thrill.
Those who yield are those who fall,
Achieving not God’s blessed will.
Sowing flesh shall reap but gall...
“Forward! Upward! Higher still!”

In days of brimming youthful years,
With dreams afresh to seek and fill.
A humble heart will stay more tears,
Than all of life’s great wit and will.
He who wins is he who hears...
“Forward! Upward! Higher still!”

–by Lee Rufener

I press toward the mark for the prize of the
high calling of God in Christ Jesus –Philippians 3:14.

“Dr. Waldron,” the woman said to me as I prepared to leave the exam room. “I have one more question. How can I lose this extra weight?”

I sighed inaudibly as I sat down to discuss the situation with her. Dealing with weight gain is not the sort of thing that is easy to tack onto the end of an office visit and there have been many lengthy books written on the subject.

Americans seem to struggle with this. They spend an average of 33 billion dollars on weight loss products every year and 65 percent of Americans are either overweight or obese.

The whole discussion is a challenging one. We want a quick fix—to take a pill or add in a fat-burning food or do a simple exercise that will melt the extra weight away simply and quickly. The reality is that while we gain weight quite easily, it is much more difficult to lose that same weight. Maintaining weight loss is harder yet.

In the Beginning

We don’t know much about life before the fall in Genesis 3. We do know that …God saw every thing that he had made, and, behold, it was very good… –Genesis 1:31.

It is safe to assume that Adam and Eve did not struggle with their weight before sin entered the world. They were created perfectly which meant that they would not have struggled with metabolism issues. They also did not have the uncontrolled appetites for food that their descendants deal with today.

Two things happened with the fall of man in the Garden of Eden. First, humans started to have physical ailments—their bodies did not work as well as they did before. Adam and Eve were still able to live much longer lives than humans today, but metabolic diseases and other illnesses began to develop. The second thing that happened was that they began to have a sin nature.

Those two things have led to a lot of problems… Among them are metabolism and weight issues.

What the Bible Says About Food

Our bodies need to eat nutritious food—without eating they would deteriorate and eventually die. There is nothing better for a man, than that he should eat and drink, and that he should make his soul enjoy good in his labour. This also I saw, that it was from the hand of God –Ecclesiastes 2:24.

The Old Testament law was restrictive regarding what the Jewish people could eat. Under Kosher Law, the number of clean animals was far outweighed by the numbers of unclean animals. More than that, the book of Proverbs mentions several times that overeating is dangerous. Be not among winebibbers; among riotous eaters of flesh: For the drunkard and the glutton shall come to poverty: and drowsiness shall clothe a man with rags –Proverbs 23:20-21.

From the New Testament we find the early church no longer required Gentile Christians to follow Jewish laws regarding their diets. The Jerusalem council specifically required …that they abstain from pollutions of idols, and from fornication, and from things strangled, and from blood –Acts 15:20. Otherwise, it seems that they were free to eat whatever they wanted.

What did not change in the New Testament was the idea of self-control. The Fruit of the Spirit lists temperance as one of the things Christians should have and Paul made it clear that he was focused on controlling his desires, lest he become a castaway (see 1 Corinthians 9:27).

What? know ye not that your body is the temple of the Holy Ghost which is in you, which ye have of God, and ye are not your own? For ye are bought with a price: therefore glorify God in your body, and in your spirit, which are God’s –1 Corinthians 6:19-20.

Know ye not that ye are the temple of God, and that the Spirit of God dwelleth in you? If any man defile the temple of God, him shall God destroy; for the temple of God is holy, which temple ye are –1 Corinthians 3:16-17.

Scripture is clear that Christians should take care of their bodies, put their desires under the control of God, and avoid things that have anything to do with idolatry.

Reasons People Gain Weight

It is easy to break down reasons for weight gain into two big categories:

  1. problems with metabolism
  2. problems with excessive calories.

When we think about metabolic issues, these include things like thyroid problems and diabetes. These disorders affect the rate at which our bodies burn calories. One of the main ways we have to increase our metabolism is to increase our activity levels, particularly exercise that increases the heart rate—cardiovascular exercise.

Excess calories mainly come from overeating. It is important to remember that people eat for lots of reasons other than because they are hungry. People eat because they are bored, lonely, sad, and yes, sometimes because they are hungry. Some medications, particularly steroids, can increase appetite and negatively affect the metabolic rate.

We call the number of calories our bodies burn while at rest, the body’s metabolic rate. There are a couple of different formulas used to calculate our basal metabolic rates. They use height, weight, age, and gender to determine how many calories your body will burn in an average day. There are a few applications and websites that will do this calculation for you. https://www.active.com/fitness/calculators/bmr The important thing to know is that this is the number of calories you should consume to maintain your current body weight. Eat fewer calories than this number and you will tend to lose weight, take in more calories than this number and you will gain weight.

Is Weight Important?

From a medical standpoint, being overweight is associated with several different things. It tends to increase insulin resistance and it can lead to diabetes. It increases blood pressure. It can lead to obstructive sleep apnea, and it worsens arthritis in the back and legs.

Being overweight is not necessarily an indication of a spiritual problem and depending on a person’s genetics, it can be difficult to get it where it should be according to the charts. Even though most people feel much better when they are close to their ideal weight, Scripture does not indicate that there is a specific weight or body mass index (BMI) that Christians should not go over.

The important thing is that our lives are to be under the control of God if we have yielded ourselves, appetites, and all, to Him. We should try to be healthy in order that we can best participate in Kingdom building. More than that, we should attempt to set an example for others of a life that is yielded to God.

Myths About Weight Loss…

There are many things that people believe about weight loss. We will look at a list of things which people repeat. While there may be a grain of truth in them, they are not completely true and may discourage activities that can help a person who is struggling with his weight.

…Vigorous exercise is the only way to lose weight.

Many people believe that the reason that they can’t lose weight is because they can’t do enough exercise. They struggle with pain, arthritis, or some heart or lung condition that makes them unable to do vigorous athletic endeavors.

Maybe they know someone who took up running and lost a bunch of weight and that seems like the right way to do it. They just don’t feel able to take that path and feel hopeless about the whole endeavor.

Exercise is important. Most medical societies recommend that people exercise at least 150 minutes a week. While exercise does boost our metabolism and helps our hearts and lungs, it still may not change a person’s weight very much.

Most people burn between 200 and 300 calories with a half hour of exercise. While this may sound like a lot, a body must burn 3500 calories to lose one pound. In addition, most of us are hungrier after we exercise, and it is awfully easy to eat an extra 200 calories that basically negates whatever was burned during the exercise time.

…Carbohydrates make you gain weight.

Carbohydrate is the medical term for sugars. The calories we consume in our diets come from one of three sources: carbohydrates, fats, and proteins. Carbohydrates are present in desserts, but they are also present in many starchy foods like rice, corn, pasta, bread, and lots of other things.

There are several diets, like the Atkins Diet and the Keto Diet, that push those who follow them to cut out as many carbohydrates as possible. People often do lose weight on these sorts of diets. Unfortunately, these diets are difficult to maintain long term as they are quite restrictive.

The healthiest thing is to eat carbohydrates moderately and steer towards the healthier options. Using whole grains and more complex carbohydrates is important. A bowl of oatmeal may have a similar number of grams of carbohydrates as compared to a sugary breakfast cereal, but it will be broken down more slowly by our bodies and is easier for them to deal with.

…Starvation is the only way to lose weight.

Starvation does result in weight loss—there were no heavy-set people who came out of the concentration camps in World War II. This certainly is not the only way to lose weight, nor is it a healthy way to lose weight.

We know that when people starve for extended periods of time, they will begin to lose muscle mass, their bones will get weaker, and their metabolism will decrease. Most people who starve themselves will end up regaining all of the weight they lost within a few years and because their metabolism has been downgraded, in the long run it will be harder for them to keep weight off.

…You just need to eat ‘___’ fat burning food to lose weight!

I specifically left the food blank above because it seems that this is always changing. Maybe you’ve read that Greek yogurt, or cinnamon, or goji berry juice will help you lose weight. Studies indicate that there is no magic food that will melt fat away.

If these foods work, it is because you have replaced something unhealthy and rich in calories with something healthier. For example, if your normal breakfast consists of 5 strips of bacon, a glass of orange juice, 2 slices of toast, and two eggs and you replace that with a glass of water and a bowl of oatmeal, you will probably lose weight. It is not because the oatmeal is “burning fat,” but rather that it has significantly fewer calories than the breakfast you were eating before.

Some foods have almost no calories and probably take as much energy to eat and digest as humans get from them. Celery, iceberg lettuce, and mushrooms all fall into this category. The problem is that if you put peanut butter on the celery, salad dressing on the lettuce, and fry the mushrooms in butter or oil, then suddenly they aren’t the low-calorie foods they purport to be. We humans are very good at fixing low-cal foods so that they both taste better and are no longer low-calorie.

…Fat free and diet foods are the key to weight loss.

There are many foods and condiments on the market that have reduced fat and claim to be lower calorie than the normal versions of themselves. These often have a lot of different chemicals and sugar substitutes in them to get the taste and texture as similar to the regular versions as possible.

Sugar substitutes seem to be healthier than sugar when used moderately, but they also seem to encourage people to crave sweeter foods. Studies have linked artificial sweeteners with the onset of glucose intolerance—something that could lead to diabetes. https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC3095502/ Dieticians seem to think that of the various sugar substitutes, Stevia is the safest.

All in all, our goal should not be to try to eat all the same foods, just with fewer calories, but rather to eat a variety of healthy foods and moderate-sized portions. This is what will lead to a better metabolism and not simply getting reduced fat versions of our favorite foods.

…The solution is diet pills.

Over time I have seen many people take medications and supplements, both prescription and over the counter varieties, to try to help them lose weight. These medications and supplements are supposed to do a number of things—reduce appetite and increase the metabolic rate are several of these.

They often work in the short term. People lose quite a bit of weight in the first few weeks and think that they have conquered their struggles. The problem is that over time, they usually get used to whatever it is that they are taking, their appetite returns, and their metabolism goes back to normal.

While these sorts of solutions may give short-term help, being healthy in the long term, means figuring out a healthy eating plan and exercise schedule, then sticking with it long term. The goal should never be simply to “take off ten pounds,” but rather to be as healthy as possible.

We’ve covered a lot of things not to do and probably reading between the lines you can see some of the things that are helpful to do as well. A second part (Lord willing) will be coming with the next issue to discuss positive things that we can do to achieve a healthy weight.

With all of this, it is important to remember that our goal is not about achieving some sort of earthly beauty. The aim, rather, is to treat our body as the Temple of the Holy Ghost (1 Corinthians 6:19). I have heard this verse used to explain why we shouldn’t drink, smoke, or get tattoos, but we need to treat it with respect when it comes to eating and exercise, as well.

As we care for our bodies, we will be better able to meet the needs of the people around us and we will be prepared to meet whatever plan God has for our lives.

“Dr. Waldron”, disse-me a mulher enquanto eu me preparava para sair da sala de exames. “Tenho mais uma pergunta. Como posso perder este peso extra?”

Suspirei sem fazer barulho enquanto me sentava para conversar com ela sobre a situação. Lidar com o ganho de peso não é algo que se possa simplesmente acrescentar ao fim de uma consulta, e muitos livros extensos já foram escritos sobre o assunto.

Os americanos parecem ter dificuldades com isso. Gastam, em média, 33 bilhões de dólares por ano em produtos para emagrecer, e 65 por cento dos americanos estão acima do peso ou são obesos.

É uma discussão bastante desafiadora. Queremos uma solução rápida — tomar um comprimido, acrescentar um alimento que queime gordura ou fazer um exercício simples que elimine o peso extra de maneira simples e rápida. A realidade é que, embora ganhemos peso com bastante facilidade, é muito mais difícil perder esse mesmo peso. Manter a perda de peso é ainda mais difícil.

No princípio

Não sabemos muito sobre a vida antes da queda, em Gênesis 3. Sabemos que …Deus viu tudo quanto fizera, e eis que era muito bom… –Gênesis 1:31.

É seguro supor que Adão e Eva não lutavam contra o peso antes de o pecado entrar no mundo. Foram criados perfeitamente, o que significa que não teriam problemas de metabolismo. Também não tinham o apetite descontrolado por comida com que seus descendentes lidam hoje.

Duas coisas aconteceram com a queda do homem no Jardim do Éden. Primeiro, os seres humanos começaram a ter problemas físicos — seus corpos não funcionavam tão bem quanto antes. Adão e Eva ainda conseguiam viver muito mais tempo do que os seres humanos de hoje, mas doenças metabólicas e outras enfermidades começaram a surgir. A segunda coisa que aconteceu foi que passaram a ter uma natureza pecaminosa.

Essas duas coisas levaram a muitos problemas… Entre eles estão os problemas de metabolismo e de peso.

O que a Bíblia diz sobre a alimentação

Nossos corpos precisam de alimentos nutritivos — sem comer, deteriorariam e acabariam morrendo. Não há nada melhor para o homem do que comer, beber e fazer que a sua alma desfrute do bem no seu trabalho. Também vi que isso vem da mão de Deus –Eclesiastes 2:24.

A lei do Antigo Testamento impunha restrições ao que o povo judeu podia comer. Segundo a lei kosher, o número de animais puros era muito menor que o de animais impuros. Além disso, o livro de Provérbios menciona várias vezes que comer demais é perigoso. Não estejas entre os que se embriagam com vinho, nem entre os que se empanturram de carne; pois o bêbado e o glutão acabarão na pobreza, e a sonolência vestirá o homem de trapos –Provérbios 23:20-21.

No Novo Testamento, vemos que a igreja primitiva já não exigia que os cristãos gentios seguissem as leis judaicas relativas à alimentação. O concílio de Jerusalém exigiu especificamente …que se abstivessem das contaminações dos ídolos, da imoralidade sexual, da carne de animais estrangulados e do sangue –Atos 15:20. Fora isso, parece que eram livres para comer o que quisessem.

O que não mudou no Novo Testamento foi a ideia do domínio próprio. A lista do fruto do Espírito inclui a temperança como uma das qualidades que os cristãos devem ter, e Paulo deixou claro que se empenhava em controlar seus desejos, para não ser desqualificado (ver 1 Coríntios 9:27).

Ou não sabeis que o vosso corpo é templo do Espírito Santo, que habita em vós, o qual recebestes de Deus, e que não sois de vós mesmos? Pois fostes comprados por preço; glorificai, portanto, a Deus no vosso corpo e no vosso espírito, que pertencem a Deus –1 Coríntios 6:19-20.

Não sabeis que sois templo de Deus e que o Espírito de Deus habita em vós? Se alguém profanar o templo de Deus, Deus o destruirá; pois o templo de Deus é santo, e esse templo sois vós –1 Coríntios 3:16-17.

As Escrituras deixam claro que os cristãos devem cuidar do corpo, submeter seus desejos ao controle de Deus e evitar coisas que tenham qualquer relação com a idolatria.

Motivos pelos quais as pessoas ganham peso

É fácil dividir os motivos do ganho de peso em duas grandes categorias:

  1. problemas de metabolismo
  2. problemas relacionados ao excesso de calorias.

Quando pensamos em problemas metabólicos, isso inclui coisas como problemas da tireoide e diabetes. Esses distúrbios afetam a velocidade com que nossos corpos queimam calorias. Uma das principais maneiras de aumentar o metabolismo é elevar o nível de atividade, especialmente com exercícios que aumentem a frequência cardíaca — exercícios cardiovasculares.

O excesso de calorias vem principalmente de comer demais. É importante lembrar que as pessoas comem por muitos motivos além da fome. Comem porque estão entediadas, solitárias, tristes e, sim, às vezes porque estão com fome. Alguns medicamentos, especialmente os esteroides, podem aumentar o apetite e afetar negativamente o metabolismo.

Chamamos de taxa metabólica do corpo o número de calorias que queimamos em repouso. Há algumas fórmulas diferentes para calcular nossa taxa metabólica basal. Elas usam altura, peso, idade e sexo para determinar quantas calorias seu corpo queimará em um dia comum. Há alguns aplicativos e sites que fazem esse cálculo para você. https://www.active.com/fitness/calculators/bmr O importante é saber que esse é o número de calorias que você deve consumir para manter o peso corporal atual. Consuma menos calorias do que esse número e a tendência será perder peso; consuma mais calorias do que esse número e você ganhará peso.

O peso é importante?

Do ponto de vista médico, o excesso de peso está associado a várias coisas. Tende a aumentar a resistência à insulina e pode levar ao diabetes. Aumenta a pressão arterial. Pode causar apneia obstrutiva do sono e agravar a artrite nas costas e nas pernas.

Estar acima do peso não é necessariamente sinal de um problema espiritual e, dependendo da genética da pessoa, pode ser difícil chegar ao peso indicado pelas tabelas. Embora a maioria das pessoas se sinta muito melhor quando está perto do peso ideal, as Escrituras não indicam que haja um peso ou índice de massa corporal (IMC) específico que os cristãos não devam ultrapassar.

O importante é que, se nos entregamos a Deus, com nossos desejos e tudo o mais, nossa vida deve estar sob o controle dele. Devemos tentar ter saúde para poder participar da melhor maneira possível da edificação do Reino. Além disso, devemos procurar dar aos outros o exemplo de uma vida entregue a Deus.

Mitos sobre a perda de peso…

Há muitas coisas em que as pessoas acreditam sobre a perda de peso. Vamos analisar uma lista de coisas que as pessoas costumam repetir. Embora possa haver nelas um fundo de verdade, não são inteiramente verdadeiras e podem desestimular atividades que ajudam quem está lutando contra o peso.

…O exercício vigoroso é a única maneira de perder peso.

Muitas pessoas acreditam que não conseguem perder peso porque não podem fazer exercícios suficientes. Elas enfrentam dores, artrite ou algum problema cardíaco ou pulmonar que as impede de praticar atividades físicas vigorosas.

Talvez conheçam alguém que começou a correr e perdeu bastante peso, e isso parece ser a maneira certa de fazer. Simplesmente não se sentem capazes de seguir esse caminho e ficam sem esperança diante de todo o esforço.

O exercício é importante. A maioria das associações médicas recomenda que as pessoas se exercitem pelo menos 150 minutos por semana. Embora o exercício estimule o metabolismo e ajude o coração e os pulmões, ainda assim pode não alterar muito o peso de uma pessoa.

A maioria das pessoas queima entre 200 e 300 calorias com meia hora de exercício. Embora isso possa parecer muito, o corpo precisa queimar 3.500 calorias para perder cerca de 450 gramas. Além disso, a maioria de nós sente mais fome depois de se exercitar, e é muito fácil comer 200 calorias a mais, anulando basicamente o que foi queimado durante o exercício.

…Os carboidratos fazem você ganhar peso.

Carboidrato é o termo médico para açúcares. As calorias que consumimos na alimentação vêm de uma entre três fontes: carboidratos, gorduras e proteínas. Os carboidratos estão presentes nas sobremesas, mas também em muitos alimentos ricos em amido, como arroz, milho, massas, pão e muitas outras coisas.

Há várias dietas, como a dieta Atkins e a dieta cetogênica, que incentivam quem as segue a cortar o máximo possível de carboidratos. Muitas vezes as pessoas perdem peso com esse tipo de dieta. Infelizmente, são dietas difíceis de manter a longo prazo, pois são bastante restritivas.

O mais saudável é comer carboidratos com moderação e preferir as opções mais saudáveis. É importante consumir cereais integrais e carboidratos mais complexos. Uma tigela de aveia pode ter quantidade semelhante de gramas de carboidratos à de um cereal açucarado para o café da manhã, mas será digerida mais lentamente pelo nosso corpo e será mais fácil para ele processá-la.

…A única maneira de perder peso é passar fome.

Passar fome realmente resulta em perda de peso — não havia pessoas corpulentas entre as que saíram dos campos de concentração na Segunda Guerra Mundial. Certamente, essa não é a única maneira de perder peso, nem é uma maneira saudável.

Sabemos que, quando as pessoas passam fome por períodos prolongados, começam a perder massa muscular, os ossos ficam mais fracos e o metabolismo diminui. A maioria das pessoas que passa fome voluntariamente acaba recuperando todo o peso perdido em poucos anos e, como o metabolismo foi reduzido, a longo prazo será mais difícil manter o peso baixo.

…Basta comer ‘___’ alimento que queima gordura para perder peso!

Deixei especificamente o espaço em branco acima porque parece que isso está sempre mudando. Talvez você tenha lido que iogurte grego, canela ou suco de goji ajudam a perder peso. Estudos indicam que não há nenhum alimento milagroso que elimine a gordura.

Se esses alimentos funcionam, é porque você substituiu algo pouco saudável e rico em calorias por algo mais saudável. Por exemplo, se seu café da manhã normal consiste em 5 fatias de bacon, um copo de suco de laranja, 2 fatias de torrada e dois ovos, e você troca tudo isso por um copo de água e uma tigela de aveia, provavelmente perderá peso. Não é porque a aveia esteja “queimando gordura”, mas porque tem significativamente menos calorias do que o café da manhã que você comia antes.

Alguns alimentos quase não têm calorias e provavelmente exigem tanta energia para serem comidos e digeridos quanto a energia que os seres humanos obtêm deles. Aipo, alface-americana e cogumelos se enquadram nessa categoria. O problema é que, se você passar pasta de amendoim no aipo, colocar molho para salada na alface e fritar os cogumelos na manteiga ou no óleo, de repente eles deixam de ser os alimentos de baixas calorias que parecem ser. Nós, seres humanos, somos muito bons em preparar alimentos de baixas calorias de modo que fiquem mais saborosos e deixem de ter poucas calorias.

…Alimentos sem gordura e dietéticos são a chave para perder peso.

Há muitos alimentos e condimentos no mercado com teor reduzido de gordura, que afirmam ter menos calorias que suas versões comuns. Muitas vezes, eles contêm diversos produtos químicos e substitutos do açúcar para que o sabor e a textura sejam o mais parecidos possível com os das versões comuns.

Os substitutos do açúcar parecem ser mais saudáveis que o açúcar quando usados com moderação, mas também parecem estimular o desejo por alimentos mais doces. Estudos associaram os adoçantes artificiais ao surgimento de intolerância à glicose — algo que poderia levar ao diabetes. https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC3095502/ Os nutricionistas parecem considerar que, entre os vários substitutos do açúcar, a estévia é o mais seguro.

Em suma, nosso objetivo não deve ser tentar comer os mesmos alimentos de sempre, só que com menos calorias, mas sim consumir uma variedade de alimentos saudáveis e porções moderadas. Isso é o que levará a um metabolismo melhor, e não simplesmente comprar versões com menos gordura de nossos alimentos favoritos.

…A solução são os comprimidos para emagrecer.

Ao longo do tempo, vi muitas pessoas tomarem medicamentos e suplementos, tanto com receita quanto vendidos sem receita, na tentativa de ajudar a perder peso. Espera-se que esses medicamentos e suplementos façam várias coisas — reduzir o apetite e aumentar a taxa metabólica são algumas delas.

Muitas vezes funcionam a curto prazo. As pessoas perdem bastante peso nas primeiras semanas e acham que venceram suas dificuldades. O problema é que, com o tempo, geralmente se acostumam ao que estão tomando, o apetite volta e o metabolismo retorna ao normal.

Embora esse tipo de solução possa ajudar a curto prazo, para ter saúde a longo prazo é preciso descobrir um plano alimentar saudável e uma rotina de exercícios e, depois, mantê-los por muito tempo. O objetivo nunca deve ser simplesmente “perder cinco quilos”, mas sim ter a melhor saúde possível.

Falamos de muitas coisas que não devemos fazer e, provavelmente, lendo nas entrelinhas, você consegue perceber algumas das coisas que também ajudam. Uma segunda parte (se Deus quiser) virá na próxima edição para abordar as medidas positivas que podemos tomar para alcançar um peso saudável.

Em tudo isso, é importante lembrar que nosso objetivo não é alcançar algum tipo de beleza terrena. O propósito, antes, é tratar nosso corpo como templo do Espírito Santo (1 Coríntios 6:19). Já ouvi esse versículo ser usado para explicar por que não devemos beber, fumar ou fazer tatuagens, mas também precisamos tratá-lo com respeito no que diz respeito à alimentação e ao exercício.

Ao cuidarmos do nosso corpo, estaremos mais aptos a atender às necessidades das pessoas ao nosso redor e preparados para cumprir qualquer plano que Deus tenha para nossa vida.

Greetings in the worthy name of our Lord and Saviour, Jesus Christ. I trust that amid the present uncertainties in the world our hearts echo with the Psalmist: In God is my salvation and my glory: the rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God –Psalm 62:7. And, God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble –Psalm 46:1.

We are facing unprecedented and challenging times. More so than many of us can remember in our lifetime. I’m sure that each generation has faced challenges unique to their time in history. The same is true of us. But what is our ‘time’ in history? Most god-fearing individuals believe we are on the threshold of what the Scriptures refer to as “the time of the end”. (See Daniel 8:17; 11:35; 11:40; 12:4; & 12:9)

Maybe it is just me, or perhaps it has a lot to do with how fast news is broadcast around the world now a days. But it sure seems like there is a lot more chaos and violent acts of nature than there was five or ten years ago. Hurricanes, tornadoes, wildfires, earthquakes, drought, flooding, political unrest, wars, and rumors of war. Did I miss anything? Oh yes, there’s the ever-present issue of a worldwide pestilence—Covid-19.

Much of the world today seems to have a sense that “something is up”, or that “something is about to happen”. We should not be surprised by this, Jesus foretold it. We should not be overcome and distracted by fear, Jesus has told us what to do. In the following Scripture I have underlined three things that I see Jesus wants us to be active in doing as long as time continues.

And Jesus answered and said unto them, Take heed that no man deceive you. For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many. And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars: see that ye be not troubled: for all these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet. For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be famines, and pestilences, and earthquakes, in divers places. All these are the beginning of sorrows. Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted, and shall kill you: and ye shall be hated of all nations for my name’s sake. And then shall many be offended, and shall betray one another, and shall hate one another. And many false prophets shall rise, and shall deceive many. And because iniquity shall abound, the love of many shall wax cold. But he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved. And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations; and then shall the end come –Matthew 24:4-14.

Take heed that no man deceive you

I find it interesting that Jesus mentions this before telling us what He wants us to do. Someone has said that spiritual blindness is different than physical blindness in that when someone is physically blind, they know it, but when someone is spiritually blind, they don’t know it. In fact, that is the foundation of being spiritually blind—to no longer be aware of one’s own spiritual condition.

What all can we be deceived by? Who all might try to deceive us? Let’s always remember that Satan wants to use whoever he can, however he can, to deceive as many as he can. Job’s friends turned against him and even his own wife offered Satan’s own words as a way out (See Job 1;11; 2:5; and 2:9). We should not be surprised if we find ourselves in similar situations; Christ predicted that this would happen (See Matthew 10:35-36; and Luke 12:53).

Let’s never forget that God has given some clear solutions that we can follow to prevent ourselves from becoming deceived. Take heed, brethren, lest there be in any of you an evil heart of unbelief, in departing from the living God. But exhort one another daily, while it is called To day; lest any of you be hardened through the deceitfulness of sin. For we are made partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence stedfast unto the end; While it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts, as in the provocation –Hebrews 3:12-15.

Endure unto the end

This is one of the more interesting Scriptures that I think of whenever there is a heated discussion about whether or not someone who is once saved is then always saved and therefore never able to become unsaved. Doesn’t Scripture assure us …that ye may know that ye have eternal life… –1 John 5:13. However, Peter tells us to …beware lest ye also, being led away with the error of the wicked, fall from your own stedfastness –2 Peter 3:17.

So how do we bring this together so that Scripture harmonizes? First, we need to be saved initially so we can have eternal life which provides us with the power to walk in obedience to God’s Word. Secondly, we stay saved as long as we continue walking in obedience to the Scriptures. Then lastly, we are finally saved forever, IF we endure through life faithfully until the end (the end of our life here on earth).

Preach the Gospel in all the world

Preach the Gospel? Yes. Maybe we can’t all personally do the preaching, but we can all do our part to help the church fulfil this mandate. Some folks God has ordained to spend hours in their prayer closet in earnest intercessory prayer. Some have been called to give of their finances to support others who have been chosen to be on the front lines preaching the Gospel. This is a group effort. It is the church as a whole working together with each local church doing their part and everyone doing their individual part.

Let’s not allow the chaos and confusion around us to cause us to become distracted and disoriented. Let’s pull together as brothers and sisters with a common goal—not being deceived, enduring unto the end, and preaching the Gospel in all the world.

Now unto him that is able to keep you from falling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory with exceeding joy, To the only wise God our Saviour, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and ever. Amen. –Jude 1:24-25.
