우리 주님이시며 구주이신 예수 그리스도의 존귀하신 이름으로 문안드립니다. 세상이 현재 겪는 불확실성 가운데서도 우리의 마음이 시편 기자의 고백에 화답하기를 바랍니다. 나의 구원과 영광이 하나님께 있음이여, 내 힘의 반석과 피난처도 하나님께 있도다 –시편 62:7. 또한 하나님은 우리의 피난처시요 힘이시니, 환난 중에 만날 큰 도움이시라 –시편 46:1.

우리는 전례 없이 힘겨운 시대를 맞이하고 있습니다. 우리 가운데 많은 이가 평생 기억할 수 있는 그 어느 때보다도 그렇습니다. 각 세대는 역사 속에서 그 시대만의 고유한 어려움에 직면해 왔으리라 확신합니다. 우리도 마찬가지입니다. 그렇다면 역사의 ‘우리 시대’란 무엇일까요? 하나님을 경외하는 대부분의 사람들은 우리가 성경에서 “마지막 때”라고 부르는 시기의 문턱에 서 있다고 믿습니다. (다니엘 8:17; 11:35; 11:40; 12:4; 및 12:9 참조)

그저 저만 그렇게 느끼는 것인지, 아니면 요즘 뉴스가 전 세계로 얼마나 빠르게 퍼져 나가는지와 큰 관련이 있는지 모르겠습니다. 하지만 5년이나 10년 전보다 혼란과 자연의 폭력적인 현상이 훨씬 더 많아진 것 같습니다. 허리케인, 토네이도, 산불, 지진, 가뭄, 홍수, 정치적 소요, 전쟁, 전쟁의 소문. 제가 빠뜨린 것이 있나요? 아, 그렇습니다. 전 세계에 계속 퍼져 있는 전염병, 코로나19도 있습니다.

오늘날 세계의 많은 사람은 “무슨 일이 일어나고 있다”거나 “무언가 곧 일어날 것”이라는 느낌을 갖고 있는 듯합니다. 우리는 이를 놀랍게 여겨서는 안 됩니다. 예수님께서 미리 말씀하셨기 때문입니다. 두려움에 압도되어 주의를 빼앗겨서도 안 됩니다. 예수님께서 우리가 무엇을 해야 할지 말씀해 주셨기 때문입니다. 다음 성경 말씀에서 저는 시간이 계속되는 동안 예수님께서 우리가 적극적으로 행하기를 바라시는 세 가지를 밑줄로 표시했습니다.

예수께서 대답하여 이르시되, 너희가 사람의 미혹을 받지 않도록 주의하라. 많은 사람이 내 이름으로 와서 이르되 내가 그리스도라 하여 많은 사람을 미혹하리라. 너희가 전쟁과 전쟁의 소문을 들을 것이니, 너희는 삼가 두려워하지 말라. 이런 일이 반드시 일어나야 하되 아직 끝은 아니니라. 민족이 민족을, 나라가 나라를 대적하여 일어나겠고, 곳곳에 기근과 전염병과 지진이 있으리니, 이 모든 것은 고통의 시작이니라. 그때에 사람들이 너희를 환난에 넘겨주고 너희를 죽이리니, 너희가 내 이름 때문에 모든 민족에게 미움을 받으리라. 그때에 많은 사람이 실족하고 서로 배반하며 서로 미워하겠고, 거짓 선지자가 많이 일어나 많은 사람을 미혹하겠으며, 불법이 성하므로 많은 사람의 사랑이 식어지리라. 그러나 끝까지 견디는 자는 구원을 받으리라. 그리고 이 천국 복음이 온 세상에 전파되어 모든 민족에게 증언이 되리니, 그제야 끝이 오리라 –마태복음 24:4-14.

너희가 사람의 미혹을 받지 않도록 주의하라

예수님께서 우리가 무엇을 하기를 바라시는지 말씀하시기에 앞서 이 말씀을 하신 것이 흥미롭습니다. 누군가 영적 맹목은 육체적 맹목과 다르다고 말한 적이 있습니다. 육체적으로 눈이 먼 사람은 자신이 그렇다는 것을 알지만, 영적으로 눈이 먼 사람은 그렇다는 것을 모른다는 것입니다. 사실 이것이 영적으로 눈먼 상태의 토대입니다. 자기 자신의 영적 상태를 더는 알아차리지 못하는 것입니다.

우리는 무엇에 미혹될 수 있을까요? 누가 우리를 미혹하려 할 수 있을까요? 사탄은 가능한 모든 사람을, 가능한 모든 방법으로 이용해 가능한 한 많은 사람을 미혹하려 한다는 것을 늘 기억합시다. 욥의 친구들은 그에게 등을 돌렸고, 심지어 그의 아내도 벗어날 길이라며 사탄의 말을 그대로 내놓았습니다 (욥기 1;11; 2:5; 및 2:9 참조). 우리도 비슷한 상황에 놓일 수 있다는 사실을 놀라워해서는 안 됩니다. 그리스도께서 이런 일이 일어날 것이라고 예언하셨습니다 (마태복음 10:35-36; 및 누가복음 12:53 참조).

미혹되지 않도록 우리가 따를 수 있는 분명한 해결책을 하나님께서 주셨다는 사실을 결코 잊지 맙시다. 형제들아, 너희 가운데 누구든지 살아 계신 하나님을 떠나 믿지 아니하는 악한 마음을 품지 않도록 주의하라. 오직 오늘이라 일컫는 동안에 날마다 서로 권면하여 너희 중 누구든지 죄의 속임수로 완고하게 되지 않도록 하라. 우리가 그리스도와 함께 참여한 자가 되었으니, 처음의 확신을 끝까지 굳게 붙들면 그러하리라. “오늘 너희가 그의 음성을 듣거든, 광야에서 거역하던 때와 같이 너희 마음을 완고하게 하지 말라” 하였느니라 –히브리서 3:12-15.

끝까지 견디라

한번 구원받은 사람은 언제나 구원받은 것이며 따라서 다시 구원을 잃을 수 없느냐를 두고 격렬한 논쟁이 벌어질 때마다 제가 떠올리는 흥미로운 성경 말씀 가운데 하나입니다. 성경은 …너희로 하여금 영생이 있음을 알게 하려 함이라… –요한일서 5:13.라고 확언하지 않습니까? 그러나 베드로는 우리에게 …너희도 미혹에 이끌려 너희의 굳건함에서 떨어질까 삼가라 –베드로후서 3:17.라고 말합니다.

그렇다면 성경 말씀이 서로 조화를 이루도록 이 두 가지를 어떻게 함께 이해해야 할까요? 첫째, 우리는 처음에 구원을 받아야 영생을 얻을 수 있고, 그 영생은 하나님의 말씀에 순종하며 살아갈 능력을 줍니다. 둘째, 성경에 순종하며 계속 살아가는 한 우리는 구원받은 상태를 유지합니다. 마지막으로, 우리가 이 땅에서의 삶이 끝날 때까지 신실하게 견딘다면, 그때 영원히 구원을 받습니다.

온 세상에 복음을 전파하라

복음을 전파하라고요? 그렇습니다. 우리 모두가 직접 전파할 수는 없을지 모르지만, 교회가 이 사명을 이루도록 각자 맡은 몫을 할 수 있습니다. 하나님께서 간절히 중보 기도하며 기도의 골방에서 여러 시간을 보내도록 정하신 이들도 있습니다. 복음을 전하는 최전선에 서도록 택함받은 이들을 지원하기 위해 재정을 바치도록 부름받은 이들도 있습니다. 이는 함께하는 일입니다. 교회 전체가 힘을 모아 일하고, 각 지역 교회가 맡은 몫을 하며, 모든 사람이 개인의 몫을 다하는 것입니다.

우리 주변의 혼란과 혼돈으로 인해 주의가 흐트러지고 방향을 잃지 않도록 합시다. 미혹되지 않고, 끝까지 견디며, 온 세상에 복음을 전한다는 공동의 목표를 품고 형제자매로서 힘을 모읍시다.

능히 너희를 넘어지지 않게 지키시고, 자기의 영광 앞에 흠 없이 큰 기쁨으로 서게 하실 이, 곧 홀로 지혜로우신 우리 구주 하나님께 영광과 위엄과 권능과 권세가 이제와 영원토록 있을지어다. 아멘. –유다서 1:24-25.

The night was still, the air was drear.

A man walked alone; his direction unclear.

A battle raged within his troubled soul.

He was at the crossroads, all his life as a whole.

He believed in God, or at least so he thought.

He obeyed what he knew—all that he’d been taught.

But something’s not right, there’s something I lack.

I’ve lived like most others, as my life plays back.

But I go to church! I sing and I pray!

I even helped the neighbor, just the other day!

He fought with his mind, justifying the wrong.

It was God that was working, He seemed quite strong.

The fact of the matter, it’s confidence I lack.

I believe in myself, not the God from way back.

God wants to show strong, in my life every day.

He wants me to be proved; He’s the Life and the Way.

There’s no better One, in Whom to put all your trust;

Than the almighty God. For all men it’s a must!

–by Barry Grant

“Dr. Waldron,” the woman said to me as I prepared to leave the exam room. “I have one more question. How can I lose this extra weight?”

I sighed inaudibly as I sat down to discuss the situation with her. Dealing with weight gain is not the sort of thing that is easy to tack onto the end of an office visit and there have been many lengthy books written on the subject.

Americans seem to struggle with this. They spend an average of 33 billion dollars on weight loss products every year and 65 percent of Americans are either overweight or obese.

The whole discussion is a challenging one. We want a quick fix—to take a pill or add in a fat-burning food or do a simple exercise that will melt the extra weight away simply and quickly. The reality is that while we gain weight quite easily, it is much more difficult to lose that same weight. Maintaining weight loss is harder yet.

In the Beginning

We don’t know much about life before the fall in Genesis 3. We do know that …God saw every thing that he had made, and, behold, it was very good… –Genesis 1:31.

It is safe to assume that Adam and Eve did not struggle with their weight before sin entered the world. They were created perfectly which meant that they would not have struggled with metabolism issues. They also did not have the uncontrolled appetites for food that their descendants deal with today.

Two things happened with the fall of man in the Garden of Eden. First, humans started to have physical ailments—their bodies did not work as well as they did before. Adam and Eve were still able to live much longer lives than humans today, but metabolic diseases and other illnesses began to develop. The second thing that happened was that they began to have a sin nature.

Those two things have led to a lot of problems… Among them are metabolism and weight issues.

What the Bible Says About Food

Our bodies need to eat nutritious food—without eating they would deteriorate and eventually die. There is nothing better for a man, than that he should eat and drink, and that he should make his soul enjoy good in his labour. This also I saw, that it was from the hand of God –Ecclesiastes 2:24.

The Old Testament law was restrictive regarding what the Jewish people could eat. Under Kosher Law, the number of clean animals was far outweighed by the numbers of unclean animals. More than that, the book of Proverbs mentions several times that overeating is dangerous. Be not among winebibbers; among riotous eaters of flesh: For the drunkard and the glutton shall come to poverty: and drowsiness shall clothe a man with rags –Proverbs 23:20-21.

From the New Testament we find the early church no longer required Gentile Christians to follow Jewish laws regarding their diets. The Jerusalem council specifically required …that they abstain from pollutions of idols, and from fornication, and from things strangled, and from blood –Acts 15:20. Otherwise, it seems that they were free to eat whatever they wanted.

What did not change in the New Testament was the idea of self-control. The Fruit of the Spirit lists temperance as one of the things Christians should have and Paul made it clear that he was focused on controlling his desires, lest he become a castaway (see 1 Corinthians 9:27).

What? know ye not that your body is the temple of the Holy Ghost which is in you, which ye have of God, and ye are not your own? For ye are bought with a price: therefore glorify God in your body, and in your spirit, which are God’s –1 Corinthians 6:19-20.

Know ye not that ye are the temple of God, and that the Spirit of God dwelleth in you? If any man defile the temple of God, him shall God destroy; for the temple of God is holy, which temple ye are –1 Corinthians 3:16-17.

Scripture is clear that Christians should take care of their bodies, put their desires under the control of God, and avoid things that have anything to do with idolatry.

Reasons People Gain Weight

It is easy to break down reasons for weight gain into two big categories:

  1. problems with metabolism
  2. problems with excessive calories.

When we think about metabolic issues, these include things like thyroid problems and diabetes. These disorders affect the rate at which our bodies burn calories. One of the main ways we have to increase our metabolism is to increase our activity levels, particularly exercise that increases the heart rate—cardiovascular exercise.

Excess calories mainly come from overeating. It is important to remember that people eat for lots of reasons other than because they are hungry. People eat because they are bored, lonely, sad, and yes, sometimes because they are hungry. Some medications, particularly steroids, can increase appetite and negatively affect the metabolic rate.

We call the number of calories our bodies burn while at rest, the body’s metabolic rate. There are a couple of different formulas used to calculate our basal metabolic rates. They use height, weight, age, and gender to determine how many calories your body will burn in an average day. There are a few applications and websites that will do this calculation for you. https://www.active.com/fitness/calculators/bmr The important thing to know is that this is the number of calories you should consume to maintain your current body weight. Eat fewer calories than this number and you will tend to lose weight, take in more calories than this number and you will gain weight.

Is Weight Important?

From a medical standpoint, being overweight is associated with several different things. It tends to increase insulin resistance and it can lead to diabetes. It increases blood pressure. It can lead to obstructive sleep apnea, and it worsens arthritis in the back and legs.

Being overweight is not necessarily an indication of a spiritual problem and depending on a person’s genetics, it can be difficult to get it where it should be according to the charts. Even though most people feel much better when they are close to their ideal weight, Scripture does not indicate that there is a specific weight or body mass index (BMI) that Christians should not go over.

The important thing is that our lives are to be under the control of God if we have yielded ourselves, appetites, and all, to Him. We should try to be healthy in order that we can best participate in Kingdom building. More than that, we should attempt to set an example for others of a life that is yielded to God.

Myths About Weight Loss…

There are many things that people believe about weight loss. We will look at a list of things which people repeat. While there may be a grain of truth in them, they are not completely true and may discourage activities that can help a person who is struggling with his weight.

…Vigorous exercise is the only way to lose weight.

Many people believe that the reason that they can’t lose weight is because they can’t do enough exercise. They struggle with pain, arthritis, or some heart or lung condition that makes them unable to do vigorous athletic endeavors.

Maybe they know someone who took up running and lost a bunch of weight and that seems like the right way to do it. They just don’t feel able to take that path and feel hopeless about the whole endeavor.

Exercise is important. Most medical societies recommend that people exercise at least 150 minutes a week. While exercise does boost our metabolism and helps our hearts and lungs, it still may not change a person’s weight very much.

Most people burn between 200 and 300 calories with a half hour of exercise. While this may sound like a lot, a body must burn 3500 calories to lose one pound. In addition, most of us are hungrier after we exercise, and it is awfully easy to eat an extra 200 calories that basically negates whatever was burned during the exercise time.

…Carbohydrates make you gain weight.

Carbohydrate is the medical term for sugars. The calories we consume in our diets come from one of three sources: carbohydrates, fats, and proteins. Carbohydrates are present in desserts, but they are also present in many starchy foods like rice, corn, pasta, bread, and lots of other things.

There are several diets, like the Atkins Diet and the Keto Diet, that push those who follow them to cut out as many carbohydrates as possible. People often do lose weight on these sorts of diets. Unfortunately, these diets are difficult to maintain long term as they are quite restrictive.

The healthiest thing is to eat carbohydrates moderately and steer towards the healthier options. Using whole grains and more complex carbohydrates is important. A bowl of oatmeal may have a similar number of grams of carbohydrates as compared to a sugary breakfast cereal, but it will be broken down more slowly by our bodies and is easier for them to deal with.

…Starvation is the only way to lose weight.

Starvation does result in weight loss—there were no heavy-set people who came out of the concentration camps in World War II. This certainly is not the only way to lose weight, nor is it a healthy way to lose weight.

We know that when people starve for extended periods of time, they will begin to lose muscle mass, their bones will get weaker, and their metabolism will decrease. Most people who starve themselves will end up regaining all of the weight they lost within a few years and because their metabolism has been downgraded, in the long run it will be harder for them to keep weight off.

…You just need to eat ‘___’ fat burning food to lose weight!

I specifically left the food blank above because it seems that this is always changing. Maybe you’ve read that Greek yogurt, or cinnamon, or goji berry juice will help you lose weight. Studies indicate that there is no magic food that will melt fat away.

If these foods work, it is because you have replaced something unhealthy and rich in calories with something healthier. For example, if your normal breakfast consists of 5 strips of bacon, a glass of orange juice, 2 slices of toast, and two eggs and you replace that with a glass of water and a bowl of oatmeal, you will probably lose weight. It is not because the oatmeal is “burning fat,” but rather that it has significantly fewer calories than the breakfast you were eating before.

Some foods have almost no calories and probably take as much energy to eat and digest as humans get from them. Celery, iceberg lettuce, and mushrooms all fall into this category. The problem is that if you put peanut butter on the celery, salad dressing on the lettuce, and fry the mushrooms in butter or oil, then suddenly they aren’t the low-calorie foods they purport to be. We humans are very good at fixing low-cal foods so that they both taste better and are no longer low-calorie.

…Fat free and diet foods are the key to weight loss.

There are many foods and condiments on the market that have reduced fat and claim to be lower calorie than the normal versions of themselves. These often have a lot of different chemicals and sugar substitutes in them to get the taste and texture as similar to the regular versions as possible.

Sugar substitutes seem to be healthier than sugar when used moderately, but they also seem to encourage people to crave sweeter foods. Studies have linked artificial sweeteners with the onset of glucose intolerance—something that could lead to diabetes. https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC3095502/ Dieticians seem to think that of the various sugar substitutes, Stevia is the safest.

All in all, our goal should not be to try to eat all the same foods, just with fewer calories, but rather to eat a variety of healthy foods and moderate-sized portions. This is what will lead to a better metabolism and not simply getting reduced fat versions of our favorite foods.

…The solution is diet pills.

Over time I have seen many people take medications and supplements, both prescription and over the counter varieties, to try to help them lose weight. These medications and supplements are supposed to do a number of things—reduce appetite and increase the metabolic rate are several of these.

They often work in the short term. People lose quite a bit of weight in the first few weeks and think that they have conquered their struggles. The problem is that over time, they usually get used to whatever it is that they are taking, their appetite returns, and their metabolism goes back to normal.

While these sorts of solutions may give short-term help, being healthy in the long term, means figuring out a healthy eating plan and exercise schedule, then sticking with it long term. The goal should never be simply to “take off ten pounds,” but rather to be as healthy as possible.

We’ve covered a lot of things not to do and probably reading between the lines you can see some of the things that are helpful to do as well. A second part (Lord willing) will be coming with the next issue to discuss positive things that we can do to achieve a healthy weight.

With all of this, it is important to remember that our goal is not about achieving some sort of earthly beauty. The aim, rather, is to treat our body as the Temple of the Holy Ghost (1 Corinthians 6:19). I have heard this verse used to explain why we shouldn’t drink, smoke, or get tattoos, but we need to treat it with respect when it comes to eating and exercise, as well.

As we care for our bodies, we will be better able to meet the needs of the people around us and we will be prepared to meet whatever plan God has for our lives.

‘Dr. Waldron,’ zei de vrouw tegen me terwijl ik me klaarmaakte om de onderzoekskamer te verlaten. ‘Ik heb nog één vraag. Hoe kan ik dit extra gewicht kwijtraken?’

Ik zuchtte onhoorbaar terwijl ik ging zitten om de situatie met haar te bespreken. Omgaan met gewichtstoename is niet iets wat je gemakkelijk aan het einde van een consult kunt toevoegen, en er zijn veel uitvoerige boeken over dit onderwerp geschreven.

Amerikanen lijken hiermee te worstelen. Ze geven jaarlijks gemiddeld 33 miljard dollar uit aan producten om af te vallen, en 65 procent van de Amerikanen heeft overgewicht of obesitas.

Het is een lastig onderwerp. We willen een snelle oplossing: een pil nemen, een vetverbrandend voedingsmiddel toevoegen of een eenvoudige oefening doen waardoor het extra gewicht snel en moeiteloos verdwijnt. De werkelijkheid is dat we weliswaar gemakkelijk aankomen, maar dat het veel moeilijker is om datzelfde gewicht weer kwijt te raken. Het gewichtsverlies behouden is nog moeilijker.

In het begin

We weten niet veel over het leven vóór de zondeval in Genesis 3. We weten wel dat …God zag alles wat Hij gemaakt had, en zie, het was zeer goed… –Genesis 1:31.

We mogen aannemen dat Adam en Eva vóór de zonde in de wereld kwam niet met hun gewicht worstelden. Ze waren volmaakt geschapen, wat betekende dat ze geen problemen met hun stofwisseling zouden hebben gehad. Ook hadden ze niet de onbeheerste eetlust waarmee hun nakomelingen vandaag de dag te maken hebben.

Met de val van de mens in de hof van Eden gebeurden er twee dingen. Ten eerste kregen mensen lichamelijke aandoeningen: hun lichaam werkte niet meer zo goed als daarvoor. Adam en Eva konden nog steeds veel langer leven dan mensen tegenwoordig, maar stofwisselingsziekten en andere aandoeningen begonnen zich te ontwikkelen. Het tweede wat gebeurde, was dat ze een zondige natuur kregen.

Die twee dingen hebben tot veel problemen geleid… waaronder problemen met de stofwisseling en het gewicht.

Wat de Bijbel zegt over voedsel

Ons lichaam heeft voedzaam eten nodig: zonder voedsel zou het achteruitgaan en uiteindelijk sterven. Er is niets beters voor een mens dan te eten en te drinken en zijn ziel te laten genieten van het goede van zijn inspanningen. Ook zag ik dat dit uit de hand van God kwam –Prediker 2:24.

De wet van het Oude Testament stelde beperkingen aan wat het Joodse volk mocht eten. Volgens de kosjere voorschriften waren er veel meer onreine dieren dan reine dieren. Bovendien wordt in het boek Spreuken meerdere keren gezegd dat te veel eten gevaarlijk is. Verkeer niet onder de wijnzuipers, onder de gulzigaards die vlees eten, want een dronkaard en gulzigaard komen tot armoede, en slaperigheid kleedt een mens in lompen –Spreuken 23:20-21.

Uit het Nieuwe Testament blijkt dat de vroege kerk van niet-Joodse christenen niet langer eiste dat zij de Joodse dieetwetten volgden. De raad in Jeruzalem bepaalde uitdrukkelijk …dat zij zich onthouden van de verontreiniging door de afgoden, van hoererij, van het verstikte en van bloed –Handelingen 15:20. Verder lijkt het erop dat ze vrij waren om te eten wat ze wilden.

Wat in het Nieuwe Testament niet veranderde, was het belang van zelfbeheersing. In de vrucht van de Geest wordt matigheid genoemd als een van de eigenschappen die christenen behoren te hebben, en Paulus maakte duidelijk dat hij erop gericht was zijn verlangens in bedwang te houden, zodat hij niet verwerpelijk zou worden (zie 1 Korinthe 9:27).

Weet u niet dat uw lichaam een tempel is van de Heilige Geest, Die in u is en Die u van God hebt ontvangen, en dat u niet van uzelf bent? U bent immers duur gekocht. Verheerlijk daarom God in uw lichaam en in uw geest, die van God zijn –1 Korinthe 6:19-20.

Weet u niet dat u de tempel van God bent en dat de Geest van God in u woont? Als iemand de tempel van God te gronde richt, zal God hem te gronde richten, want de tempel van God is heilig, en die tempel bent u –1 Korinthe 3:16-17.

De Schrift maakt duidelijk dat christenen goed voor hun lichaam moeten zorgen, hun verlangens onder Gods gezag moeten stellen en alles moeten vermijden wat met afgoderij te maken heeft.

Redenen waarom mensen aankomen

De redenen voor gewichtstoename zijn gemakkelijk in twee grote categorieën onder te verdelen:

  1. problemen met de stofwisseling
  2. problemen met een te hoge calorie-inname.

Bij stofwisselingsproblemen gaat het bijvoorbeeld om schildklierproblemen en diabetes. Deze aandoeningen beïnvloeden de snelheid waarmee ons lichaam calorieën verbrandt. Een van de belangrijkste manieren om onze stofwisseling te verhogen, is meer bewegen, met name door lichaamsbeweging die de hartslag verhoogt: cardio-oefeningen.

Een teveel aan calorieën komt vooral door te veel eten. Het is belangrijk om te bedenken dat mensen om allerlei andere redenen eten dan omdat ze honger hebben. Mensen eten omdat ze zich vervelen, eenzaam of verdrietig zijn, en ja, soms omdat ze honger hebben. Sommige medicijnen, met name steroïden, kunnen de eetlust vergroten en de stofwisseling nadelig beïnvloeden.

Het aantal calorieën dat ons lichaam in rust verbrandt, noemen we de stofwisselingssnelheid van het lichaam. Er zijn verschillende formules om onze basale stofwisseling te berekenen. Daarbij worden lengte, gewicht, leeftijd en geslacht gebruikt om te bepalen hoeveel calorieën uw lichaam op een gemiddelde dag verbrandt. Er zijn enkele apps en websites die deze berekening voor u uitvoeren. https://www.active.com/fitness/calculators/bmr Het belangrijkste om te weten is dat dit het aantal calorieën is dat u moet innemen om uw huidige lichaamsgewicht te behouden. Eet u minder calorieën dan dit aantal, dan zult u doorgaans afvallen; neemt u meer calorieën in dan dit aantal, dan zult u aankomen.

Is gewicht belangrijk?

Vanuit medisch oogpunt wordt overgewicht in verband gebracht met verschillende zaken. Het verhoogt de insulineresistentie en kan tot diabetes leiden. Het verhoogt de bloeddruk. Het kan obstructieve slaapapneu veroorzaken en artritis in de rug en benen verergeren.

Overgewicht wijst niet noodzakelijkerwijs op een geestelijk probleem en, afhankelijk van iemands genetische aanleg, kan het moeilijk zijn om het gewicht op het niveau te krijgen dat volgens de tabellen wenselijk is. Hoewel de meeste mensen zich veel beter voelen als ze dicht bij hun ideale gewicht zitten, geeft de Schrift niet aan dat er een bepaald gewicht of een bepaalde body mass index (BMI) is waar christenen niet boven zouden moeten komen.

Het belangrijkste is dat ons leven onder Gods gezag staat, als we onszelf, met onze verlangens en al, aan Hem hebben overgegeven. We moeten proberen gezond te zijn, zodat we zo goed mogelijk kunnen bijdragen aan de opbouw van het Koninkrijk. Meer nog, we moeten proberen anderen een voorbeeld te geven van een leven dat aan God is overgegeven.

Mythen over afvallen…

Mensen geloven veel dingen over afvallen. We bekijken een lijst met beweringen die vaak worden herhaald. Er kan een kern van waarheid in zitten, maar ze zijn niet helemaal waar en kunnen mensen die met hun gewicht worstelen ontmoedigen om dingen te doen die kunnen helpen.

…Intensief sporten is de enige manier om af te vallen.

Veel mensen denken dat ze niet kunnen afvallen omdat ze niet genoeg kunnen sporten. Ze hebben pijn, artritis of een aandoening aan hart of longen, waardoor ze geen intensieve sportactiviteiten kunnen doen.

Misschien kennen ze iemand die is gaan hardlopen en veel is afgevallen, en lijkt dat hun de juiste manier. Zelf voelen ze zich niet in staat die weg in te slaan en voelen ze zich hopeloos over de hele onderneming.

Beweging is belangrijk. De meeste medische verenigingen adviseren mensen om ten minste 150 minuten per week te bewegen. Hoewel lichaamsbeweging onze stofwisseling stimuleert en ons hart en onze longen helpt, verandert het iemands gewicht misschien niet veel.

De meeste mensen verbranden tijdens een half uur lichaamsbeweging tussen de 200 en 300 calorieën. Dat klinkt misschien als veel, maar het lichaam moet 3500 calorieën verbranden om een pond af te vallen. Bovendien hebben de meesten van ons meer honger na het sporten, en het is erg gemakkelijk om 200 extra calorieën te eten, waardoor je in feite weer tenietdoet wat je tijdens het sporten hebt verbrand.

…Van koolhydraten kom je aan.

Koolhydraten is de medische term voor suikers. De calorieën in ons eten zijn afkomstig uit een van drie bronnen: koolhydraten, vetten en eiwitten. Koolhydraten zitten in desserts, maar ook in veel zetmeelrijke voedingsmiddelen zoals rijst, maïs, pasta, brood en allerlei andere producten.

Er zijn verschillende diëten, zoals het Atkinsdieet en het ketodieet, die mensen die ze volgen aansporen om zo veel mogelijk koolhydraten te schrappen. Mensen vallen met dit soort diëten vaak af. Helaas zijn deze diëten op de lange termijn moeilijk vol te houden, omdat ze behoorlijk beperkend zijn.

Het gezondst is om met mate koolhydraten te eten en voor de gezondere opties te kiezen. Volkorenproducten en complexere koolhydraten gebruiken is belangrijk. Een kom havermout kan ongeveer evenveel gram koolhydraten bevatten als een portie gezoete ontbijtgranen, maar de koolhydraten uit havermout worden door ons lichaam langzamer afgebroken en zijn gemakkelijker te verwerken.

…Uithongeren is de enige manier om af te vallen.

Uithongeren leidt inderdaad tot gewichtsverlies: uit de concentratiekampen in de Tweede Wereldoorlog kwamen geen mensen met een fors postuur. Dit is zeker niet de enige manier om af te vallen en ook geen gezonde manier.

We weten dat mensen die langdurig hongerlijden spiermassa verliezen, hun botten verzwakken en hun stofwisseling vertraagt. De meeste mensen die zichzelf uithongeren, zullen binnen een paar jaar al het verloren gewicht weer terugkrijgen. Omdat hun stofwisseling is vertraagd, zullen ze op de lange termijn nog meer moeite hebben om hun gewicht laag te houden.

…Je hoeft alleen maar ‘___’ vetverbrandend voedsel te eten om af te vallen!

Ik heb hierboven bewust de naam van het voedingsmiddel opengelaten, omdat die kennelijk steeds verandert. Misschien hebt u gelezen dat Griekse yoghurt, kaneel of gojibessensap u helpt afvallen. Onderzoek wijst uit dat er geen wondervoedsel bestaat dat vet laat verdwijnen.

Als deze voedingsmiddelen werken, komt dat doordat u iets ongezonds en calorierijks hebt vervangen door iets gezonders. Als uw gewone ontbijt bijvoorbeeld bestaat uit vijf plakken spek, een glas sinaasappelsap, twee sneetjes toast en twee eieren, en u dat vervangt door een glas water en een kom havermout, zult u waarschijnlijk afvallen. Dat komt niet doordat de havermout ‘vet verbrandt’, maar doordat die aanzienlijk minder calorieën bevat dan het ontbijt dat u daarvoor at.

Sommige voedingsmiddelen bevatten bijna geen calorieën en kosten mensen waarschijnlijk evenveel energie om te eten en te verteren als ze opleveren. Selderij, ijsbergsla en champignons vallen allemaal in deze categorie. Het probleem is dat ze geen caloriearme voedingsmiddelen meer zijn zodra u pindakaas op de selderij doet, sladressing over de sla giet en de champignons in boter of olie bakt. Wij mensen zijn er heel goed in om caloriearme voedingsmiddelen zo klaar te maken dat ze lekkerder smaken, maar niet langer caloriearm zijn.

…Vetvrije en dieetproducten zijn de sleutel tot afvallen.

Er zijn veel voedingsmiddelen en smaakmakers op de markt met minder vet, die beweren minder calorieën te bevatten dan de gewone varianten. Vaak zitten er allerlei chemicaliën en suikervervangers in om de smaak en textuur zo veel mogelijk op die van de gewone varianten te laten lijken.

Suikervervangers lijken bij matig gebruik gezonder dan suiker, maar lijken mensen ook meer te laten verlangen naar zoet voedsel. Onderzoeken hebben kunstmatige zoetstoffen in verband gebracht met het ontstaan van glucose-intolerantie, iets wat tot diabetes kan leiden. https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC3095502/ Diëtisten lijken te denken dat Stevia van de verschillende suikervervangers het veiligst is.

Al met al moet ons doel niet zijn om al hetzelfde voedsel te blijven eten, maar dan met minder calorieën. We moeten juist verschillende gezonde voedingsmiddelen eten en de porties matig houden. Dat leidt tot een betere stofwisseling, niet simpelweg kiezen voor vetarme varianten van onze favoriete voedingsmiddelen.

…De oplossing is dieetpillen.

In de loop der tijd heb ik veel mensen medicijnen en supplementen zien gebruiken, zowel op recept verkrijgbare als vrij verkrijgbare middelen, om te proberen af te vallen. Deze medicijnen en supplementen zijn bedoeld om verschillende dingen te doen, zoals de eetlust verminderen en de stofwisseling verhogen.

Op korte termijn werken ze vaak. Mensen verliezen in de eerste weken behoorlijk wat gewicht en denken dat ze hun problemen hebben overwonnen. Het probleem is dat ze na verloop van tijd meestal wennen aan wat ze innemen, hun eetlust terugkomt en hun stofwisseling weer normaal wordt.

Dit soort oplossingen kan op korte termijn helpen, maar om op de lange termijn gezond te blijven, moet u een gezond eet- en bewegingsplan opstellen en u daar langdurig aan houden. Het doel mag nooit alleen zijn om ‘tien pond kwijt te raken’, maar moet zijn om zo gezond mogelijk te zijn.

We hebben veel besproken van wat u niet moet doen, en waarschijnlijk kunt u tussen de regels door ook enkele dingen zien die wél helpen. In het volgende nummer verschijnt, zo de Heer wil, een tweede deel over positieve dingen die we kunnen doen om een gezond gewicht te bereiken.

Bij dit alles is het belangrijk te bedenken dat ons doel niet is om een of ander aards schoonheidsideaal te bereiken. Het doel is veeleer om ons lichaam te behandelen als de tempel van de Heilige Geest (1 Korinthe 6:19). Ik heb dit vers horen gebruiken om uit te leggen waarom we niet zouden moeten drinken, roken of tatoeages laten zetten, maar we moeten het ook in acht nemen als het gaat om eten en lichaamsbeweging.

Als we goed voor ons lichaam zorgen, kunnen we beter voorzien in de behoeften van de mensen om ons heen en zijn we voorbereid op elk plan dat God met ons leven heeft.

There He was, the King Himself, standing before Pilate, awaiting His death sentence. A large crowd had gathered outside. There was no mistaking it, these people were angry. They wanted this man, Jesus of Nazareth, dead. “Crucify him! Crucify him!” was all that could be heard. This man must have done something terrible. But who were these people that were so angry at the Son of God? Maybe they were rapists, thieves, and murderers. Possibly they were the local liars, drunks, or some other evildoers. Actually, they were the religious people, the church goers, the ones claiming to be God’s people.

Ever since that infamous day, history has repeated itself. People claiming to be God’s people have seen those who love Jesus and try to follow His teachings as their enemies and have persecuted them any way they could. From the Jews, to the Roman Catholics, to the Protestants, the mainstream church of the day has always been the enemy of those who try to govern their everyday lives by the simple clarity of the Scriptures.

I am concerned that we have signed a deal with the mainstream church of our day—a deal for peace at all costs.

Any Scripture that teaches rebuke, reproof, or correction is considered out-of-date and is not allowed to be used to help shape the faith and practice of today’s Christian. Many individuals, church leaders, and even whole churches have begun to believe that love and acceptance alone is a better way to point others to Christ. Those who would raise a voice of warning are seen to be critical and stirring unrest, so they are quickly silenced.

As we search the Scriptures, we see that Jesus, then the disciples, then the early church, had nothing good to say or think about the false church.

While out witnessing or talking to people about the Lord, I’m amazed at the backlash from the mainstream church of our day. Mainly, the Protestant church.

A simple man walked up to a Christian concert holding a sign reading ‘Jesus saves from sin’. Without him ever saying a word, he was attacked. “Quit judging us!” “You don’t know our hearts!” “You’re a disgrace!” “Bigot!” The man slowly walked away.

Many times, the people who get angry when discussions involving God come up are actually folks who claim to know Jesus. The sinners seem to let the message penetrate their hearts. If you were to go to an intersection in a city and simply hold a sign proclaiming something about Christ, you would soon see that this is true.

As I was standing in line at a fast-food restaurant, I noticed that the young man preparing my sandwich had many interesting tattoos. Some were of tombstones, skulls, and other graphic designs. I calmly asked him if he could explain what the tattoos meant to him. He began going into detail about each one. I then asked the young man if he knew Jesus. He got sober and explained that he wanted to believe in God but couldn’t. I quoted a few Bible verses and told him that God was waiting for him. I noticed that God’s Word was having a great effect on the young man.

Meanwhile, I also noticed that the lady behind me was beginning to get frustrated. Finally, she interrupted our conversation and told the man, “Jesus loves you just the way you are. You don’t have to change for this man.” This lady later told me what church she went to and how judgmental she thought that I had acted. I was amazed. I had only told the young man about the Savior!

Before I left the restaurant, I walked back over to the young man to bid him farewell. As I approached, he looked up with tears in his eyes. “Thank you”, he said “I can tell that you truly care about me. I will go home and really think about what you said.”

That night, as I reflected on the day’s events, I wondered why that professing Christian woman had such a problem with my interaction with the young man. Why did she get so angry? I felt like the Lord gave me an answer: No man can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon –Matthew 6:24.

She was a nice young lady. And, yes, she professed that she was a Christian, but she clearly did not live a life that was in obedience to God’s Word. Rather, outside of going to church, one would not be able to tell at all that she was a follower of Christ. I’m sure if I would have met her at the park, we could have had a nice chat. I’m sure she would have been courteous and polite. I’m sure she would have presented herself as a good citizen and nice person. But when it came to being excited about Jesus, sharing the gospel, and talking about God’s Word, her true colors came out.

Am I saying that a person must be an Anabaptist to make it to heaven? Absolutely not, but I am saying we must obey the Bible and follow Christ to make it to heaven. Most professing Christians are super nice and seem godly, until you start talking about God.

Since when has the definition of a Christian been ‘a nice person’, or ‘a good citizen’? Is that all there is to it anymore—simply do what you want, find a fun church that doesn’t require anything from you, get a good job, get married, have a few children and just like that you’re a ‘Christian’? God help us!

When He was having a discussion with a group of people about whether or not they were true followers of God, Jesus said, …If ye were Abraham’s children, ye would do the works of Abraham. But now ye seek to kill me, a man that hath told you the truth … Ye do the deeds of your father … Ye are of your father the devil… –John 8:39-44.

Has the true church slipped so far as to not be able to call things as they are? God’s Word gives us clear understanding on the matter: Proving what is acceptable unto the Lord. And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather reprove them. For it is a shame even to speak of those things which are done of them in secret. But all things that are reproved are made manifest by the light: for whatsoever doth make manifest is light –Ephesians 5:10-13.

Jesus says Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid –Matthew 5:14. Do we expose sin and heresy in the same way that light exposes darkness? Or are we too attached to a comfortable life with no enemies? We do not need to be scared of the world, or of the false church, because we know that we have what they need! For years the mainstream churches have been getting farther and farther away from the truth of God’s Word. Are we afraid to recognize this? Are we afraid to separate ourselves from this? Will we stand up against it like the early church did?

There is a reason why the Protestant reformer, Martin Luther, died hating the Anabaptist people—because they rejected his interpretation of the Scriptures. The Anabaptist people were not respecters of people. Rather their only respect was for God and His Word, and that without compromise. It was for this that they were persecuted. It would have been much easier for those godly young men to just be quiet and try to get along with the Catholics and Protestants, but they refused and both groups sought to extinguish them. Still, they lived on, trusting only in their God. When we joined the church of Jesus Christ didn’t we promise to continue fighting the same fight—the same fight that Jesus fought; the same fight the early church fought—the fight against the false church? Or have we agreed to get along, for the sake of peace? After all isn’t it better for business, for friendships, and for reputation?! God forbid!

We can live a life that seems to be without sin, but still be living in disobedience. The Bible calls us to action! We are called to be lights, to be witnesses, to pursue godliness, and to live uprightly, not just to put on a good show. I believe this is what has become popular in our day. Lying, cheating, stealing, and killing are attributes that even the world rejects. It’s the ‘in thing’ to be respectable, to make a nice living, and to be upstanding citizens. But is this the life of a born-again believer? Should we fit in with the American dream? Should the only thing that’s different between us and the Protestant church be a head covering? I think we should prayerfully consider this move, the move to join hands with the mainstream church.

I personally know many Protestant Christians. I’m not trying to say they are bad people; many are good folks. But that is not what we are talking about. I believe we need to draw a line and slow down this draw to join them in any compromising manner. Let’s look at just a few of the differences between the Protestants and Anabaptists.

War

Can you believe in war, killing your enemies, and still be a New Testament Christian? Most Protestants are supporters of fighting for our freedoms and our rights. Many will go as far as calling Anabaptist people cowards for not fighting.

Years ago, a group of professing Christians gathered around the biggest bomb ever made. This bomb was about to be sent into a foreign land to destroy an entire city; this bomb was meant to kill everything in its path. Men, women, and children alike would perish because of this bomb; that was the plan. As this group was gathered around this bomb they began to pray, they asked God’s blessing on this bombing mission. They then thanked Him for its success—killing nearly one quarter of a million souls.

Jesus calls us to love our enemies. This topic clearly separated the churches during the various wars. Most of the ‘Christian’ churches in the world supported the war effort of their country. The Anabaptists would not, and they were sorely persecuted for it. So, can we be a Christian and continue to support war? If we support war, where will it stop? Will we also prepare to defend ourselves and our families against violence and lawlessness? The American church calls ‘defending ourselves’, our families, and our country, heroism or bravery; the Bible calls it.

Entertainment

It seems that most Christians in America have no problem watching as many ballgames and sports events as they desire. Movies and television are found in nearly every home. Going to the beach, casinos, and festivals are commonplace. Spending thousands on big hunting trips and expensive vacations is completed without a second thought. To be honest, there really are no limits to what the Christian in America can do, as long as it seems right to them. Jesus tells us multiple times to deny ourselves. It seems that we look for any loophole possible to indulge in all the self-gratifying activities we want! It’s no wonder the church is struggling with pornography and many other sins of the flesh. When we learn how to deny ourselves, pick up the cross, and follow Jesus, then we will start to see a clear, distinct, and large separation between us and the mainstream church of our day.

Non-conformity

It is common to conform to one’s surroundings. This is one reason we don’t send our children to public schools. Jesus is also very clear that we need to come out from among them and be separate, to say “No” to evil communication and the ways of this world, and to not be afraid of identifying ourselves with the people of God. It almost seems that dress is really the only thing that separates many of us, and that is changing also.

Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him. For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father, but is of the world –1 John 2:15-16. Where are the people that hate the world? Where are the people that want to be as separated as possible? Where are the people that are not afraid to be laughed at? Where are the people that are not afraid to be different? Oh, where are God’s people?! If history repeats itself, there will soon be no difference between the church and the world. Oh, where are the men?!

I’ve heard many Anabaptist people say they can’t say that those in the worldly church are not Christians; they just don’t want to go in that direction. Is that truthful? Is that the message we want to send to our youth, and to our children? I don’t believe so. The Bible says that few will make it. If we pass on to our children that the Protestant church is also ok, and that they just do things differently, we are destroying everything that Jesus preached. We are saying that we do what we do, not because the Bible says, but rather we decide what we do based on our circumstances and what others around us think! No wonder our children are more interested in the modern church of today than ever before—there’s no line drawn!

There was a modern church that caught my attention. They seemed to be on fire for the Lord! The pastor preached as a dying man. They were very interested in reaching the lost. But there were so many Bible teachings that they simply ignored! I finally took it to the Lord. “What is going on here God!” It was as if God told me to ‘just wait’.

Soon after that, the pastor was released from his position because he was having an affair. Then it all became clear to me—you can have a nice church, you can preach a good message, and you can help the poor, but if you’re not willing to obey ALL of the New Testament teachings, you’re not a true Christian, and you will not find victory. It’s easy to take Christianity so far, but it is not easy to sell all that you have, put your all on the altar, and follow your Master. I know this is bold, but it is the truth of God’s Word.

I was speaking to a young lady in a Protestant setting, who wanted to give her life to the Lord. She was ready to do what it took, or so she said. I asked her if she was ready to suffer for Jesus, if she was ready to separate herself from her old friends, if she was ready to be hated by the world, and ready to be different. I asked her if she was willing to change how she looked. It didn’t take long before she shockingly responded with an emphatic “No!” “I want to start going to church, but not all that other stuff.” I later noticed her with her friends pointing and laughing at me. Being cool does not define a true Christian but being rejected for the sake of the Gospel does.

This is a tough article to write. It’s not a popular message and not very encouraging. But I think it’s a message we must consider today, not only for our sake, but for our children’s sake, and that of the church of tomorrow. We must draw clear lines of separation, without any compromise. We must honestly evaluate the modern church of our day with the clear teachings of the New Testament. We must call sin, sin. We must call disobedience, sin. We must call compromise, sin. We must once again choose to suffer with the true people of God. This does not mean that we shun people or act distasteful towards them, but with love in our hearts, and a message on our lips, we point the masses to Christ!

For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ: for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth; to the Jew first, and also to the Greek –Romans 1:16.

Вот Он Сам, Царь, стоит перед Пилатом, ожидая смертного приговора. Снаружи собралась большая толпа. Не оставалось сомнений: эти люди были разгневаны. Они хотели смерти этому человеку — Иисусу из Назарета. «Распни Его! Распни Его!» — только и слышалось вокруг. Должно быть, этот человек совершил что-то ужасное. Но кто были эти люди, так разгневанные на Сына Божьего? Может быть, насильники, воры и убийцы. Возможно, местные лжецы, пьяницы или какие-нибудь другие злодеи. На самом же деле это были религиозные люди, прихожане, те, кто называл себя народом Божьим.

С того печально известного дня история повторяется. Люди, называющие себя народом Божьим, считали врагами тех, кто любит Иисуса и старается следовать Его учению, и преследовали их всеми возможными способами. От иудеев до католиков и протестантов — господствующая церковь каждой эпохи неизменно становилась врагом тех, кто старается руководствоваться ясным и простым учением Писания в повседневной жизни.

Меня беспокоит, что мы заключили сделку с господствующей церковью наших дней — сделку ради мира любой ценой.

Любое место Писания, где говорится о порицании, обличении или исправлении, считается устаревшим, и его не позволяют использовать для формирования веры и практики сегодняшнего христианина. Многие отдельные люди, церковные лидеры и даже целые церкви стали верить, что одной лишь любви и принятия достаточно, чтобы указывать другим путь ко Христу. Тех, кто осмеливается предостеречь, считают критиканами и возмутителями спокойствия, поэтому их быстро заставляют замолчать.

Исследуя Писание, мы видим, что Иисус, затем ученики, а потом и ранняя церковь не говорили и не думали ничего хорошего о лжецеркви.

Когда я свидетельствую о Господе или говорю с людьми о Нем, меня поражает, с каким отпором я сталкиваюсь со стороны господствующей церкви наших дней. Прежде всего — протестантской церкви.

Однажды простой человек пришел на христианский концерт с табличкой «Иисус спасает от греха». Он не успел произнести ни слова, как на него набросились. «Хватит нас осуждать!» «Ты не знаешь, что у нас на сердце!» «Какой позор!» «Фанатик!» Мужчина медленно ушел.

Нередко люди, которые сердятся, когда заходит разговор о Боге, на самом деле сами утверждают, что знают Иисуса. А грешники, похоже, позволяют этому посланию проникнуть в свое сердце. Если прийти на перекресток в городе и просто встать с табличкой, возвещающей что-нибудь о Христе, вскоре можно убедиться, что это правда.

Стоя в очереди в ресторане быстрого питания, я заметил, что у молодого человека, который готовил мне сэндвич, было много интересных татуировок. Некоторые изображали надгробия, черепа и другие мрачные рисунки. Я спокойно спросил его, может ли он объяснить, что для него значат эти татуировки. Он начал подробно рассказывать о каждой. Затем я спросил молодого человека, знает ли он Иисуса. Он посерьезнел и объяснил, что хотел бы верить в Бога, но не может. Я процитировал несколько стихов из Библии и сказал ему, что Бог ждет его. Я заметил, что Слово Божье глубоко подействовало на молодого человека.

Тем временем я также заметил, что женщина позади меня начинала раздражаться. Наконец она прервала наш разговор и сказала молодому человеку: «Иисус любит тебя таким, какой ты есть. Тебе не нужно меняться ради этого человека». Позже эта женщина сказала мне, в какую церковь ходит, и рассказала, каким осуждающим, по ее мнению, было мое поведение. Я был поражен. Ведь я всего лишь рассказал молодому человеку о Спасителе!

Перед тем как уйти из ресторана, я вернулся к молодому человеку, чтобы попрощаться. Когда я подошел, он поднял на меня глаза; они были полны слез. «Спасибо, — сказал он. — Я вижу, что вам действительно не все равно. Я пойду домой и хорошенько обдумаю то, что вы сказали».

В тот вечер, размышляя о событиях дня, я задумался, почему эта женщина, называвшая себя христианкой, так возражала против моего разговора с молодым человеком. Почему она так рассердилась? Мне показалось, что Господь дал мне ответ: Никто не может служить двум господам: ибо или одного будет ненавидеть, а другого любить; или одному станет усердствовать, а о другом нерадеть. Не можете служить Богу и маммоне. –Матфея 6:24.

Она была приятной молодой женщиной. И да, она исповедовала себя христианкой, но явно не жила в послушании Слову Божьему. Если не считать посещения церкви, по ее жизни никак нельзя было понять, что она последовала за Христом. Уверен, встреться я с ней в парке, мы могли бы приятно побеседовать. Уверен, она была бы учтива и вежлива. Уверен, она представилась бы добропорядочной гражданкой и хорошим человеком. Но когда дело дошло до воодушевления Иисусом, проповеди Евангелия и разговоров о Слове Божьем, она показала свое истинное лицо.

Неужели я говорю, что для того, чтобы попасть на небеса, человек должен быть анабаптистом? Разумеется, нет. Но я говорю, что для этого мы должны повиноваться Библии и следовать за Христом. Большинство людей, исповедующих христианство, очень милы и кажутся благочестивыми — до тех пор, пока не заговоришь о Боге.

С каких это пор христианин — это «приятный человек» или «добропорядочный гражданин»? Неужели теперь все сводится к этому: делай что хочешь, найди веселую церковь, которая ничего от тебя не требует, найди хорошую работу, женись, заведи несколько детей — и вот ты уже «христианин»? Боже, помоги нам!

Когда Иисус беседовал с группой людей о том, были ли они истинными последователями Бога, Он сказал: …Если бы вы были дети Авраама, то дела Авраамовы делали бы. А теперь ищете убить Меня, Человека, сказавшего вам истину… Вы делаете дела отца вашего… Ваш отец диавол… –Иоанна 8:39-44.

Неужели истинная церковь настолько отступила, что уже не способна называть вещи своими именами? Слово Божье ясно говорит нам об этом: Испытывайте, что благоугодно Богу, и не участвуйте в бесплодных делах тьмы, но и обличайте. Ибо о том, что они делают тайно, стыдно и говорить. Все же обнаруживаемое делается явным от света, потому что все, делающееся явным, свет есть. –Ефесянам 5:10-13.

Иисус говорит: Вы — свет мира. Не может укрыться город, стоящий на верху горы. –Матфея 5:14. Обличаем ли мы грех и ересь так же, как свет рассеивает тьму? Или мы слишком привязаны к удобной жизни, в которой нет врагов? Нам не нужно бояться мира или лжецеркви, ведь мы знаем, что обладаем тем, в чем они нуждаются! Уже много лет господствующие церкви все дальше и дальше отходят от истины Слова Божьего. Боимся ли мы признать это? Боимся ли мы отделиться от них? Будем ли мы выступать против этого, как это делала ранняя церковь?

Протестантский реформатор Мартин Лютер умер, ненавидя анабаптистов, потому что они отвергли его толкование Писания. Анабаптисты не считались с лицами. Их почтение было обращено только к Богу и Его Слову, и ни в чем они не шли на компромисс. За это их и преследовали. Благочестивым молодым людям было бы намного проще просто молчать и стараться ладить с католиками и протестантами, но они отказались, и обе группы стремились истребить их. И все же они продолжали жить, уповая только на своего Бога. Разве, присоединяясь к церкви Иисуса Христа, мы не обещали продолжать ту же борьбу — ту же борьбу, которую вел Иисус; ту же борьбу, которую вела ранняя церковь, — борьбу против лжецеркви? Или мы согласились ладить со всеми ради мира? Ведь так выгоднее для дела, дружбы и репутации, не правда ли?! Боже упаси!

Мы можем жить так, что на первый взгляд будем казаться безгрешными, но при этом оставаться непослушными. Библия призывает нас действовать! Мы призваны быть светом, свидетельствовать, стремиться к благочестию и жить праведно, а не просто создавать хорошее впечатление. Думаю, именно это стало популярным в наши дни. Ложь, обман, воровство и убийство не одобряет даже мир. Теперь «в моде» быть уважаемым человеком, хорошо зарабатывать и быть добропорядочным гражданином. Но так ли живет возрожденный верующий? Должны ли мы вписываться в американскую мечту? Неужели единственное отличие между нами и протестантской церковью — головной убор? Думаю, нам следует с молитвой обдумать этот шаг — шаг к тому, чтобы объединиться с господствующей церковью.

Я лично знаю многих христиан-протестантов. Я не хочу сказать, что они плохие люди; многие из них — хорошие люди. Но речь не об этом. Я считаю, что нам нужно провести черту и замедлить наше сближение с ними, не допуская никаких компромиссов. Давайте рассмотрим лишь несколько различий между протестантами и анабаптистами.

Война

Можно ли поддерживать войну, убивать врагов и при этом оставаться христианином Нового Завета? Большинство протестантов поддерживают борьбу за наши свободы и права. Многие доходят до того, что называют анабаптистов трусами за отказ воевать.

Много лет назад группа людей, исповедовавших христианство, собралась вокруг самой большой из когда-либо созданных бомб. Эту бомбу собирались сбросить на чужую страну, чтобы уничтожить целый город; она должна была убить все на своем пути. Из-за этой бомбы погибли бы мужчины, женщины и дети — таков был план. Собравшись вокруг нее, люди начали молиться, прося Божьего благословения для этой бомбардировки. Затем они благодарили Его за ее успех — за убийство почти четверти миллиона душ.

Иисус призывает нас любить врагов. Во время разных войн этот вопрос ясно разделял церкви. Большинство «христианских» церквей в мире поддерживали участие своих стран в войне. Анабаптисты этого не делали, и за это их жестоко преследовали. Итак, можно ли быть христианином и продолжать поддерживать войну? Если мы поддерживаем войну, где же остановимся? Будем ли мы также готовиться защищать себя и свои семьи от насилия и беззакония? Американская церковь называет «защиту себя, своих семей и своей страны» героизмом и отвагой; Библия называет это…

Развлечения

Похоже, большинство христиан в Америке не видят ничего плохого в том, чтобы смотреть столько бейсбольных и других спортивных состязаний, сколько им захочется. Почти в каждом доме есть фильмы и телевизор. Поездки на пляж, в казино и на фестивали стали обычным делом. Тысячи долларов тратятся на большие охотничьи выезды и дорогой отдых, и никто не задумывается об этом. Честно говоря, для христианина в Америке нет почти никаких ограничений, если ему самому кажется, что все в порядке. Иисус не раз говорит нам отвергать себя. Похоже, мы ищем любую лазейку, лишь бы предаваться всем угодным нам занятиям! Неудивительно, что церковь борется с порнографией и многими другими плотскими грехами. Когда мы научимся отвергать себя, брать крест и следовать за Иисусом, тогда между нами и господствующей церковью наших дней начнет проявляться ясное, отчетливое и заметное разделение.

Несоответствие миру

Обычно люди подстраиваются под свое окружение. Это одна из причин, почему мы не отдаем детей в государственные школы. Иисус также совершенно ясно говорит, что нам нужно выйти из их среды и отделиться, сказать «нет» злому общению и путям этого мира и не бояться отождествлять себя с народом Божьим. Порой кажется, что многих из нас отделяет от других только одежда, да и это меняется.

Не любите мира, ни того, что в мире: кто любит мир, в том нет любви Отчей. Ибо все, что в мире: похоть плоти, похоть очей и гордость житейская, не есть от Отца, но от мира сего. –1 Иоанна 2:15-16. Где люди, ненавидящие мир? Где люди, желающие как можно сильнее отделиться от него? Где люди, которые не боятся насмешек? Где люди, которые не боятся быть не такими, как все? О, где же народ Божий?! Если история повторится, вскоре между церковью и миром не останется никакого различия. О, где же мужи?!

Я слышал, как многие анабаптисты говорили, что не могут утверждать, будто люди в мирской церкви — не христиане; просто они сами не хотят идти в этом направлении. Правду ли мы говорим? Именно такое послание мы хотим передать нашей молодежи и детям? Не думаю. Библия говорит, что спасутся немногие. Если мы передадим детям, что протестантская церковь тоже приемлема и просто делает все по-другому, мы разрушаем все, о чем проповедовал Иисус. Мы говорим, что поступаем так не потому, что этого требует Библия, а потому, что сами решаем, как поступать, исходя из обстоятельств и мнения окружающих! Неудивительно, что наши дети теперь, как никогда прежде, интересуются современной церковью — ведь черта не проведена!

Одна современная церковь привлекла мое внимание. Казалось, ее члены горели любовью к Господу! Пастор проповедовал так, словно был умирающим человеком. Они с большим рвением стремились достичь погибающих. Но так много библейских учений они просто игнорировали! Наконец я принес этот вопрос Господу. «Что же здесь происходит, Боже!» Казалось, Бог сказал мне: «Просто подожди».

Вскоре после этого пастора отстранили от должности, потому что у него была любовная связь на стороне. Тогда мне все стало ясно: можно иметь хорошую церковь, проповедовать хорошую весть и помогать бедным, но если ты не готов повиноваться ВСЕМ учениям Нового Завета, ты не истинный христианин и не обретешь победы. Легко зайти в христианстве достаточно далеко, но нелегко продать все, что имеешь, положить все на алтарь и последовать за своим Господином. Я знаю, что это смелое утверждение, но таково истинное Слово Божье.

Я разговаривал с молодой женщиной в протестантской среде, которая хотела посвятить свою жизнь Господу. Она была готова на все, что потребуется, — по крайней мере, так она говорила. Я спросил ее, готова ли она страдать ради Иисуса, отделиться от прежних друзей, быть ненавидимой миром и стать не такой, как все. Я спросил, готова ли она изменить свою внешность. Не прошло и много времени, как она с потрясенным видом решительно ответила: «Нет!» «Я хочу начать ходить в церковь, но не хочу всего остального». Позже я увидел, как она показывала на меня своим друзьям и смеялась вместе с ними. Быть крутым — не значит быть истинным христианином, а быть отвергнутым ради Евангелия — значит.

Эту статью нелегко писать. Это непопулярное послание, и оно не слишком ободряет. Но думаю, что сегодня нам нужно над ним задуматься не только ради себя, но и ради наших детей и будущей церкви. Мы должны провести ясные границы отделения, не идя ни на какие компромиссы. Мы должны честно оценивать современную церковь наших дней в свете ясных учений Нового Завета. Мы должны называть грех грехом. Мы должны называть непослушание грехом. Мы должны называть компромисс грехом. Мы должны вновь выбрать страдания вместе с истинным народом Божьим. Это не означает, что мы избегаем людей или ведем себя с ними неприязненно, но с любовью в сердце и посланием на устах мы указываем множеству людей путь ко Христу!

Ибо я не стыжусь благовествования Христова, потому что оно есть сила Божия ко спасению всякому верующему, во-первых, Иудею, потом и Еллину. –Римлянам 1:16.

“Could you come with me to visit my sister and her husband?” a friend asked my husband. “They’re having serious marriage problems. My brother-in-law saw how God is working in our marriage and asked me how it happened. Can you tell them how God could change their marriage, too?”

At dusk that evening, my husband, and I, waited with our friend outside his sister’s home. Half an hour later a dilapidated red pickup chugged up and shuddered to a stop. An overweight man with grease-covered clothes and a perpetual smile heaved himself out from behind the steering wheel, while his pretty, fashionably dressed wife hopped out of the passenger seat.

“Come in! Come in!” they invited, guiding us to the stairway which led to their living quarters.

“Excuse the mess,” the wife apologized, swiping clothes from the couches so we could take seats. The room was elaborately furnished but dirty. A deep layer of dust covered the top of the large-screen television set, the end tables… everything.

“Lord, give us wisdom,” I silently implored as we took seats across from the couple. How could we connect with folks we scarcely knew, and who did not have God in their lives?

The husband talked. His wife had failed him miserably and had cheated on him many times. She was presently meeting with a new boyfriend, a young chap she had learned to know on the street. “But I’ll forgive you all that,” promised the husband, “If you are willing to start over, be my wife, and be a mom to our children. I know you’ve failed, but we all fail. Let’s start over, Dear.”

The wife sat in stony silence. Our friend talked, pleading with his sister and brother-in-law to be reconciled. My husband talked about God and His plan for marriage, urging them to turn to Him.

Finally, the wife opened her mouth. Bitterness poured out; dishonor; old dirt. “You never show me that you care. You never buy me anything. Why should I try to please you anymore?”

The husband joined the fray. Both talked at once, on and on, louder and louder.

We sat with sagging hearts, listening, praying, thinking. I tried to imagine how the wife must have felt. She was pretty and young. Why stay at home to clean, cook, and wash clothes for a hulk of a husband who spent his days leaning over greasy motors and crawling under dirty cars? Why, when she could have fun on the street with a cool, young fellow who made her feel so-o-o special?

Finally, the couple ran out of steam. We sat in sad silence. “I’m sorry,” my husband stated finally, “but we can’t help you. The only one who can help you is God. And if you don’t want His help, there’s no hope for your marriage.”

“Yeah, I really should go to church,” mumbled the husband.

“Ha, ha,” sneered the wife. “Just see you become a Mennonite yet!” We rose and shook hands, promised our prayers, and left.

After we left that evening, more harsh words flew between the couple. Their two children came upon the scene and, siding with their father, drove their mother from the house.

From far in the distance came a sound of music—and what else? Singing. Joyful shouting. A wife threw open the shutter from a window facing the street, leaned out, and peered up the road. Oh, yes, today is the day my husband went to bring the Ark of the Covenant home. But why are they making such a ruckus over it?

Into the city danced the parade, singing, shouting, and blowing trumpets. David danced with all his might, his heart overflowing with thanks to God. After agonizing years of fleeing from Saul, God had established him as king. And now the Ark of the Lord was finally returning to its proper dwelling place… God be praised!

As David leaped and shouted his way up the street, his wife looked down from her perch at the window with a dark scowl on her face. Just look at how his robe flies around as he dances. Doesn’t he have any shame?! And hollering like that… what a way for a king to act! Doesn’t he care what others think?!

David returned home several hours later—tired, but happy—to bless his household. It had been a good day. He could tell his wife, Michal, all about it at the supper table.

But she beat him to the subject. [“My, but didn’t you act gloriously today,”] were her frosty words. David must have looked confused. [“I mean, jumping around like that in front of the maidens, just like a vain fellow from off the streets!”]

David must have been smitten. [“I was doing it to the Lord, to the one who chose me to be king instead of your father.”]

I imagine Michal wincing. Ouch! [“Why do you have to throw that in my face?”]

[“I know I am low in your esteem,”]* continued David, [“but those maidens you mentioned, they esteem me.”]

I think of the wayward lady in town who was chased from home by her children, and I wonder who will care for her forty years from now when her pretty face is wrinkled, and her back is bent.

I picture Michal’s lonely old age. The account ends by saying she had no children until her dying day. I doubt if her king-husband bothered to stop in with her anymore. Why would he? He received honor aplenty from others. I also wonder if Michal’s dishonor and their fall-out weakened King David. Several chapters later tell of his eyes roving to a neighbor’s wife and the resulting sin.

All wives are tempted to dishonor their husbands. We are tempted to dishonor regardless of whether our husband is a king or a mechanic, godly or ungodly.

Every day I choose to honor or dishonor the husband God gave me. I can skip alongside him, supporting with enthusiasm, or I can hang out the window, watching with scorn in my heart. I can focus on what he does well and compliment him, or I can nag about what he does wrong. My choice determines the reciprocating favor or loss. My choice affects, not only my husband and me, but also a cloud of witnesses… my children, my sisters in Christ, and my neighbors.

“And the wife see that she reverence her husband.”
(Ephesians 5:33b)

* This is how the Spanish Bible says it; the thought is clearer than in the English translation.

“Je, unaweza kuja nami kuwatembelea dada yangu na mumewe?” rafiki mmoja alimwuliza mume wangu. “Wana matatizo makubwa ya ndoa. Shemeji yangu aliona jinsi Mungu anavyotenda kazi katika ndoa yetu, akaniuliza ilikuwaje. Je, unaweza kuwaambia jinsi Mungu anavyoweza kubadilisha ndoa yao pia?”

Jioni hiyo wakati wa machweo, mimi na mume wangu tulimsubiri rafiki yetu nje ya nyumba ya dada yake. Nusu saa baadaye, gari la kubebea mizigo jekundu lililochakaa lilikuja likinguruma na kusimama kwa mtikisiko. Mwanamume mnene kupita kiasi, aliyevaa nguo zilizofunikwa na grisi na mwenye tabasamu la kudumu, alijitahidi kutoka upande wa dereva, huku mke wake mrembo, aliyevaa kwa mtindo wa kisasa, akiruka kutoka kwenye kiti cha abiria.

“Karibuni! Karibuni!” walitualika, wakituongoza kwenye ngazi zilizopanda hadi kwenye sehemu yao ya kuishi.

“Samahani kwa fujo,” mke aliomba radhi, akiondoa nguo kwenye makochi ili tuweze kuketi. Chumba kilikuwa na samani za kifahari lakini kilikuwa kichafu. Tabaka nene la vumbi lilifunika sehemu ya juu ya runinga kubwa, meza za pembeni… kila kitu.

“Bwana, tupe hekima,” niliomba kimyakimya tulipoketi mkabala na wenzi hao. Tungewezaje kuwa karibu na watu ambao hatuwafahamu sana, na ambao hawakuwa na Mungu maishani mwao?

Mume alizungumza. Mke wake alikuwa amemwangusha vibaya sana na alikuwa amemsaliti mara nyingi. Wakati huo alikuwa akikutana na mpenzi mpya, kijana aliyekuwa amefahamiana naye mtaani. “Lakini nitakusamehe yote hayo,” mume akaahidi, “ikiwa uko tayari kuanza upya, kuwa mke wangu, na kuwa mama wa watoto wetu. Najua umekosea, lakini sote hukosea. Tuanzie upya, Mpenzi.”

Mke alikaa kimya kama jiwe. Rafiki yetu akazungumza, akimsihi dada yake na shemeji yake wapatanishwe. Mume wangu akazungumza kuhusu Mungu na mpango wake kwa ajili ya ndoa, akiwahimiza wamgeukie Yeye.

Mwishowe, mke akafumbua kinywa. Uchungu ukamwagika; dharau; mambo machafu ya zamani. “Hunionyeshi kamwe kwamba unanijali. Huwahi kuninunulia chochote. Kwa nini nijitahidi tena kukufurahisha?”

Mume akaungana naye katika mabishano. Wote wawili wakazungumza kwa wakati mmoja, bila kukoma, kwa sauti zilizozidi kupaza.

Tuliketi mioyo yetu ikiwa imelegea, tukisikiliza, tukiomba, tukifikiria. Nilijaribu kuwazia jinsi mke huyo lazima alivyohisi. Alikuwa mrembo na mchanga. Kwa nini abaki nyumbani kusafisha, kupika, na kufua nguo za mume mkubwa na mnene aliyetumia siku zake akiinama juu ya injini zenye grisi na kutambaa chini ya magari machafu? Kwa nini, wakati angeweza kujifurahisha mtaani na kijana mtanashati aliyemfanya ajihisi wa pekee mno?

Mwishowe, wenzi hao wakakosa cha kusema. Tukaketi kimya kwa huzuni. “Samahani,” mume wangu alisema hatimaye, “lakini hatuwezi kuwasaidia. Mungu ndiye pekee anayeweza kuwasaidia. Na msipotaka msaada wake, hakuna tumaini kwa ndoa yenu.”

“Ndiyo, kwa kweli napaswa kwenda kanisani,” mume akanung’unika.

“Ha, ha,” mke akacheka kwa dharau. “Ngoja tu uone jinsi utakavyokuwa Mmennoni!” Tukasimama na kupeana mikono, tukaahidi kuwaombea, kisha tukaondoka.

Baada ya kuondoka jioni hiyo, maneno makali zaidi yakarushiana kati ya wenzi hao. Watoto wao wawili walifika na kukuta hali hiyo, kisha wakaungana na baba yao na kumfukuza mama yao kutoka nyumbani.

Sauti ya muziki ilisikika kutoka mbali—na nini kingine? Uimbaji. Vigelegele vya furaha. Mke akafungua kwa nguvu dirisha lililotazama barabarani, akainama nje na kutazama upande wa barabara. Naam, leo ndiyo siku ambayo mume wangu alienda kuleta nyumbani Sanduku la Agano. Lakini kwa nini wanalifanyia fujo kubwa kiasi hiki?

Gwaride likaingia mjini likicheza, likiimba, likipiga vigelegele na kupuliza tarumbeta. Daudi alicheza kwa nguvu zake zote, moyo wake ukifurika shukrani kwa Mungu. Baada ya miaka yenye uchungu ya kumkimbia Sauli, Mungu alikuwa amemweka kuwa mfalme. Na sasa Sanduku la Bwana hatimaye lilikuwa likirudi mahali pake panapostahili pa kukaa… Mungu asifiwe!

Daudi aliporuka na kupiga vigelegele akipanda barabarani, mke wake alitazama chini kutoka aliposimama dirishani, uso wake ukiwa umekunjamana kwa hasira. Angalia tu jinsi joho lake linavyopepea huku akicheza. Hana haya hata kidogo?! Na kupiga kelele hivyo… mfalme anapaswa kujiendesha hivyo kweli?! Hajali wengine wanafikiria nini?!

Daudi alirudi nyumbani saa kadhaa baadaye—akiwa amechoka, lakini mwenye furaha—ili kuibariki nyumba yake. Ilikuwa siku nzuri. Angeweza kumsimulia mke wake, Mikali, yote mezani wakati wa chakula cha jioni.

Lakini yeye akatangulia kuzungumzia jambo hilo. [“Lo, lakini leo ulijitukuza kama nini,”] hayo ndiyo maneno yake ya baridi. Lazima Daudi alionekana kuchanganyikiwa. [“Namaanisha, kurukaruka hivyo mbele ya vijakazi, kama mtu mwenye majivuno wa mitaani!”]

Lazima Daudi aliumizwa. [“Nilikuwa nikifanya hivyo kwa ajili ya Bwana, yeye aliyenichagua niwe mfalme badala ya baba yako.”]

Nawazia Mikali akijikunyata. Lo! [“Kwa nini unapaswa kunitupia hilo usoni?”]

[“Najua hunitazami kwa heshima,”]* Daudi akaendelea, [“lakini wale vijakazi uliowataja, wao huniheshimu.”]

Namfikiria yule mwanamke aliyepotoka mjini, aliyefukuzwa nyumbani na watoto wake, nami najiuliza ni nani atakayemtunza miaka arobaini kuanzia sasa, wakati uso wake mrembo utakapokuwa na mikunjo na mgongo wake utakapokuwa umepinda.

Nawazia uzee wa upweke wa Mikali. Simulizi hilo linaishia kwa kusema kwamba hakuwa na watoto hadi siku aliyokufa. Nina shaka kama mume wake mfalme alijisumbua tena kumtembelea. Kwa nini afanye hivyo? Alipokea heshima tele kutoka kwa wengine. Pia najiuliza kama dharau ya Mikali na ugomvi wao vilimdhoofisha Mfalme Daudi. Sura kadhaa baadaye zinasimulia jinsi macho yake yalivyotangatanga kumwangalia mke wa jirani yake na dhambi iliyotokana na hilo.

Wake wote hujaribiwa kuwadharau waume zao. Tunajaribiwa kudharau bila kujali kama mume wetu ni mfalme au fundi mekanika, mcha Mungu au asiye mcha Mungu.

Kila siku mimi huchagua kumheshimu au kumdharau mume ambaye Mungu amenipa. Ninaweza kwenda naye kwa furaha, nikimuunga mkono kwa shauku, au ninaweza kujitokeza dirishani, nikimtazama kwa dharau moyoni. Ninaweza kuzingatia mambo anayofanya vizuri na kumpongeza, au ninaweza kumsumbua kwa yale anayofanya vibaya. Chaguo langu huamua kama nitapata upendeleo wa kujibiwa au nitaupoteza. Chaguo langu huathiri si mimi na mume wangu tu, bali pia umati wa mashahidi… watoto wangu, dada zangu katika Kristo, na majirani zangu.

“Na mke aangalie kwamba amheshimu mumewe.”
(Waefeso 5:33b)

* Hivi ndivyo Biblia ya Kihispania inavyosema; wazo hili liko wazi zaidi kuliko katika tafsiri ya Kiingereza.

The night was still, the air was drear.

A man walked alone; his direction unclear.

A battle raged within his troubled soul.

He was at the crossroads, all his life as a whole.

He believed in God, or at least so he thought.

He obeyed what he knew—all that he’d been taught.

But something’s not right, there’s something I lack.

I’ve lived like most others, as my life plays back.

But I go to church! I sing and I pray!

I even helped the neighbor, just the other day!

He fought with his mind, justifying the wrong.

It was God that was working, He seemed quite strong.

The fact of the matter, it’s confidence I lack.

I believe in myself, not the God from way back.

God wants to show strong, in my life every day.

He wants me to be proved; He’s the Life and the Way.

There’s no better One, in Whom to put all your trust;

Than the almighty God. For all men it’s a must!

–by Barry Grant

रात थी निस्तब्ध, हवा उदास।

एक आदमी अकेला चला; मंज़िल का न था आभास।

उसकी व्याकुल आत्मा में छिड़ा था भीषण संग्राम।

वह जीवन के चौराहे पर था, जीवन का पूरा सफ़र सामने तमाम।

वह ईश्वर में विश्वास करता था, या कम-से-कम उसे ऐसा लगता था।

जो कुछ वह जानता था—जो कुछ उसे सिखाया गया था, उसका पालन करता था।

पर कुछ ठीक नहीं, मुझमें कुछ कमी है।

जीवन को पीछे मुड़कर देखूँ, तो दूसरों की तरह ही जिया हूँ मैं।

पर मैं चर्च जाता हूँ! गाता हूँ और प्रार्थना करता हूँ!

अभी कुछ ही दिन पहले पड़ोसी की मदद भी तो की थी!

उसने मन ही मन संघर्ष किया, गलत को सही ठहराया।

ईश्वर ही काम कर रहा था, वह बहुत सामर्थी लगा।

सच तो यह है कि मुझमें आत्मविश्वास की कमी है।

मैं अपने आप पर विश्वास करता हूँ, उस पुराने समय के ईश्वर पर नहीं।

ईश्वर हर दिन मेरे जीवन में अपनी सामर्थ्य दिखाना चाहता है।

वह चाहता है कि मैं प्रमाणित होऊँ; वही जीवन और मार्ग है।

अपना पूरा भरोसा रखने के लिए उससे बेहतर कोई नहीं;

सर्वशक्तिमान ईश्वर से बढ़कर कोई नहीं। हर मनुष्य के लिए यह ज़रूरी है!

Lord, this pain seems unbearable.
Things once loved now must die.
So many hearts are bleeding.
No one has kept a dry eye.

We’ve wept and writhed and prayed
Asking, Lord, this cup to avoid.
We tried what we thought might change it,
But all attempts seemed to return to us void.

Father, we’ve cried out for mercy,
All would have escaped this pain.
But Lord, You bade us go through it;
Your hand in it all You’ve made plain.

Our minds seem to spin as we ponder,
Just exactly what You’re trying to do.
Yet we know that no matter our feelings,
There’s a reason we this storm must go through.

So Father, we bow at Your feet now,
Acknowledging Your omnipotent might.
We cannot discern all the details,
But we trust in the end, all will be right.

Help us, Father, to be broken,
Releasing our all up to You.
Our rights, dreams, ambitions, and possessions,
Making everything open to Your view.

Grow in us, Lord, a humility,
Quiet, yet deep and true.
It’s a jewel that nothing but trials can teach.
Lord, through this, make us more like You!

May our eyes be set on You, Father,
Not on this o’erwhelming gale.
For You have gone through these deep waters,
Nothing but what You plan will prevail.

Obedient even unto death, Lord,
No matter how high the cost may seem.
Give us a vision of the heavenly treasure,
For which no earthly price can exceed.

–By Adrianna H. Fanton

Tuhan, rasa sakit ini seakan tak tertanggungkan.
Hal-hal yang dahulu dikasihi kini harus mati.
Begitu banyak hati yang terluka.
Tak seorang pun dapat menahan air mata.

Kami menangis, meronta, dan berdoa,
Memohon, Tuhan, agar cawan ini dijauhkan.
Kami mencoba apa pun yang kami kira dapat mengubahnya,
Namun semua upaya seakan kembali kepada kami dengan sia-sia.

Bapa, kami berseru memohon belas kasihan,
Seandainya kami semua dapat luput dari rasa sakit ini.
Namun, Tuhan, Engkau menyuruh kami menjalaninya;
Engkau telah memperjelas bahwa tangan-Mu bekerja dalam semua ini.

Pikiran kami seakan berputar saat merenungkan,
Apa sebenarnya yang hendak Engkau lakukan.
Namun kami tahu, apa pun yang kami rasakan,
Ada alasan mengapa badai ini harus kami lalui.

Maka, Bapa, kini kami bersujud di kaki-Mu,
Mengakui kuasa-Mu yang mahakuasa.
Kami tak mampu memahami setiap perinciannya,
Namun kami percaya pada akhirnya semua akan baik-baik saja.

Tolonglah kami, Bapa, agar kami diremukkan,
Menyerahkan seluruh diri kami kepada-Mu.
Hak, impian, ambisi, dan milik kami,
Membuka segalanya bagi-Mu untuk melihatnya.

Tumbuhkanlah dalam diri kami, Tuhan, kerendahan hati,
Tenang, namun dalam dan sejati.
Itulah permata yang hanya dapat diajarkan oleh pencobaan.
Tuhan, melalui semua ini, jadikanlah kami semakin serupa dengan-Mu!

Kiranya mata kami tertuju kepada-Mu, Bapa,
Bukan kepada badai dahsyat ini.
Sebab Engkau telah melalui air yang dalam ini,
Hanya yang Engkau rencanakanlah yang akan terlaksana.

Taat bahkan sampai mati, Tuhan,
Betapapun besarnya harga yang harus dibayar.
Berilah kami pandangan akan harta surgawi,
Yang nilainya tak mungkin dilampaui oleh harga duniawi.

–Oleh Adrianna H. Fanton
