Note de la rédaction : Nombre de nos lecteurs seront peut-être d’abord convaincus que ce sujet ne les concerne pas. Si c’est le cas, nous nous en réjouissons avec vous. Toutefois, avant de simplement passer cet article, nous encourageons le lecteur à lire attentivement ce qui suit, puis à commencer à poser des questions à sa famille, à ses amis et à ses connaissances. Nous entendons dire que la jeune génération, en particulier, est attirée par des événements organisés par des organismes chrétiens indépendants (tels que des concerts, des séminaires, des écoles bibliques, etc.) ou par des services spéciaux dans des églises voisines, qui comportent ce type de contenu à des degrés divers. Les groupes et concerts de musique spéciale, le ventriloquisme, les films religieux et les saynètes y occupent une place particulièrement importante. Nous souhaitons sensibiliser à cette question et susciter une discussion à ce sujet.

Le théâtre religieux — qu’est-ce que c’est ?

Récit sérieux interprété par des acteurs qui jouent ou imitent un dialogue donné de manière théâtrale, ou événement de la vie réelle comportant des effets émotionnels caractéristiques d’une pièce, le tout inspiré d’un thème religieux. (American Heritage College Dictionary)

Est-ce un sujet de préoccupation pour l’Église ? Cela devrait l’être. Cela semble généralement commencer par des services prolongés de « prière et louange » entre l’école du dimanche et le culte. Ou lors de services spéciaux autres que ceux du dimanche matin. Cela peut inclure des présentations instrumentales, des spectacles de marionnettes, des saynètes, des pièces, des danses et des films religieux.

Le théâtre religieux n’est pas nouveau. Il a été introduit au Moyen Âge (400 à 1200 apr. J.-C.) sous la forme de représentations dramatiques à thème religieux appelées « mystères ». Ces pièces devinrent si corrompues que l’Église catholique tenta d’y mettre fin, mais sans succès. En 1242, le mystère de la Passion, représentation de la mort du Christ, vit le jour en Allemagne et continue d’être joué dans le monde entier aujourd’hui.

Une observation intéressante, lorsque nous regardons le passé, est que le théâtre religieux fut introduit pendant la période la plus sombre de l’histoire (le Moyen Âge), mais que l’Église sortit de cette longue ère de déchéance morale grâce à la prédication anabaptiste, centrée sur la Bible et la Nouvelle Alliance, remplie de l’Esprit, lors du réveil de la Réforme.

I. Pourquoi le théâtre viole le véritable culte

a. Le théâtre viole le principe de l’écoute.

Dans le monde spirituel, voir n’est pas aussi important qu’entendre (2 Corinthiens 4:18). Les mots entendre, entend et entendu se trouvent plus de 1 000 fois dans la Bible. En fait, toute la Bible est Dieu qui parle à l’homme. Il veut que l’humanité entende ! « Ainsi parle le Seigneur » est une formule récurrente dans toute l’Écriture.

Sur le mont Sinaï (Exode 19:9), le peuple entendit le message de Dieu par l’intermédiaire de son porte-parole, Moïse. La voix de Dieu lui faisait peur (Exode 20:18-19), mais il était essentiel de l’entendre afin qu’il « ne pèche pas ». Dans Exode 20, Dieu donna des instructions détaillées sur la manière dont le culte devait se dérouler. Tu ne feras point avec moi de dieux d’argent, et tu ne te feras point de dieux d’or –Exode 20:23. Ces aides visuelles (idoles) violaient la loi de Dieu concernant l’écoute. C’est par les yeux que vient la tentation de fabriquer des idoles. Les autels que Dieu autorisait devaient être simples et non taillés (vss. 24-25). Ce qu’ils voyaient ne devait pas détourner leur attention de ce qu’ils entendaient depuis l’autel ! Ce qui est vu, en particulier l’indécence, tend à détourner l’attention de ce qui est entendu (v. 26).

La prédication de Jésus faisait appel à l’écoute : Que celui qui a des oreilles pour entendre entende –Matthieu 13:9. Bien qu’il n’ait pas utilisé d’aides visuelles comme le font les prédicateurs aujourd’hui, Jésus utilisait des aides verbales (des paraboles) pour faire appel à l’écoute (Matthieu 13:18).

Sur la montagne de la Transfiguration (Matthieu 17), Pierre voulait réinventer le culte en construisant trois abris. Il voulait avoir quelque chose à voir ! Mais la voix qui venait des nuées rappela aux disciples l’importance d’écouter (v. 5). Dieu n’approuve pas le culte avec des aides visuelles !

Jésus dit : En vérité, en vérité, je vous le dis, celui qui entend ma parole et croit à celui qui m’a envoyé a la vie éternelle… L’heure vient, et elle est déjà venue, où les morts entendront la voix du Fils de Dieu ; et ceux qui l’auront entendue vivront. Jean 5:24-25. Le salut vient par l’écoute de la Parole de Dieu, mais seulement lorsque l’on croit ce que l’on entend !

Paul pose des questions qui donnent à réfléchir : Comment donc invoqueront-ils celui en qui ils n’ont pas cru ? Et comment croiront-ils en celui dont ils n’ont pas entendu parler ? Et comment en entendront-ils parler, s’il n’y a personne qui prêche ? –Romains 10:14. Il répond lui-même à ses questions : Ainsi la foi vient de ce qu’on entend, et ce qu’on entend vient de la parole de Dieu –Romains 10:17. Selon la loi de Dieu, on fait l’expérience du salut soit en entendant la Parole de Dieu, soit en la lisant !

Dans les 2e et 3e chapitres de l’Apocalypse, Jésus répète sept fois : « Que celui qui a des oreilles entende. » Le théâtre religieux est superficiel, car il fait appel à la partie psychique de l’homme, et non à sa partie spirituelle. La partie psychique de l’homme (les émotions) peut passer un très bon moment tandis que son esprit reste intact et indifférent. Satan se sert des yeux pour détourner l’homme des véritables problèmes de son cœur.

Hébreux 11:6 nous dit : « La foi est une ferme assurance des choses qu’on espère, une démonstration de celles qu’on ne voit pas. » La vraie foi vient au cœur humain par l’écoute, et non par la démonstration. Par conséquent, le théâtre religieux frôle l’opposition au Christ, car il va à l’encontre de la loi de Dieu concernant l’écoute.

b. Le théâtre viole la sincérité.

Les Écritures enseignent l’importance de la sincérité dans tous les domaines de la vie (1 Corinthiens 5:8 ; 2 Corinthiens 1:12, 2:17 ; Philippiens 1:10). Pour préserver notre sincérité, il est important que chacun reconnaisse que Dieu nous a créés comme des individus uniques (Psaume 139:14-15). Nous ne sommes pas et ne pouvons pas être quelqu’un d’autre ! Essayer d’être quelqu’un d’autre viole notre individualité unique. Et, ce faisant, on devient insincère.

Quel est le rapport avec le théâtre religieux ? Le théâtre implique de jouer la comédie. Jésus eut des différends constants avec les pharisiens. Ils jouaient constamment la comédie, ou prétendaient être ce qu’ils n’étaient pas. Jésus les traita à maintes reprises d’hypocrites. Le mot grec d’origine signifie « acteur ».

La seule motivation des pharisiens à prier en public était d’être vus des hommes (Matthieu 6:5-7). Ils étaient conscients de leur public, et donc de leur prestation. Jésus indiqua très clairement que la piété devait s’exprimer dans l’intimité, dans « ta chambre ». Lorsqu’une personne qui manifeste sa piété se préoccupe davantage de sa prestation que de son message, elle ne rend plus un culte : elle donne un spectacle ! Cela peut arriver aux prédicateurs, aux quatuors, aux chorales, etc. Les « marches de prière » relèvent généralement elles aussi de cette même catégorie de comédie.

Lorsqu’une personne fait du jeu d’acteur une habitude, elle devient hypocrite. Elle porte atteinte à sa propre âme, car elle abîme son individualité, que Dieu lui a donnée.

Jésus qualifia sept fois les pharisiens d’hypocrites dans Matthieu 23. Il leur dit qu’ils étaient des morts ambulants (Matthieu 23:27-28). Ils avaient joué la comédie si longtemps qu’ils ne distinguaient plus le réel de l’irréel !

Cette tromperie explique en partie pourquoi les acteurs professionnels deviennent si extrémistes sur les questions de la vie. Dans leur profession, ils se détachent de plus en plus de la vérité, de la sincérité et de la réalité. Sur des sujets comme l’écologie, les droits des animaux, l’avortement, les droits des homosexuels et le réchauffement climatique, beaucoup ont adopté des positions déconnectées des fondements de la vérité et ne sont plus sincères.

Prétendre prier ou adorer, ou incarner des personnages bibliques dans une pièce, n’est pas seulement insincère, mais frôle le sacrilège. Imaginez prétendre être Jésus dans une pièce ! Prétendre être Jésus est blasphématoire, car aucun chrétien n’a jamais approché sa perfection ! Ou bien, que dire du fait de prétendre être le diable ? Pourquoi, je vous le demande, une personne qui suit sincèrement les enseignements de Jésus voudrait-elle incarner le mal ? A. W. Tozer conclut : « Le jeu d’acteur constitue une grave contradiction morale, puisqu’il met le mensonge au service de la vérité. »

Le théâtre religieux, ceux qui s’y impliquent et, à vrai dire, ceux qui approuvent l’hypocrisie même que Jésus a condamnée, sont des imposteurs. Le Saint-Esprit n’honore ni la prétention ni le cabotinage !

Si des multitudes suivirent Jésus, c’est que sa sincérité était si rafraîchissante en comparaison du jeu de comédie permanent des pharisiens.

II. Raisons pratiques pour lesquelles le théâtre religieux est une menace

a. Le théâtre religieux démoralise le respect dû à Dieu.

Une personne qui prétend être Jésus-Christ ou tout autre personnage biblique érode son respect pour le Seigneur. À force de jouer la comédie, sa crainte de Dieu s’éteint lentement en elle. Après tout, si une personne peut prétendre être l’égale du Christ, pourquoi respecter un être supérieur ? Les pharisiens ne soupçonnaient même pas qu’ils étaient des morts ambulants (Matthieu 23:27).

b. Le théâtre religieux associe le culte au monde du spectacle.

Hollywood a clairement démontré que le monde du spectacle ne peut pas produire de valeurs morales conformes à Dieu. Faire jouer à un homme et à une femme le rôle de mari et de femme détruit le caractère sacré du mariage. Le monde du spectacle approuve également des pratiques de fréquentation amoureuse qui violent les normes bibliques de pureté. Le monde du spectacle est devenu la référence en matière de normes morales dans la société d’aujourd’hui, et beaucoup suivent ce modèle impie.

c. Le théâtre religieux ne satisfait pas l’homme intérieur.

Lorsque les sens d’une personne sont stimulés par le spectacle extérieur, ses émotions recherchent sans cesse une nouvelle exaltation et une autre expérience de culte agréable. Cela suscite en elle le désir de voir encore un autre spectacle, plus satisfaisant que le précédent. Les émotions s’amusent, mais l’homme intérieur est affamé et dépérit lentement, car le cœur et l’esprit n’ont pas été nourris d’une véritable substance.

d. Le théâtre religieux ruine le prédicateur.

Le théâtre est l’ami du prédicateur paresseux. Il n’a plus besoin de : Étudie pour te présenter devant Dieu comme un homme éprouvé… –2 Timothée 2:15. Il ne faut aucune onction du Saint-Esprit pour remplacer le sermon par une pièce. Au lieu d’ordonner aux hommes d’être « la lumière du monde », il leur demande : « Veuillez baisser les lumières ! » Lorsque le projecteur remplace le prophète, le principal moyen par lequel l’homme peut trouver le salut disparaît (1 Corinthiens 1:21).

« Tant que le prédicateur peut se rabattre sur le divertissement, la pression qui forme les prédicateurs fera défaut. L’habitude et le rythme qui caractérisent la grande prédication manqueront à leur ministère. » –A. W. Tozer.

L’usage du théâtre religieux condamnera le prédicateur à la médiocrité ! La menace à laquelle nous faisons face aujourd’hui, c’est qu’à mesure que le théâtre religieux se multiplie, les réveils envoyés du ciel qui ont marqué le passé disparaîtront.

e. Le véritable culte sera considéré comme inférieur.

En utilisant le théâtre dans un service de culte, les Églises apprennent aux jeunes à penser que le véritable culte n’est qu’une forme de divertissement inférieure parmi d’autres. Lorsque le culte et le théâtre sont fusionnés, le culte est réduit au plus petit dénominateur commun. Le danger est que la prochaine génération ne sache pas ce qu’est le véritable culte !

III. Les formes du véritable culte

a. La prière

La prière est un vaste sujet, une forme de culte qui demeure trop souvent inexploitée. Dans la vie de l’assemblée, la prière publique est comprimée par les contraintes de temps que nous nous imposons.

Dans l’Église primitive, les prières publiques suivaient un modèle régulier dans les pratiques de culte. Il y eut des prières publiques immédiatement après l’ascension du Christ (Actes 1:14) et lors de la première ordination (Actes 1:24). Et ils persévéraient … dans les prières –Actes 2:42. Il n’y avait aucun esprit d’apathie ! Les réunions de prière étaient un outil d’évangélisation, un moyen d’inculquer la crainte de Dieu et un puissant facteur d’unité pour toute l’Église (Actes 2:41-44).

Pierre et Jean assistèrent à une réunion de prière en milieu d’après-midi (Actes 3:1). (Dis donc, frère en la foi, quand as-tu assisté pour la dernière fois à une réunion de prière en milieu d’après-midi ?) Leur réunion de prière eut des effets sismiques (Actes 4:31) ! La puissance et la présence du Saint-Esprit dans nos cultes produisent des résultats !

La présence aux réunions de prière n’était pas une option mensuelle ou bimensuelle (Actes 6:4) ! Lorsque Pierre était en prison, ils organisèrent volontairement une chaîne de prière, jour et nuit (Actes 12:5). Ils imposèrent les mains à leurs missionnaires et prièrent pour eux (Actes 13:3). Ils se réunirent au bord de la rivière pour prier (Actes 16:13). Remarquez bien : ce rassemblement au bord de la rivière n’avait pas pour but de pratiquer quelque sport nautique que ce soit ; c’était une réunion de prière ! Ils se réunirent là où …on avait coutume de faire la prière… –Actes 16:13. Ils comprenaient que, partout où des chrétiens se retrouvaient, il était normal de prier ensemble.

b. La prédication

La prédication est une forme de culte qui remonte à l’époque de Jonas (Jonas 3:2) et de Moïse (Actes 15:21). Dans l’Ancien Testament, la prédication était le moyen choisi par Dieu pour communiquer sa volonté à l’homme. Lorsque Jésus entra en scène, …[il] vint en Galilée, prêchant l’Évangile du royaume de Dieu –Marc 1:14. Il utilisa la même forme de culte. Jésus se servait de paraboles comme illustrations verbales (et non visuelles), qui captaient l’attention de ses auditeurs.

Vers la fin de son ministère, Jésus étendit la prédication comme forme de culte aux générations futures et à toutes les cultures du monde : …Allez dans le monde entier, et prêchez l’Évangile à toute créature –Marc 16:15.

Paul fut appelé à prêcher l’Évangile (1 Corinthiens 1:17-21). La prédication ne devait pas être embellie par l’ingéniosité humaine. Il a plu à Dieu d’utiliser la folie et la simplicité de la prédication pour apporter le salut à ceux qui osaient croire. Pour cette raison, la prédication doit être le point central de chaque service de culte. Les services de louange, les concerts et les spectacles musicaux dérobent du temps qui devrait plutôt être consacré à écouter une prédication inspirée par le Saint-Esprit. Lorsque le théâtre religieux sert à présenter la vérité, il contourne le moyen ordonné par Dieu pour apporter à l’homme le message du salut.

Heureux celui qui lit et ceux qui entendent les paroles de cette prophétie, et qui gardent les choses qui y sont écrites… –Apocalypse 1:3. Le moyen de communication de Dieu est la Parole écrite ou parlée. Pas une image ! Pas une pièce ! Pas un spectacle !

c. Le chant

Le Nouveau Testament ne donne aucun indice de l’existence de chanteurs professionnels, de chorales ou de prestations musicales. Un chant qui a du sens exige la participation de tous et une implication réfléchie de l’esprit (1 Corinthiens 14:15). Le contexte implique clairement que le culte ou le chant n’est pas seulement une expérience individuelle ; il édifie toutes les personnes présentes. Les solistes, qui ont tendance à s’exalter eux-mêmes, empêchent le reste de l’assemblée de prendre part à une expérience de culte communautaire.

Que la parole du Christ habite en vous abondamment, en toute sagesse ; instruisez-vous et exhortez-vous les uns les autres par des psaumes, des hymnes et des cantiques spirituels, chantant à Dieu dans vos cœurs avec reconnaissance –Colossiens 3:16. Les cantiques spirituels touchent le cœur, tandis que les chants psychiques font bouger les pieds et les émotions. Nous chantons « pour le Seigneur ». La prédication va de Dieu vers l’homme, tandis que le chant va de l’homme vers Dieu et exprime la louange, l’adoration, l’honneur et la reconnaissance. Le chant est destiné au culte, et non au divertissement.

Entretenez-vous par des psaumes, des hymnes et des cantiques spirituels, chantant et célébrant le Seigneur de tout votre cœur –Éphésiens 5:19. Le chant rempli de l’Esprit apporte édification mutuelle, inspiration et encouragement. La participation au chant a le pouvoir de répondre à des besoins profonds, là où d’autres méthodes échouent. « Célébrer le Seigneur de tout votre cœur » signifie que le cœur accompagne le chant. Les instruments extérieurs tendent à mettre l’accent sur les capacités d’une personne plutôt que sur son cœur. Si nos chants ne sont pas accompagnés de notre cœur, ils deviennent un autre spectacle de culte pharisien.

Le culte de l’Ancien Testament était agréé par Dieu ; néanmoins, il était aussi ritualisé, avec des sacrifices d’animaux, des encensements, des instruments de musique et des danses devant le Seigneur. Le culte du Nouveau Testament est toutefois très différent. Jésus nous enseigne que nous …devons l’adorer en esprit et en vérité –Jean 4:24. L’esprit du culte remplace les rituels. Lorsque nous passons de formes de culte intérieures à des formes extérieures, nous violons l’« esprit » du culte du Nouveau Testament. Notre culte ne doit pas être stimulé par des éléments extérieurs, mais plutôt par le Saint-Esprit (Éphésiens 5:18).

IV. L’essence du véritable culte

Lorsque Jésus rencontra la femme au puits, elle exprima sa préoccupation au sujet du changement dans la forme du culte (Jean 4:20). Elle se souciait de la manière dont ses pères avaient adoré. Autrement dit : « Nous avons toujours fait comme ça ! » Chaque génération de fidèles doit se garder d’un culte formaliste.

Deux attitudes nuisent au véritable culte :

  • Formaliste – s’habituer tellement à faire les choses comme nous les avons toujours faites que nous finissons par accomplir les gestes machinalement et par perdre de vue celui que nous adorons.
  • Nonchalante – devenir tellement indifférent à toute forme de culte que celui qui est adoré finit par être occulté par l’indifférence.

Les deux styles de culte, formaliste et nonchalant, ont un problème fondamental commun : le manque de révérence envers Dieu !

Les pères de la femme au puits avaient perdu à la fois le point de mire et la notion du culte : « Vous adorez ce que vous ne connaissez pas » (Jean 4:22a). Jésus indiqua clairement que le culte n’est pas irréfléchi : « Nous, nous adorons ce que nous connaissons » (4:22b). Le véritable culte fait appel à notre esprit et à notre intelligence. Le véritable culte apporte quelque chose : « Le salut vient de Jésus » (4:22c). Il transforme la vie !

Le lieu du culte n’est pas aussi important que l’attitude (Jean 4:23). L’accent que met Jésus ne porte pas sur la cérémonie extérieure, mais sur l’état de l’esprit et du cœur.

Dieu est Esprit ; et il faut que ceux qui l’adorent l’adorent en esprit et en vérité –Jean 4:24. Remarquez le mot « faut » ! Le seul culte acceptable est celui qui est rendu en esprit et en vérité. Notre attitude doit être en harmonie avec l’Esprit de Dieu. Le véritable culte implique aussi notre réponse à la vérité. Si notre esprit ne répond pas à la vérité, nous n’adorons pas ! Si notre pensée est ailleurs, ou occupée par autre chose, notre culte n’est qu’un rituel froid et mort !

Conclusion

À la lumière des principes de l’Écriture, il est clair que le théâtre religieux n’est pas le moyen choisi par Dieu pour faire naître la foi et la vie dans l’âme humaine !

Le modèle du véritable culte dans le Nouveau Testament consiste à se réunir pour écouter la prédication de la Parole, prier ensemble et les uns pour les autres, et chanter des chants, des hymnes et des cantiques spirituels.

La tentation d’introduire de nouvelles choses dans le culte est bien réelle aujourd’hui. Jésus nous appelle à adorer en esprit et en vérité. Lorsque chacun de nous fait sincèrement sa part pour que les services de culte restent profonds et spirituels, cela réduit la tentation de réintroduire le formalisme (« la manière dont nos pères adoraient ») ou d’introduire la désinvolture (toute nouvelle forme de culte irrévérencieux).

Ouvrages cités

La Bible — version King James.

The Vance Havner Quotebook, Dennis J. Hester, Grand Rapids : Baker Book House, 1986.

The night was still, the air was drear.

A man walked alone; his direction unclear.

A battle raged within his troubled soul.

He was at the crossroads, all his life as a whole.

He believed in God, or at least so he thought.

He obeyed what he knew—all that he’d been taught.

But something’s not right, there’s something I lack.

I’ve lived like most others, as my life plays back.

But I go to church! I sing and I pray!

I even helped the neighbor, just the other day!

He fought with his mind, justifying the wrong.

It was God that was working, He seemed quite strong.

The fact of the matter, it’s confidence I lack.

I believe in myself, not the God from way back.

God wants to show strong, in my life every day.

He wants me to be proved; He’s the Life and the Way.

There’s no better One, in Whom to put all your trust;

Than the almighty God. For all men it’s a must!

–by Barry Grant

“Dr. Waldron,” the woman said to me as I prepared to leave the exam room. “I have one more question. How can I lose this extra weight?”

I sighed inaudibly as I sat down to discuss the situation with her. Dealing with weight gain is not the sort of thing that is easy to tack onto the end of an office visit and there have been many lengthy books written on the subject.

Americans seem to struggle with this. They spend an average of 33 billion dollars on weight loss products every year and 65 percent of Americans are either overweight or obese.

The whole discussion is a challenging one. We want a quick fix—to take a pill or add in a fat-burning food or do a simple exercise that will melt the extra weight away simply and quickly. The reality is that while we gain weight quite easily, it is much more difficult to lose that same weight. Maintaining weight loss is harder yet.

In the Beginning

We don’t know much about life before the fall in Genesis 3. We do know that …God saw every thing that he had made, and, behold, it was very good… –Genesis 1:31.

It is safe to assume that Adam and Eve did not struggle with their weight before sin entered the world. They were created perfectly which meant that they would not have struggled with metabolism issues. They also did not have the uncontrolled appetites for food that their descendants deal with today.

Two things happened with the fall of man in the Garden of Eden. First, humans started to have physical ailments—their bodies did not work as well as they did before. Adam and Eve were still able to live much longer lives than humans today, but metabolic diseases and other illnesses began to develop. The second thing that happened was that they began to have a sin nature.

Those two things have led to a lot of problems… Among them are metabolism and weight issues.

What the Bible Says About Food

Our bodies need to eat nutritious food—without eating they would deteriorate and eventually die. There is nothing better for a man, than that he should eat and drink, and that he should make his soul enjoy good in his labour. This also I saw, that it was from the hand of God –Ecclesiastes 2:24.

The Old Testament law was restrictive regarding what the Jewish people could eat. Under Kosher Law, the number of clean animals was far outweighed by the numbers of unclean animals. More than that, the book of Proverbs mentions several times that overeating is dangerous. Be not among winebibbers; among riotous eaters of flesh: For the drunkard and the glutton shall come to poverty: and drowsiness shall clothe a man with rags –Proverbs 23:20-21.

From the New Testament we find the early church no longer required Gentile Christians to follow Jewish laws regarding their diets. The Jerusalem council specifically required …that they abstain from pollutions of idols, and from fornication, and from things strangled, and from blood –Acts 15:20. Otherwise, it seems that they were free to eat whatever they wanted.

What did not change in the New Testament was the idea of self-control. The Fruit of the Spirit lists temperance as one of the things Christians should have and Paul made it clear that he was focused on controlling his desires, lest he become a castaway (see 1 Corinthians 9:27).

What? know ye not that your body is the temple of the Holy Ghost which is in you, which ye have of God, and ye are not your own? For ye are bought with a price: therefore glorify God in your body, and in your spirit, which are God’s –1 Corinthians 6:19-20.

Know ye not that ye are the temple of God, and that the Spirit of God dwelleth in you? If any man defile the temple of God, him shall God destroy; for the temple of God is holy, which temple ye are –1 Corinthians 3:16-17.

Scripture is clear that Christians should take care of their bodies, put their desires under the control of God, and avoid things that have anything to do with idolatry.

Reasons People Gain Weight

It is easy to break down reasons for weight gain into two big categories:

  1. problems with metabolism
  2. problems with excessive calories.

When we think about metabolic issues, these include things like thyroid problems and diabetes. These disorders affect the rate at which our bodies burn calories. One of the main ways we have to increase our metabolism is to increase our activity levels, particularly exercise that increases the heart rate—cardiovascular exercise.

Excess calories mainly come from overeating. It is important to remember that people eat for lots of reasons other than because they are hungry. People eat because they are bored, lonely, sad, and yes, sometimes because they are hungry. Some medications, particularly steroids, can increase appetite and negatively affect the metabolic rate.

We call the number of calories our bodies burn while at rest, the body’s metabolic rate. There are a couple of different formulas used to calculate our basal metabolic rates. They use height, weight, age, and gender to determine how many calories your body will burn in an average day. There are a few applications and websites that will do this calculation for you. https://www.active.com/fitness/calculators/bmr The important thing to know is that this is the number of calories you should consume to maintain your current body weight. Eat fewer calories than this number and you will tend to lose weight, take in more calories than this number and you will gain weight.

Is Weight Important?

From a medical standpoint, being overweight is associated with several different things. It tends to increase insulin resistance and it can lead to diabetes. It increases blood pressure. It can lead to obstructive sleep apnea, and it worsens arthritis in the back and legs.

Being overweight is not necessarily an indication of a spiritual problem and depending on a person’s genetics, it can be difficult to get it where it should be according to the charts. Even though most people feel much better when they are close to their ideal weight, Scripture does not indicate that there is a specific weight or body mass index (BMI) that Christians should not go over.

The important thing is that our lives are to be under the control of God if we have yielded ourselves, appetites, and all, to Him. We should try to be healthy in order that we can best participate in Kingdom building. More than that, we should attempt to set an example for others of a life that is yielded to God.

Myths About Weight Loss…

There are many things that people believe about weight loss. We will look at a list of things which people repeat. While there may be a grain of truth in them, they are not completely true and may discourage activities that can help a person who is struggling with his weight.

…Vigorous exercise is the only way to lose weight.

Many people believe that the reason that they can’t lose weight is because they can’t do enough exercise. They struggle with pain, arthritis, or some heart or lung condition that makes them unable to do vigorous athletic endeavors.

Maybe they know someone who took up running and lost a bunch of weight and that seems like the right way to do it. They just don’t feel able to take that path and feel hopeless about the whole endeavor.

Exercise is important. Most medical societies recommend that people exercise at least 150 minutes a week. While exercise does boost our metabolism and helps our hearts and lungs, it still may not change a person’s weight very much.

Most people burn between 200 and 300 calories with a half hour of exercise. While this may sound like a lot, a body must burn 3500 calories to lose one pound. In addition, most of us are hungrier after we exercise, and it is awfully easy to eat an extra 200 calories that basically negates whatever was burned during the exercise time.

…Carbohydrates make you gain weight.

Carbohydrate is the medical term for sugars. The calories we consume in our diets come from one of three sources: carbohydrates, fats, and proteins. Carbohydrates are present in desserts, but they are also present in many starchy foods like rice, corn, pasta, bread, and lots of other things.

There are several diets, like the Atkins Diet and the Keto Diet, that push those who follow them to cut out as many carbohydrates as possible. People often do lose weight on these sorts of diets. Unfortunately, these diets are difficult to maintain long term as they are quite restrictive.

The healthiest thing is to eat carbohydrates moderately and steer towards the healthier options. Using whole grains and more complex carbohydrates is important. A bowl of oatmeal may have a similar number of grams of carbohydrates as compared to a sugary breakfast cereal, but it will be broken down more slowly by our bodies and is easier for them to deal with.

…Starvation is the only way to lose weight.

Starvation does result in weight loss—there were no heavy-set people who came out of the concentration camps in World War II. This certainly is not the only way to lose weight, nor is it a healthy way to lose weight.

We know that when people starve for extended periods of time, they will begin to lose muscle mass, their bones will get weaker, and their metabolism will decrease. Most people who starve themselves will end up regaining all of the weight they lost within a few years and because their metabolism has been downgraded, in the long run it will be harder for them to keep weight off.

…You just need to eat ‘___’ fat burning food to lose weight!

I specifically left the food blank above because it seems that this is always changing. Maybe you’ve read that Greek yogurt, or cinnamon, or goji berry juice will help you lose weight. Studies indicate that there is no magic food that will melt fat away.

If these foods work, it is because you have replaced something unhealthy and rich in calories with something healthier. For example, if your normal breakfast consists of 5 strips of bacon, a glass of orange juice, 2 slices of toast, and two eggs and you replace that with a glass of water and a bowl of oatmeal, you will probably lose weight. It is not because the oatmeal is “burning fat,” but rather that it has significantly fewer calories than the breakfast you were eating before.

Some foods have almost no calories and probably take as much energy to eat and digest as humans get from them. Celery, iceberg lettuce, and mushrooms all fall into this category. The problem is that if you put peanut butter on the celery, salad dressing on the lettuce, and fry the mushrooms in butter or oil, then suddenly they aren’t the low-calorie foods they purport to be. We humans are very good at fixing low-cal foods so that they both taste better and are no longer low-calorie.

…Fat free and diet foods are the key to weight loss.

There are many foods and condiments on the market that have reduced fat and claim to be lower calorie than the normal versions of themselves. These often have a lot of different chemicals and sugar substitutes in them to get the taste and texture as similar to the regular versions as possible.

Sugar substitutes seem to be healthier than sugar when used moderately, but they also seem to encourage people to crave sweeter foods. Studies have linked artificial sweeteners with the onset of glucose intolerance—something that could lead to diabetes. https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC3095502/ Dieticians seem to think that of the various sugar substitutes, Stevia is the safest.

All in all, our goal should not be to try to eat all the same foods, just with fewer calories, but rather to eat a variety of healthy foods and moderate-sized portions. This is what will lead to a better metabolism and not simply getting reduced fat versions of our favorite foods.

…The solution is diet pills.

Over time I have seen many people take medications and supplements, both prescription and over the counter varieties, to try to help them lose weight. These medications and supplements are supposed to do a number of things—reduce appetite and increase the metabolic rate are several of these.

They often work in the short term. People lose quite a bit of weight in the first few weeks and think that they have conquered their struggles. The problem is that over time, they usually get used to whatever it is that they are taking, their appetite returns, and their metabolism goes back to normal.

While these sorts of solutions may give short-term help, being healthy in the long term, means figuring out a healthy eating plan and exercise schedule, then sticking with it long term. The goal should never be simply to “take off ten pounds,” but rather to be as healthy as possible.

We’ve covered a lot of things not to do and probably reading between the lines you can see some of the things that are helpful to do as well. A second part (Lord willing) will be coming with the next issue to discuss positive things that we can do to achieve a healthy weight.

With all of this, it is important to remember that our goal is not about achieving some sort of earthly beauty. The aim, rather, is to treat our body as the Temple of the Holy Ghost (1 Corinthians 6:19). I have heard this verse used to explain why we shouldn’t drink, smoke, or get tattoos, but we need to treat it with respect when it comes to eating and exercise, as well.

As we care for our bodies, we will be better able to meet the needs of the people around us and we will be prepared to meet whatever plan God has for our lives.

“Dkt. Waldron,” yule mwanamke aliniambia nilipokuwa nikijiandaa kuondoka kwenye chumba cha uchunguzi. “Nina swali moja zaidi. Ninawezaje kupunguza uzito huu wa ziada?”

Niliguna kimyakimya nilipoketi ili kuzungumza naye kuhusu hali hiyo. Kushughulikia ongezeko la uzito si jambo rahisi kuliongezea mwishoni mwa ziara ya kliniki, na vitabu vingi virefu vimeandikwa kuhusu mada hii.

Inaonekana Wamarekani wanakabiliana na tatizo hili. Hutumia wastani wa dola bilioni 33 kila mwaka kununua bidhaa za kupunguza uzito, na asilimia 65 ya Wamarekani wana uzito uliozidi au ni wanene kupita kiasi.

Mjadala mzima ni wenye changamoto. Tunataka suluhisho la haraka—kumeza kidonge, kuongeza chakula kinachochoma mafuta, au kufanya zoezi rahisi litakaloyeyusha uzito wa ziada kwa urahisi na haraka. Ukweli ni kwamba ingawa tunaongezeka uzito kwa urahisi, ni vigumu zaidi kupunguza uzito huo huo. Kudumisha uzito uliopungua ni vigumu zaidi bado.

Hapo Mwanzo

Hatujui mengi kuhusu maisha kabla ya anguko katika Mwanzo 3. Tunajua kwamba …Mungu akaona kila kitu alichokifanya, na tazama, kilikuwa chema sana… –Mwanzo 1:31.

Ni salama kudhani kwamba Adamu na Hawa hawakuhangaika na uzito wao kabla dhambi haijaingia ulimwenguni. Waliumbwa wakamilifu, jambo lililomaanisha kwamba wasingekuwa na matatizo ya kimetaboliki. Pia hawakuwa na hamu ya chakula isiyodhibitika ambayo wazao wao hukabiliana nayo leo.

Mambo mawili yalitokea wakati wa anguko la mwanadamu katika Bustani ya Edeni. Kwanza, wanadamu walianza kupata maradhi ya kimwili—miili yao haikufanya kazi vizuri kama ilivyokuwa awali. Adamu na Hawa bado waliweza kuishi maisha marefu zaidi kuliko wanadamu wa leo, lakini magonjwa ya kimetaboliki na maradhi mengine yakaanza kutokea. Jambo la pili lililotokea ni kwamba wakaanza kuwa na asili ya dhambi.

Mambo hayo mawili yamesababisha matatizo mengi… Miongoni mwao ni matatizo ya kimetaboliki na uzito.

Biblia Inasema Nini Kuhusu Chakula

Miili yetu inahitaji kula chakula chenye virutubisho—bila kula, ingedhoofika na hatimaye kufa. Hakuna jambo lililo bora zaidi kwa mwanadamu kuliko kula na kunywa, na kuifanya nafsi yake ifurahie mema katika kazi yake. Hili pia niliona kwamba lilitoka mkononi mwa Mungu –Mhubiri 2:24.

Sheria ya Agano la Kale ilikuwa na vizuizi kuhusu kile ambacho Wayahudi wangeweza kula. Chini ya sheria za vyakula vya Kosheri, idadi ya wanyama walio safi ilizidiwa sana na idadi ya wanyama walio najisi. Zaidi ya hayo, kitabu cha Mithali kinataja mara kadhaa kwamba kula kupita kiasi ni hatari. Usiwe miongoni mwa walevi wa divai, wala miongoni mwa walafi wa nyama: Kwa maana mlevi na mlafi wataingia katika umaskini, na usingizi utamvika mtu matambara –Mithali 23:20-21.

Katika Agano Jipya tunaona kwamba kanisa la kwanza halikuwataka tena Wakristo wa Mataifa kufuata sheria za Kiyahudi kuhusu vyakula vyao. Baraza la Yerusalemu lilitaka hasa …waepuke uchafuzi wa sanamu, na uasherati, na vitu vilivyosongwa koo, na damu –Matendo 15:20. La sivyo, inaonekana walikuwa huru kula chochote walichotaka.

Kilichobaki bila kubadilika katika Agano Jipya ni wazo la kujizuia. Orodha ya Tunda la Roho inataja kiasi kuwa mojawapo ya mambo ambayo Wakristo wanapaswa kuwa nayo, na Paulo aliweka wazi kwamba alijitahidi kudhibiti tamaa zake, asije akawa mtu aliyekataliwa (tazama 1 Wakorintho 9:27).

Hamjui ya kuwa miili yenu ni hekalu la Roho Mtakatifu aliye ndani yenu, mliyepewa na Mungu, nanyi si mali yenu wenyewe? Maana mlinunuliwa kwa bei; basi, mtukuzeni Mungu katika miili yenu na katika roho zenu, ambazo ni za Mungu –1 Wakorintho 6:19-20.

Hamjui ya kuwa ninyi ni hekalu la Mungu, na ya kuwa Roho wa Mungu anakaa ndani yenu? Mtu akiliharibu hekalu la Mungu, Mungu atamharibu; kwa maana hekalu la Mungu ni takatifu, ambalo ndilo ninyi –1 Wakorintho 3:16-17.

Maandiko yako wazi kwamba Wakristo wanapaswa kutunza miili yao, kuweka tamaa zao chini ya utawala wa Mungu, na kuepuka mambo yoyote yanayohusiana na ibada ya sanamu.

Sababu Zinazowafanya Watu Waongezeke Uzito

Ni rahisi kugawa sababu za kuongezeka uzito katika makundi mawili makubwa:

  1. matatizo ya kimetaboliki
  2. matatizo ya kalori nyingi kupita kiasi.

Tunapofikiria matatizo ya kimetaboliki, haya yanajumuisha mambo kama matatizo ya tezi na kisukari. Matatizo haya huathiri kasi ambayo miili yetu huchoma kalori. Mojawapo ya njia kuu tulizonazo za kuongeza kimetaboliki ni kuongeza kiwango cha shughuli zetu, hasa mazoezi yanayoongeza mapigo ya moyo—mazoezi ya moyo na mishipa ya damu.

Kalori za ziada hutokana hasa na kula kupita kiasi. Ni muhimu kukumbuka kwamba watu hula kwa sababu nyingi zaidi ya kuwa na njaa. Watu hula kwa sababu wamechoshwa, wako wapweke, wana huzuni, na ndiyo, wakati mwingine kwa sababu wana njaa. Baadhi ya dawa, hasa steroidi, zinaweza kuongeza hamu ya kula na kuathiri vibaya kiwango cha kimetaboliki.

Tunaita idadi ya kalori ambazo miili yetu huchoma tukiwa tumepumzika kiwango cha kimetaboliki cha mwili. Kuna fomula kadhaa tofauti zinazotumiwa kukokotoa viwango vyetu vya kimetaboliki ya msingi. Hutumia urefu, uzito, umri na jinsia kuamua ni kalori ngapi mwili wako utatumia kwa siku ya wastani. Kuna programu na tovuti kadhaa zitakazokufanyia hesabu hii. https://www.active.com/fitness/calculators/bmr Jambo muhimu la kujua ni kwamba hii ndiyo idadi ya kalori unayopaswa kutumia ili kudumisha uzito wako wa sasa. Kula kalori chache kuliko idadi hii na kwa kawaida utapunguza uzito; tumia kalori nyingi zaidi ya idadi hii na utaongezeka uzito.

Je, Uzito Ni Muhimu?

Kwa mtazamo wa kitabibu, kuwa na uzito uliozidi kunahusishwa na mambo kadhaa tofauti. Huelekea kuongeza usugu wa insulini na kunaweza kusababisha kisukari. Huongeza shinikizo la damu. Kunaweza kusababisha tatizo la kukosa pumzi usingizini kutokana na kuziba kwa njia ya hewa, na huzidisha ugonjwa wa yabisi kwenye mgongo na miguu.

Kuwa na uzito uliozidi si lazima kuwe ishara ya tatizo la kiroho, na kulingana na vinasaba vya mtu, inaweza kuwa vigumu kuufikisha mahali unapopaswa kuwa kulingana na chati. Ingawa watu wengi huhisi vizuri zaidi wanapokuwa karibu na uzito wao bora, Maandiko hayaonyeshi kuwa kuna uzito maalumu au fahirisi ya uzito wa mwili (BMI) ambayo Wakristo hawapaswi kuizidi.

Jambo muhimu ni kwamba maisha yetu yanapaswa kuwa chini ya utawala wa Mungu ikiwa tumejikabidhi kwake sisi wenyewe, pamoja na hamu zetu. Tunapaswa kujitahidi kuwa na afya njema ili tuweze kushiriki kadiri tuwezavyo katika kuujenga Ufalme. Zaidi ya hayo, tunapaswa kujaribu kuwa mfano kwa wengine wa maisha yaliyojitoa kwa Mungu.

Imani Potofu Kuhusu Kupunguza Uzito…

Kuna mambo mengi ambayo watu huamini kuhusu kupunguza uzito. Tutaangalia orodha ya mambo ambayo watu hurudia. Ingawa huenda yakawa na chembe ya ukweli, si kweli kabisa na yanaweza kukatisha tamaa watu wasifanye mambo yanayoweza kumsaidia mtu anayehangaika na uzito wake.

…Mazoezi makali ndiyo njia pekee ya kupunguza uzito.

Watu wengi huamini kwamba sababu hawawezi kupunguza uzito ni kwa kuwa hawawezi kufanya mazoezi ya kutosha. Wanahangaika na maumivu, ugonjwa wa yabisi, au tatizo fulani la moyo au mapafu linalowafanya washindwe kufanya shughuli kali za riadha.

Huenda wanamfahamu mtu aliyeanza kukimbia na kupunguza uzito mwingi, na hilo linaonekana kuwa njia sahihi ya kufanya hivyo. Hawajihisi tu kuwa na uwezo wa kufuata njia hiyo, na wanakata tamaa kuhusu juhudi yote hiyo.

Mazoezi ni muhimu. Mashirika mengi ya kitabibu hupendekeza watu wafanye mazoezi angalau dakika 150 kwa wiki. Ingawa mazoezi huongeza kimetaboliki yetu na kusaidia moyo na mapafu yetu, huenda bado yasibadilishe sana uzito wa mtu.

Watu wengi hutumia kati ya kalori 200 na 300 kwa kufanya mazoezi kwa nusu saa. Ingawa huenda hii ikaonekana kuwa nyingi, mwili lazima utumie kalori 3500 ili kupunguza pauni moja. Isitoshe, wengi wetu huwa na njaa zaidi baada ya kufanya mazoezi, na ni rahisi sana kula kalori 200 za ziada ambazo kimsingi hufuta kalori zozote zilizotumika wakati wa mazoezi.

…Wanga hukufanya uongezeke uzito.

Wanga ni neno la kitabibu linalomaanisha sukari. Kalori tunazotumia katika vyakula vyetu hutokana na mojawapo ya vyanzo vitatu: wanga, mafuta na protini. Wanga hupatikana kwenye vitindamlo, lakini pia hupatikana katika vyakula vingi vya wanga kama vile wali, mahindi, tambi, mkate na vitu vingine vingi.

Kuna mipango kadhaa ya ulaji, kama vile Mpango wa Atkins na Mpango wa Keto, inayowahimiza wanaoifuata kupunguza wanga kadiri iwezekanavyo. Mara nyingi watu hupunguza uzito kwa kufuata mipango hii ya ulaji. Kwa bahati mbaya, mipango hii ni vigumu kuifuata kwa muda mrefu kwa kuwa ina vizuizi vingi.

Jambo lenye afya zaidi ni kula wanga kwa kiasi na kuelekea kwenye chaguo zenye afya zaidi. Ni muhimu kutumia nafaka zisizokobolewa na wanga changamano zaidi. Bakuli la uji wa shayiri linaweza kuwa na idadi sawa ya gramu za wanga na nafaka za kiamsha kinywa zenye sukari, lakini mwili wetu huuvunjavunja polepole zaidi na ni rahisi zaidi kuushughulikia.

…Kujinyima chakula ndiyo njia pekee ya kupunguza uzito.

Kujinyima chakula kwa kweli husababisha kupungua kwa uzito—hakukuwa na watu wanene waliotoka katika kambi za mateso wakati wa Vita vya Pili vya Dunia. Kwa hakika hii si njia pekee ya kupunguza uzito, wala si njia yenye afya ya kupunguza uzito.

Tunajua kwamba watu wanapokaa kwa muda mrefu bila chakula, misuli yao huanza kupungua, mifupa yao hudhoofika, na kimetaboliki yao hupungua. Watu wengi wanaojinyima chakula huishia kurejesha uzito wote waliopunguza ndani ya miaka michache, na kwa sababu kimetaboliki yao imepungua, hatimaye itakuwa vigumu zaidi kwao kuzuia uzito usiongezeke tena.

…Unahitaji tu kula chakula ‘___’ kinachochoma mafuta ili kupunguza uzito!

Niliacha nafasi ya chakula hapo juu kwa makusudi kwa sababu inaonekana kwamba jambo hili hubadilika kila wakati. Huenda umesoma kwamba mtindi wa Kigiriki, mdalasini, au juisi ya tunda la goji itakusaidia kupunguza uzito. Tafiti zinaonyesha kwamba hakuna chakula cha kimiujiza kitakachoyeyusha mafuta.

Ikiwa vyakula hivi vinafaa, ni kwa sababu umebadilisha kitu kisicho na afya na chenye kalori nyingi kwa kitu chenye afya zaidi. Kwa mfano, ikiwa kiamsha kinywa chako cha kawaida kina vipande 5 vya nyama ya bekoni, glasi moja ya juisi ya machungwa, vipande 2 vya mkate uliokaangwa, na mayai mawili, kisha ukabadilisha hayo kwa glasi ya maji na bakuli la uji wa shayiri, huenda utapunguza uzito. Si kwa sababu uji wa shayiri “unachoma mafuta,” bali kwa kuwa una kalori chache zaidi kwa kiasi kikubwa kuliko kiamsha kinywa ulichokuwa ukila awali.

Baadhi ya vyakula vina kalori chache sana, na huenda vinahitaji nishati nyingi kuliwa na kumeng’enywa kama ile ambayo wanadamu huipata kutokana navyo. Selari, lettusi ya kichwa na uyoga vyote vimo katika kundi hili. Tatizo ni kwamba ukiweka siagi ya karanga kwenye selari, mchuzi wa saladi kwenye lettusi, na kukaanga uyoga katika siagi au mafuta, basi ghafla havitakuwa tena vyakula vyenye kalori chache kama vinavyodaiwa. Sisi wanadamu ni hodari sana wa kurekebisha vyakula vyenye kalori chache ili viwe na ladha nzuri zaidi na visiwe tena na kalori chache.

…Vyakula visivyo na mafuta na vyakula vya lishe ndiyo ufunguo wa kupunguza uzito.

Kuna vyakula na viungo vingi sokoni vyenye mafuta yaliyopunguzwa na vinavyodai kuwa na kalori chache kuliko matoleo yake ya kawaida. Mara nyingi huwa na kemikali na vibadala vya sukari vya aina nyingi ili ladha na umbile vifanane kadiri iwezekanavyo na matoleo ya kawaida.

Vibadala vya sukari vinaonekana kuwa na afya zaidi kuliko sukari vinapotumiwa kwa kiasi, lakini pia vinaonekana kuwafanya watu watamani vyakula vitamu zaidi. Tafiti zimehusisha vitamu bandia na kuanza kwa kutovumilia glukosi—jambo linaloweza kusababisha kisukari. https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC3095502/ Wataalamu wa lishe wanaonekana kufikiri kwamba kati ya vibadala mbalimbali vya sukari, Stevia ndicho salama zaidi.

Kwa ujumla, lengo letu halipaswi kuwa kujaribu kula vyakula vilevile vyote, ila vyenye kalori chache tu, bali kula vyakula mbalimbali vyenye afya na sehemu za chakula za wastani. Hili ndilo litakalowezesha kimetaboliki kuwa bora zaidi, wala si kupata tu matoleo yenye mafuta yaliyopunguzwa ya vyakula tunavyovipenda.

…Suluhisho ni vidonge vya kupunguza uzito.

Kwa miaka mingi nimewaona watu wengi wakitumia dawa na virutubisho, vya kuandikiwa na vya kununuliwa bila agizo la daktari, ili kujaribu kuwasaidia kupunguza uzito. Dawa na virutubisho hivi vinapaswa kufanya mambo mbalimbali—kupunguza hamu ya kula na kuongeza kiwango cha kimetaboliki ni baadhi yake.

Mara nyingi hufanya kazi kwa muda mfupi. Watu hupunguza uzito mwingi katika majuma machache ya kwanza na kufikiri kwamba wameshinda matatizo yao. Tatizo ni kwamba baada ya muda, kwa kawaida miili yao huizoea dawa au kirutubisho wanachotumia, hamu yao ya kula hurudi, na kimetaboliki yao hurudia hali ya kawaida.

Ingawa suluhisho za aina hii zinaweza kutoa msaada wa muda mfupi, kuwa na afya njema kwa muda mrefu kunamaanisha kubuni mpango mzuri wa ulaji na ratiba ya mazoezi, kisha kuendelea nayo kwa muda mrefu. Lengo halipaswi kamwe kuwa tu “kupunguza pauni kumi,” bali kuwa na afya njema kadiri iwezekanavyo.

Tumezungumzia mambo mengi ambayo hayapaswi kufanywa, na huenda ukisoma kwa makini utaona baadhi ya mambo yanayofaa kufanywa pia. Sehemu ya pili (Mungu akipenda) itakuja katika toleo lijalo ili kujadili mambo chanya tunayoweza kufanya ili kufikia uzito wenye afya.

Pamoja na mambo haya yote, ni muhimu kukumbuka kwamba lengo letu si kufikia aina fulani ya urembo wa kidunia. Lengo, badala yake, ni kuuchukulia mwili wetu kama Hekalu la Roho Mtakatifu (1 Wakorintho 6:19). Nimesikia mstari huu ukitumiwa kueleza kwa nini hatupaswi kunywa pombe, kuvuta sigara, au kujichora tattoo, lakini tunapaswa kuuheshimu pia linapokuja suala la kula na kufanya mazoezi.

Tunapotunza miili yetu, tutaweza vizuri zaidi kukidhi mahitaji ya watu wanaotuzunguka, na tutakuwa tayari kutimiza mpango wowote ambao Mungu anao kwa ajili ya maisha yetu.

There He was, the King Himself, standing before Pilate, awaiting His death sentence. A large crowd had gathered outside. There was no mistaking it, these people were angry. They wanted this man, Jesus of Nazareth, dead. “Crucify him! Crucify him!” was all that could be heard. This man must have done something terrible. But who were these people that were so angry at the Son of God? Maybe they were rapists, thieves, and murderers. Possibly they were the local liars, drunks, or some other evildoers. Actually, they were the religious people, the church goers, the ones claiming to be God’s people.

Ever since that infamous day, history has repeated itself. People claiming to be God’s people have seen those who love Jesus and try to follow His teachings as their enemies and have persecuted them any way they could. From the Jews, to the Roman Catholics, to the Protestants, the mainstream church of the day has always been the enemy of those who try to govern their everyday lives by the simple clarity of the Scriptures.

I am concerned that we have signed a deal with the mainstream church of our day—a deal for peace at all costs.

Any Scripture that teaches rebuke, reproof, or correction is considered out-of-date and is not allowed to be used to help shape the faith and practice of today’s Christian. Many individuals, church leaders, and even whole churches have begun to believe that love and acceptance alone is a better way to point others to Christ. Those who would raise a voice of warning are seen to be critical and stirring unrest, so they are quickly silenced.

As we search the Scriptures, we see that Jesus, then the disciples, then the early church, had nothing good to say or think about the false church.

While out witnessing or talking to people about the Lord, I’m amazed at the backlash from the mainstream church of our day. Mainly, the Protestant church.

A simple man walked up to a Christian concert holding a sign reading ‘Jesus saves from sin’. Without him ever saying a word, he was attacked. “Quit judging us!” “You don’t know our hearts!” “You’re a disgrace!” “Bigot!” The man slowly walked away.

Many times, the people who get angry when discussions involving God come up are actually folks who claim to know Jesus. The sinners seem to let the message penetrate their hearts. If you were to go to an intersection in a city and simply hold a sign proclaiming something about Christ, you would soon see that this is true.

As I was standing in line at a fast-food restaurant, I noticed that the young man preparing my sandwich had many interesting tattoos. Some were of tombstones, skulls, and other graphic designs. I calmly asked him if he could explain what the tattoos meant to him. He began going into detail about each one. I then asked the young man if he knew Jesus. He got sober and explained that he wanted to believe in God but couldn’t. I quoted a few Bible verses and told him that God was waiting for him. I noticed that God’s Word was having a great effect on the young man.

Meanwhile, I also noticed that the lady behind me was beginning to get frustrated. Finally, she interrupted our conversation and told the man, “Jesus loves you just the way you are. You don’t have to change for this man.” This lady later told me what church she went to and how judgmental she thought that I had acted. I was amazed. I had only told the young man about the Savior!

Before I left the restaurant, I walked back over to the young man to bid him farewell. As I approached, he looked up with tears in his eyes. “Thank you”, he said “I can tell that you truly care about me. I will go home and really think about what you said.”

That night, as I reflected on the day’s events, I wondered why that professing Christian woman had such a problem with my interaction with the young man. Why did she get so angry? I felt like the Lord gave me an answer: No man can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon –Matthew 6:24.

She was a nice young lady. And, yes, she professed that she was a Christian, but she clearly did not live a life that was in obedience to God’s Word. Rather, outside of going to church, one would not be able to tell at all that she was a follower of Christ. I’m sure if I would have met her at the park, we could have had a nice chat. I’m sure she would have been courteous and polite. I’m sure she would have presented herself as a good citizen and nice person. But when it came to being excited about Jesus, sharing the gospel, and talking about God’s Word, her true colors came out.

Am I saying that a person must be an Anabaptist to make it to heaven? Absolutely not, but I am saying we must obey the Bible and follow Christ to make it to heaven. Most professing Christians are super nice and seem godly, until you start talking about God.

Since when has the definition of a Christian been ‘a nice person’, or ‘a good citizen’? Is that all there is to it anymore—simply do what you want, find a fun church that doesn’t require anything from you, get a good job, get married, have a few children and just like that you’re a ‘Christian’? God help us!

When He was having a discussion with a group of people about whether or not they were true followers of God, Jesus said, …If ye were Abraham’s children, ye would do the works of Abraham. But now ye seek to kill me, a man that hath told you the truth … Ye do the deeds of your father … Ye are of your father the devil… –John 8:39-44.

Has the true church slipped so far as to not be able to call things as they are? God’s Word gives us clear understanding on the matter: Proving what is acceptable unto the Lord. And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather reprove them. For it is a shame even to speak of those things which are done of them in secret. But all things that are reproved are made manifest by the light: for whatsoever doth make manifest is light –Ephesians 5:10-13.

Jesus says Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid –Matthew 5:14. Do we expose sin and heresy in the same way that light exposes darkness? Or are we too attached to a comfortable life with no enemies? We do not need to be scared of the world, or of the false church, because we know that we have what they need! For years the mainstream churches have been getting farther and farther away from the truth of God’s Word. Are we afraid to recognize this? Are we afraid to separate ourselves from this? Will we stand up against it like the early church did?

There is a reason why the Protestant reformer, Martin Luther, died hating the Anabaptist people—because they rejected his interpretation of the Scriptures. The Anabaptist people were not respecters of people. Rather their only respect was for God and His Word, and that without compromise. It was for this that they were persecuted. It would have been much easier for those godly young men to just be quiet and try to get along with the Catholics and Protestants, but they refused and both groups sought to extinguish them. Still, they lived on, trusting only in their God. When we joined the church of Jesus Christ didn’t we promise to continue fighting the same fight—the same fight that Jesus fought; the same fight the early church fought—the fight against the false church? Or have we agreed to get along, for the sake of peace? After all isn’t it better for business, for friendships, and for reputation?! God forbid!

We can live a life that seems to be without sin, but still be living in disobedience. The Bible calls us to action! We are called to be lights, to be witnesses, to pursue godliness, and to live uprightly, not just to put on a good show. I believe this is what has become popular in our day. Lying, cheating, stealing, and killing are attributes that even the world rejects. It’s the ‘in thing’ to be respectable, to make a nice living, and to be upstanding citizens. But is this the life of a born-again believer? Should we fit in with the American dream? Should the only thing that’s different between us and the Protestant church be a head covering? I think we should prayerfully consider this move, the move to join hands with the mainstream church.

I personally know many Protestant Christians. I’m not trying to say they are bad people; many are good folks. But that is not what we are talking about. I believe we need to draw a line and slow down this draw to join them in any compromising manner. Let’s look at just a few of the differences between the Protestants and Anabaptists.

War

Can you believe in war, killing your enemies, and still be a New Testament Christian? Most Protestants are supporters of fighting for our freedoms and our rights. Many will go as far as calling Anabaptist people cowards for not fighting.

Years ago, a group of professing Christians gathered around the biggest bomb ever made. This bomb was about to be sent into a foreign land to destroy an entire city; this bomb was meant to kill everything in its path. Men, women, and children alike would perish because of this bomb; that was the plan. As this group was gathered around this bomb they began to pray, they asked God’s blessing on this bombing mission. They then thanked Him for its success—killing nearly one quarter of a million souls.

Jesus calls us to love our enemies. This topic clearly separated the churches during the various wars. Most of the ‘Christian’ churches in the world supported the war effort of their country. The Anabaptists would not, and they were sorely persecuted for it. So, can we be a Christian and continue to support war? If we support war, where will it stop? Will we also prepare to defend ourselves and our families against violence and lawlessness? The American church calls ‘defending ourselves’, our families, and our country, heroism or bravery; the Bible calls it.

Entertainment

It seems that most Christians in America have no problem watching as many ballgames and sports events as they desire. Movies and television are found in nearly every home. Going to the beach, casinos, and festivals are commonplace. Spending thousands on big hunting trips and expensive vacations is completed without a second thought. To be honest, there really are no limits to what the Christian in America can do, as long as it seems right to them. Jesus tells us multiple times to deny ourselves. It seems that we look for any loophole possible to indulge in all the self-gratifying activities we want! It’s no wonder the church is struggling with pornography and many other sins of the flesh. When we learn how to deny ourselves, pick up the cross, and follow Jesus, then we will start to see a clear, distinct, and large separation between us and the mainstream church of our day.

Non-conformity

It is common to conform to one’s surroundings. This is one reason we don’t send our children to public schools. Jesus is also very clear that we need to come out from among them and be separate, to say “No” to evil communication and the ways of this world, and to not be afraid of identifying ourselves with the people of God. It almost seems that dress is really the only thing that separates many of us, and that is changing also.

Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him. For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father, but is of the world –1 John 2:15-16. Where are the people that hate the world? Where are the people that want to be as separated as possible? Where are the people that are not afraid to be laughed at? Where are the people that are not afraid to be different? Oh, where are God’s people?! If history repeats itself, there will soon be no difference between the church and the world. Oh, where are the men?!

I’ve heard many Anabaptist people say they can’t say that those in the worldly church are not Christians; they just don’t want to go in that direction. Is that truthful? Is that the message we want to send to our youth, and to our children? I don’t believe so. The Bible says that few will make it. If we pass on to our children that the Protestant church is also ok, and that they just do things differently, we are destroying everything that Jesus preached. We are saying that we do what we do, not because the Bible says, but rather we decide what we do based on our circumstances and what others around us think! No wonder our children are more interested in the modern church of today than ever before—there’s no line drawn!

There was a modern church that caught my attention. They seemed to be on fire for the Lord! The pastor preached as a dying man. They were very interested in reaching the lost. But there were so many Bible teachings that they simply ignored! I finally took it to the Lord. “What is going on here God!” It was as if God told me to ‘just wait’.

Soon after that, the pastor was released from his position because he was having an affair. Then it all became clear to me—you can have a nice church, you can preach a good message, and you can help the poor, but if you’re not willing to obey ALL of the New Testament teachings, you’re not a true Christian, and you will not find victory. It’s easy to take Christianity so far, but it is not easy to sell all that you have, put your all on the altar, and follow your Master. I know this is bold, but it is the truth of God’s Word.

I was speaking to a young lady in a Protestant setting, who wanted to give her life to the Lord. She was ready to do what it took, or so she said. I asked her if she was ready to suffer for Jesus, if she was ready to separate herself from her old friends, if she was ready to be hated by the world, and ready to be different. I asked her if she was willing to change how she looked. It didn’t take long before she shockingly responded with an emphatic “No!” “I want to start going to church, but not all that other stuff.” I later noticed her with her friends pointing and laughing at me. Being cool does not define a true Christian but being rejected for the sake of the Gospel does.

This is a tough article to write. It’s not a popular message and not very encouraging. But I think it’s a message we must consider today, not only for our sake, but for our children’s sake, and that of the church of tomorrow. We must draw clear lines of separation, without any compromise. We must honestly evaluate the modern church of our day with the clear teachings of the New Testament. We must call sin, sin. We must call disobedience, sin. We must call compromise, sin. We must once again choose to suffer with the true people of God. This does not mean that we shun people or act distasteful towards them, but with love in our hearts, and a message on our lips, we point the masses to Christ!

For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ: for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth; to the Jew first, and also to the Greek –Romans 1:16.

거기에는 왕이신 그분께서 친히 빌라도 앞에 서서 사형 선고를 기다리고 계셨습니다. 밖에는 큰 무리가 모여 있었습니다. 의심의 여지가 없었습니다. 사람들은 화가 나 있었습니다. 그들은 이 사람, 나사렛 예수를 죽이기를 원했습니다. “그를 십자가에 못 박으라! 십자가에 못 박으라!” 하는 소리만 들렸습니다. 이 사람은 분명 끔찍한 일을 저질렀을 것입니다. 그런데 하나님의 아들에게 그렇게 화를 내던 사람들은 누구였을까요? 강간범이나 도둑, 살인자였을지도 모릅니다. 동네의 거짓말쟁이나 술꾼, 혹은 다른 악인들이었을 수도 있습니다. 사실 그들은 종교적인 사람들이었고, 교회에 다니는 사람들이었으며, 하나님의 백성이라고 주장하는 사람들이었습니다.

그 악명 높은 날 이후로 역사는 되풀이되어 왔습니다. 하나님의 백성이라고 주장하는 사람들은 예수님을 사랑하고 그분의 가르침을 따르려는 이들을 적으로 여기고, 할 수 있는 온갖 방법으로 박해했습니다. 유대인들로부터 로마 가톨릭교도들, 개신교도들에 이르기까지, 그 시대의 주류 교회는 일상생활을 성경의 단순하고 명료한 말씀에 따라 다스리려는 이들의 적이었습니다.

우리가 오늘날의 주류 교회와 어떤 대가를 치르더라도 평화를 지키자는 거래를 맺은 것은 아닌지 염려됩니다.

책망과 꾸지람, 교정을 가르치는 성경 말씀은 시대에 뒤떨어진 것으로 여겨져 오늘날 그리스도인의 믿음과 실천을 형성하는 데 쓰이지 못하게 됩니다. 많은 개인과 교회 지도자, 심지어 교회 전체가 사랑과 수용만으로도 다른 이들을 그리스도께 인도하는 더 나은 길이라고 믿기 시작했습니다. 경고의 목소리를 내려는 이들은 비판적이고 소란을 일으킨다고 여겨져 재빨리 입을 다물게 됩니다.

성경을 살펴보면 예수님도, 제자들도, 초대 교회도 거짓 교회에 대해 좋은 말을 하거나 좋은 생각을 품지 않았음을 알 수 있습니다.

주님에 대해 사람들에게 전하거나 이야기하러 나갈 때면, 오늘날의 주류 교회, 특히 개신교 교회에서 거센 반발이 나오는 것을 보고 놀랍니다.

한 평범한 남자가 “예수님은 죄에서 구원하십니다”라고 적힌 팻말을 들고 기독교 음악 공연장에 걸어갔습니다. 그는 한마디도 하지 않았는데 공격을 받았습니다. “우리를 판단하지 마세요!” “당신은 우리 마음을 모르잖아요!” “정말 수치스럽네요!” “편협한 사람!” 그 남자는 천천히 자리를 떠났습니다.

하나님에 관한 이야기가 나오면 화를 내는 사람들은 예수님을 안다고 주장하는 이들인 경우가 많습니다. 죄인들은 오히려 그 메시지가 마음에 스며들도록 두는 듯합니다. 도시의 교차로에 가서 그리스도에 관한 내용을 선포하는 팻말을 들고 있기만 해도 곧 이것이 사실임을 알게 될 것입니다.

패스트푸드점에서 줄을 서 있는데, 제 샌드위치를 만들던 젊은 남자에게 흥미로운 문신이 많이 있는 것이 눈에 띄었습니다. 묘비와 해골, 그 밖의 섬뜩한 그림들이 그려져 있었습니다. 저는 차분하게 그 문신들이 자신에게 어떤 의미인지 설명해 줄 수 있느냐고 물었습니다. 그는 각각에 대해 자세히 설명하기 시작했습니다. 이어서 그 젊은이에게 예수님을 아느냐고 물었습니다. 그는 차분해지더니 하나님을 믿고 싶지만 믿을 수 없다고 설명했습니다. 저는 성경 구절을 몇 구절 인용하고 하나님께서 그를 기다리고 계신다고 말했습니다. 하나님의 말씀이 그 젊은이에게 큰 영향을 주고 있음을 알 수 있었습니다.

한편 제 뒤에 있던 여자가 점점 답답해하는 것도 눈에 띄었습니다. 마침내 그녀는 우리 대화에 끼어들어 그 남자에게 말했습니다. “예수님은 지금 모습 그대로 당신을 사랑하세요. 이 사람 때문에 변할 필요는 없어요.” 나중에 그 여자는 자신이 어느 교회에 다니는지 말하며 제가 얼마나 판단하는 태도를 보였다고 생각하는지 알려주었습니다. 저는 놀랐습니다. 저는 그 젊은이에게 구주에 관해 말했을 뿐이었습니다!

식당을 떠나기 전에 그 젊은이에게 다시 가서 작별 인사를 했습니다. 제가 다가가자 그는 눈물을 글썽이며 고개를 들었습니다. “고맙습니다.” 그가 말했습니다. “정말 저를 염려해 주신다는 걸 알 수 있어요. 집에 가서 하신 말씀을 정말 곰곰이 생각해 볼게요.”

그날 밤 그날의 일을 되새기며, 그리스도인이라고 고백하는 그 여자가 왜 제가 그 젊은이와 나눈 대화를 그토록 문제 삼았는지 궁금했습니다. 왜 그렇게 화를 냈을까요? 주님께서 제게 답을 주신 것 같았습니다. 한 사람이 두 주인을 섬기지 못할 것이니, 혹 이를 미워하고 저를 사랑하거나 혹 이를 붙들고 저를 업신여길 것이라. 너희가 하나님과 재물을 겸하여 섬기지 못하느니라 –마태복음 6:24.

그녀는 좋은 젊은 여성이었습니다. 그리고 그렇습니다. 그녀는 자신이 그리스도인이라고 고백했지만, 분명 하나님의 말씀에 순종하는 삶을 살지는 않았습니다. 교회에 가는 것 말고는 그녀가 그리스도를 따르는 사람이라는 사실을 전혀 알아차릴 수 없었을 것입니다. 공원에서 그녀를 만났다면 즐겁게 대화를 나눌 수 있었으리라고 확신합니다. 그녀는 예의 바르고 공손했을 것입니다. 훌륭한 시민이자 좋은 사람으로 자신을 보였을 것입니다. 그러나 예수님을 향한 열정과 복음 전파, 하나님의 말씀에 관한 이야기가 나오자 그녀의 본색이 드러났습니다.

천국에 가려면 재세례파 신자가 되어야 한다는 말인가요? 절대 아닙니다. 하지만 천국에 가려면 성경에 순종하고 그리스도를 따라야 한다고 말하는 것입니다. 그리스도인이라고 고백하는 사람들 대부분은 아주 친절하고 경건해 보입니다. 하나님에 관해 이야기하기 시작하기 전까지는 말입니다.

그리스도인의 정의가 ‘좋은 사람’이나 ‘훌륭한 시민’이 된 것은 언제부터입니까? 이제 그게 전부란 말인가요? 하고 싶은 대로 하고, 아무것도 요구하지 않는 재미있는 교회를 찾아다니고, 좋은 직장을 얻고, 결혼하고, 아이를 몇 명 낳으면 그저 그렇게 ‘그리스도인’이 되는 것입니까? 하나님, 우리를 도와주소서!

예수님께서 자신들이 하나님의 참된 추종자인지에 관해 한 무리의 사람들과 이야기하실 때 이렇게 말씀하셨습니다. …너희가 아브라함의 자손이면 아브라함이 행한 일들을 할 것이거늘. 이제 너희가 진리를 너희에게 말한 사람인 나를 죽이려 하는도다 … 너희는 너희 아비의 행위를 하는도다 … 너희는 너희 아비 마귀에게서 났으니… –요한복음 8:39-44.

참된 교회가 사태를 있는 그대로 말하지 못할 만큼 멀리 벗어나 버린 것일까요? 이 문제에 관해 하나님의 말씀은 분명히 알려 줍니다. 주께 기쁘시게 할 것이 무엇인가 시험하여 보라. 너희는 열매 없는 어둠의 일에 참여하지 말고 도리어 책망하라. 그들이 은밀히 행하는 것들은 말하기도 부끄러운 것들이라. 그러나 책망을 받는 모든 것은 빛으로 드러나나니 드러나게 하는 것마다 빛이니라 –에베소서 5:10-13.

예수님께서 말씀하십니다. 너희는 세상의 빛이라. 산 위에 있는 동네가 숨겨지지 못할 것이요 –마태복음 5:14. 빛이 어둠을 드러내듯 우리도 죄와 이단을 드러내고 있습니까? 아니면 적 없이 편안한 삶에 지나치게 집착하고 있습니까? 우리는 세상이나 거짓 교회를 두려워할 필요가 없습니다. 그들에게 필요한 것을 우리가 가지고 있음을 알기 때문입니다! 주류 교회들은 여러 해 동안 하나님의 말씀의 진리에서 점점 더 멀어져 왔습니다. 우리는 이것을 인정하기를 두려워합니까? 이것과 분리되기를 두려워합니까? 초대 교회처럼 이에 맞서 설 것입니까?

개신교 종교개혁자 마르틴 루터가 재세례파 사람들을 미워한 채 세상을 떠난 데에는 이유가 있습니다. 그들이 그의 성경 해석을 거부했기 때문입니다. 재세례파 사람들은 사람을 봐주지 않았습니다. 그들이 존중한 것은 오직 하나님과 그분의 말씀이었으며, 타협은 없었습니다. 바로 그 때문에 그들은 박해를 받았습니다. 그 경건한 젊은이들이 조용히 입을 다물고 가톨릭교도들과 개신교도들과 잘 지내려 했다면 훨씬 쉬웠을 것입니다. 그러나 그들은 거부했고, 양쪽 집단 모두 그들을 없애려 했습니다. 그럼에도 그들은 오직 하나님만 신뢰하며 살아남았습니다. 예수 그리스도의 교회에 들어왔을 때 우리도 같은 싸움을 계속하겠다고 약속하지 않았습니까? 예수님께서 싸우신 싸움, 초대 교회가 싸운 싸움, 곧 거짓 교회에 맞선 싸움을 말입니다. 아니면 평화를 위해 잘 지내기로 합의했습니까? 결국 그게 사업에도, 우정에도, 평판에도 더 낫지 않습니까?! 하나님께서 금하시기를 바랍니다!

죄가 없는 듯한 삶을 살면서도 불순종 가운데 살 수 있습니다. 성경은 우리에게 행동하라고 부릅니다! 우리는 단지 그럴듯한 모습을 보이는 것이 아니라 빛이 되고, 증인이 되고, 경건을 추구하며, 올바르게 살도록 부름받았습니다. 저는 오늘날 이것이 유행이 되었다고 생각합니다. 거짓말하고, 속이고, 훔치고, 죽이는 일은 세상 사람들조차 거부하는 태도입니다. 존경받을 만하고, 넉넉히 벌고, 훌륭한 시민이 되는 것이 ‘요즘 대세’입니다. 하지만 이것이 거듭난 신자의 삶입니까? 우리는 아메리칸드림에 부합해야 합니까? 우리와 개신교 교회의 차이라고는 머리 덮개 하나뿐이어야 합니까? 주류 교회와 손잡으려는 이 움직임을 기도하며 숙고해야 한다고 생각합니다.

저는 개신교 그리스도인들을 많이 알고 있습니다. 그들이 나쁜 사람들이라고 말하려는 것이 아닙니다. 좋은 사람들도 많습니다. 하지만 지금 우리가 이야기하는 것은 그것이 아닙니다. 우리는 분명한 선을 긋고, 어떤 식으로든 타협하며 그들에게 합류하려는 흐름을 늦춰야 한다고 믿습니다. 개신교도와 재세례파 사이의 차이 가운데 몇 가지만 살펴봅시다.

전쟁

전쟁을 믿고 적을 죽이면서도 신약의 그리스도인일 수 있다고 생각하십니까? 대부분의 개신교도는 우리의 자유와 권리를 위해 싸우는 것을 지지합니다. 많은 이들은 싸우지 않는 재세례파 사람들을 겁쟁이라고까지 부릅니다.

여러 해 전, 그리스도인이라고 고백하는 한 무리가 지금까지 만들어진 것 가운데 가장 큰 폭탄 주위에 모였습니다. 그 폭탄은 한 도시 전체를 파괴하기 위해 외국 땅으로 보내지려 하고 있었습니다. 그 폭탄은 가는 길에 있는 모든 것을 죽이려는 것이었습니다. 남녀노소 할 것 없이 모두 그 폭탄 때문에 목숨을 잃을 예정이었습니다. 그것이 계획이었습니다. 이 무리가 폭탄 주위에 모여 기도하기 시작했고, 폭격 임무에 하나님의 복을 내려 달라고 구했습니다. 그런 다음 그들은 거의 25만 명의 목숨을 앗아간 그 임무가 성공한 것을 두고 하나님께 감사를 드렸습니다.

예수님은 원수를 사랑하라고 부르십니다. 이 문제는 여러 전쟁 중 교회들을 분명히 갈라놓았습니다. 세계의 ‘기독교’ 교회 대부분은 자기 나라의 전쟁 노력을 지지했습니다. 재세례파는 그렇게 하지 않았고, 그 때문에 심한 박해를 받았습니다. 그러니 전쟁을 계속 지지하면서도 그리스도인일 수 있습니까? 전쟁을 지지한다면 어디서 멈추겠습니까? 폭력과 무법으로부터 자신과 가족을 지킬 준비도 해야 할까요? 미국 교회는 자신과 가족, 나라를 ‘방어하는 것’을 영웅적 행위나 용기라고 부릅니다. 성경은 그것을 부릅니다.

오락

미국의 그리스도인 대부분은 원하는 만큼 많은 야구 경기와 스포츠 행사를 보는 데 아무런 문제가 없는 듯합니다. 거의 모든 집에서 영화와 텔레비전을 볼 수 있습니다. 해변이나 카지노, 축제에 가는 것도 흔한 일입니다. 큰 사냥 여행과 값비싼 휴가에 수천 달러를 쓰면서도 조금도 망설이지 않습니다. 솔직히 말해, 미국의 그리스도인이 자신에게 옳아 보이기만 하면 할 수 없는 일에는 사실상 한계가 없습니다. 예수님은 여러 번 자신을 부인하라고 말씀하십니다. 그런데도 우리는 원하는 자기만족적인 활동을 마음껏 즐길 수 있도록 어떻게든 빠져나갈 구멍을 찾는 듯합니다! 교회가 음란물과 그 밖의 육체의 죄로 어려움을 겪는 것도 놀랄 일이 아닙니다. 자신을 부인하고, 십자가를 지고, 예수님을 따르는 법을 배울 때 비로소 우리와 오늘날의 주류 교회 사이에 분명하고 뚜렷하며 큰 분리가 나타나기 시작할 것입니다.

세상과 일치하지 않음

주변 환경에 맞춰 살아가는 것은 흔한 일입니다. 이것이 우리가 자녀들을 공립학교에 보내지 않는 이유 가운데 하나입니다. 예수님은 그들 가운데서 나와 분리되어야 하고, 악한 교제와 세상의 방식을 거부하며, 하나님의 백성과 자신을 동일시하기를 두려워하지 말아야 한다고도 매우 분명히 말씀하십니다. 우리 가운데 많은 이들을 구별해 주는 것은 옷차림뿐인 것처럼 보이며, 그것마저도 변하고 있습니다.

이 세상이나 세상에 있는 것들을 사랑하지 말라. 누구든지 세상을 사랑하면 아버지의 사랑이 그 안에 있지 아니하니, 이는 세상에 있는 모든 것 곧 육신의 정욕과 안목의 정욕과 이생의 자랑이 다 아버지께로부터 온 것이 아니요 세상으로부터 온 것이기 때문이라 –요한일서 2:15-16. 세상을 미워하는 사람들은 어디에 있습니까? 가능한 한 세상과 분리되기를 원하는 사람들은 어디에 있습니까? 조롱받기를 두려워하지 않는 사람들은 어디에 있습니까? 남들과 다르기를 두려워하지 않는 사람들은 어디에 있습니까? 아, 하나님의 백성은 어디에 있습니까?! 역사가 되풀이된다면 머지않아 교회와 세상 사이에는 차이가 없게 될 것입니다. 아, 남자들은 어디에 있습니까?!

세상적인 교회에 다니는 사람들이 그리스도인이 아니라고 말할 수는 없고, 다만 그 방향으로 가고 싶지 않을 뿐이라고 말하는 재세례파 사람들을 많이 들었습니다. 그것이 진실한 말입니까? 그것이 우리가 청소년과 자녀들에게 전하고 싶은 메시지입니까? 저는 그렇지 않다고 생각합니다. 성경은 구원받을 사람이 적다고 말합니다. 개신교 교회도 괜찮고 그저 다르게 할 뿐이라고 자녀들에게 전한다면, 우리는 예수님께서 전하신 모든 것을 무너뜨리는 것입니다. 우리가 그렇게 하는 이유는 성경이 그렇게 말하기 때문이 아니라, 우리의 상황과 주변 사람들이 어떻게 생각하는지에 따라 우리가 할 일을 정한다고 말하는 셈입니다! 자녀들이 오늘날의 현대 교회에 그 어느 때보다 더 관심을 갖는 것도 놀랄 일이 아닙니다. 그어 놓은 선이 없으니까요!

제 관심을 끈 현대 교회가 하나 있었습니다. 주님을 향한 열정이 넘치는 듯했습니다! 목사는 죽음을 앞둔 사람처럼 설교했습니다. 잃어버린 이들에게 다가가는 일에도 무척 관심이 많았습니다. 하지만 그들은 성경의 가르침을 너무나 많이 그냥 무시했습니다! 마침내 저는 이 일을 주님께 가져갔습니다. “하나님, 대체 무슨 일입니까!” 하나님께서 제게 ‘그저 기다리라’고 말씀하시는 듯했습니다.

얼마 지나지 않아 그 목사는 불륜을 저질렀다는 이유로 직위에서 해임되었습니다. 그제야 모든 것이 분명해졌습니다. 좋은 교회를 세우고, 좋은 메시지를 전하고, 가난한 사람들을 도울 수는 있지만, 신약의 모든 가르침에 기꺼이 순종하지 않는다면 참된 그리스도인이 아니며 승리를 얻지 못할 것입니다. 기독교 신앙을 어느 정도까지 받아들이기는 쉽지만, 가진 것을 다 팔고, 모든 것을 제단에 바치고, 주님을 따르기는 쉽지 않습니다. 이 말이 대담하다는 것을 압니다. 하지만 하나님의 말씀의 진리입니다.

개신교 환경에서 주님께 삶을 드리고 싶어 하는 젊은 여성과 이야기한 적이 있습니다. 그녀는 필요한 일이라면 무엇이든 할 준비가 되어 있다고 했습니다. 저는 그녀에게 예수님을 위해 고난받을 준비가 되었는지, 옛 친구들과 자신을 분리할 준비가 되었는지, 세상에서 미움받을 준비와 남들과 달라질 준비가 되었는지 물었습니다. 외모를 바꿀 의향이 있는지도 물었습니다. 얼마 지나지 않아 그녀는 놀랍게도 단호하게 “아니요!”라고 대답했습니다. “교회에 다니기 시작하고 싶지만, 그런 다른 것들은 싫어요.” 나중에 저는 그녀가 친구들과 함께 저를 가리키며 웃는 것을 보았습니다. 멋있어 보이는 것이 참된 그리스도인을 규정하지 않습니다. 그러나 복음을 위해 배척당하는 것은 그렇습니다.

이 글을 쓰는 일은 쉽지 않습니다. 인기 있는 메시지도 아니고 그다지 격려가 되는 말도 아닙니다. 하지만 오늘 우리가 숙고해야 할 메시지라고 생각합니다. 우리 자신뿐 아니라 자녀들과 미래의 교회를 위해서도 그렇습니다. 우리는 타협 없이 분명한 분리의 선을 그어야 합니다. 오늘날의 현대 교회를 신약의 분명한 가르침에 비추어 정직하게 평가해야 합니다. 죄를 죄라고 불러야 합니다. 불순종을 죄라고 불러야 합니다. 타협을 죄라고 불러야 합니다. 다시 한번 하나님의 참된 백성과 함께 고난받기로 선택해야 합니다. 그렇다고 사람들을 멀리하거나 그들을 불쾌하게 대하라는 뜻은 아닙니다. 마음에는 사랑을 품고 입술에는 메시지를 담아, 많은 사람을 그리스도께로 인도하는 것입니다!

나는 그리스도의 복음을 부끄러워하지 아니하노니 이 복음은 믿는 모든 사람을 구원에 이르게 하는 하나님의 능력이 됨이라 먼저는 유대인에게요 또한 헬라인에게로다 –로마서 1:16.

Greetings in the worthy name of our Lord and Saviour, Jesus Christ. I trust that amid the present uncertainties in the world our hearts echo with the Psalmist: In God is my salvation and my glory: the rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God –Psalm 62:7. And, God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble –Psalm 46:1.

We are facing unprecedented and challenging times. More so than many of us can remember in our lifetime. I’m sure that each generation has faced challenges unique to their time in history. The same is true of us. But what is our ‘time’ in history? Most god-fearing individuals believe we are on the threshold of what the Scriptures refer to as “the time of the end”. (See Daniel 8:17; 11:35; 11:40; 12:4; & 12:9)

Maybe it is just me, or perhaps it has a lot to do with how fast news is broadcast around the world now a days. But it sure seems like there is a lot more chaos and violent acts of nature than there was five or ten years ago. Hurricanes, tornadoes, wildfires, earthquakes, drought, flooding, political unrest, wars, and rumors of war. Did I miss anything? Oh yes, there’s the ever-present issue of a worldwide pestilence—Covid-19.

Much of the world today seems to have a sense that “something is up”, or that “something is about to happen”. We should not be surprised by this, Jesus foretold it. We should not be overcome and distracted by fear, Jesus has told us what to do. In the following Scripture I have underlined three things that I see Jesus wants us to be active in doing as long as time continues.

And Jesus answered and said unto them, Take heed that no man deceive you. For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many. And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars: see that ye be not troubled: for all these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet. For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be famines, and pestilences, and earthquakes, in divers places. All these are the beginning of sorrows. Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted, and shall kill you: and ye shall be hated of all nations for my name’s sake. And then shall many be offended, and shall betray one another, and shall hate one another. And many false prophets shall rise, and shall deceive many. And because iniquity shall abound, the love of many shall wax cold. But he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved. And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations; and then shall the end come –Matthew 24:4-14.

Take heed that no man deceive you

I find it interesting that Jesus mentions this before telling us what He wants us to do. Someone has said that spiritual blindness is different than physical blindness in that when someone is physically blind, they know it, but when someone is spiritually blind, they don’t know it. In fact, that is the foundation of being spiritually blind—to no longer be aware of one’s own spiritual condition.

What all can we be deceived by? Who all might try to deceive us? Let’s always remember that Satan wants to use whoever he can, however he can, to deceive as many as he can. Job’s friends turned against him and even his own wife offered Satan’s own words as a way out (See Job 1;11; 2:5; and 2:9). We should not be surprised if we find ourselves in similar situations; Christ predicted that this would happen (See Matthew 10:35-36; and Luke 12:53).

Let’s never forget that God has given some clear solutions that we can follow to prevent ourselves from becoming deceived. Take heed, brethren, lest there be in any of you an evil heart of unbelief, in departing from the living God. But exhort one another daily, while it is called To day; lest any of you be hardened through the deceitfulness of sin. For we are made partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence stedfast unto the end; While it is said, To day if ye will hear his voice, harden not your hearts, as in the provocation –Hebrews 3:12-15.

Endure unto the end

This is one of the more interesting Scriptures that I think of whenever there is a heated discussion about whether or not someone who is once saved is then always saved and therefore never able to become unsaved. Doesn’t Scripture assure us …that ye may know that ye have eternal life… –1 John 5:13. However, Peter tells us to …beware lest ye also, being led away with the error of the wicked, fall from your own stedfastness –2 Peter 3:17.

So how do we bring this together so that Scripture harmonizes? First, we need to be saved initially so we can have eternal life which provides us with the power to walk in obedience to God’s Word. Secondly, we stay saved as long as we continue walking in obedience to the Scriptures. Then lastly, we are finally saved forever, IF we endure through life faithfully until the end (the end of our life here on earth).

Preach the Gospel in all the world

Preach the Gospel? Yes. Maybe we can’t all personally do the preaching, but we can all do our part to help the church fulfil this mandate. Some folks God has ordained to spend hours in their prayer closet in earnest intercessory prayer. Some have been called to give of their finances to support others who have been chosen to be on the front lines preaching the Gospel. This is a group effort. It is the church as a whole working together with each local church doing their part and everyone doing their individual part.

Let’s not allow the chaos and confusion around us to cause us to become distracted and disoriented. Let’s pull together as brothers and sisters with a common goal—not being deceived, enduring unto the end, and preaching the Gospel in all the world.

Now unto him that is able to keep you from falling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory with exceeding joy, To the only wise God our Saviour, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and ever. Amen. –Jude 1:24-25.
