Vi saluto nel nome degno del nostro Signore e Salvatore, Gesù Cristo. Confido che, in mezzo alle attuali incertezze del mondo, i nostri cuori facciano eco alle parole del salmista: In Dio è la mia salvezza e la mia gloria; la rocca della mia forza e il mio rifugio sono in Dio – Salmo 62:7. E ancora: Dio è il nostro rifugio e la nostra forza, un aiuto sempre presente nelle avversità – Salmo 46:1.

Stiamo affrontando tempi senza precedenti e difficili, più di quanto molti di noi riescano a ricordare nel corso della propria vita. Sono certo che ogni generazione abbia affrontato sfide peculiari del proprio periodo storico. Lo stesso vale per noi. Ma qual è il nostro «tempo» nella storia? La maggior parte delle persone che temono Dio crede che siamo sulla soglia di ciò che le Scritture definiscono «il tempo della fine». (Vedi Daniele 8:17; 11:35; 11:40; 12:4; e 12:9)

Forse è solo una mia impressione, oppure dipende molto dalla rapidità con cui oggi le notizie vengono diffuse in tutto il mondo. Ma sembra proprio che ci siano molti più sconvolgimenti e fenomeni naturali violenti rispetto a cinque o dieci anni fa. Uragani, tornado, incendi boschivi, terremoti, siccità, alluvioni, disordini politici, guerre e voci di guerre. Mi è sfuggito qualcosa? Ah, sì: c’è la questione sempre presente di una pestilenza mondiale: il Covid-19.

Oggi gran parte del mondo sembra avere la sensazione che «stia succedendo qualcosa» o che «stia per accadere qualcosa». Non dovremmo esserne sorpresi: Gesù lo aveva predetto. Non dovremmo lasciarci sopraffare e distrarre dalla paura: Gesù ci ha detto cosa fare. Nel passo delle Scritture che segue ho sottolineato tre cose che, a mio avviso, Gesù vuole che ci impegniamo a fare finché durerà il tempo.

Gesù rispose loro: Badate che nessuno vi seduca. Poiché molti verranno nel mio nome, dicendo: «Io sono il Cristo», e sedurranno molti. Voi udrete parlare di guerre e di rumori di guerre; guardate di non turbarvi, perché bisogna che queste cose avvengano, ma non sarà ancora la fine. Poiché si solleverà nazione contro nazione e regno contro regno; vi saranno carestie e pestilenze e terremoti in vari luoghi. Ma tutto questo non sarà che principio di dolori. Allora vi metteranno in tribolazione e vi uccideranno, e sarete odiati da tutte le genti a causa del mio nome. Allora molti si svieranno, si tradiranno e si odieranno a vicenda. Molti falsi profeti sorgeranno e sedurranno molti. Poiché l’iniquità aumenterà, l’amore dei più si raffredderà. Ma chi avrà perseverato sino alla fine sarà salvato. E questo evangelo del regno sarà predicato in tutto il mondo, in testimonianza a tutte le genti; allora verrà la fine – Matteo 24:4-14.

Badate che nessuno vi seduca

Trovo interessante che Gesù lo menzioni prima di dirci che cosa vuole che facciamo. Qualcuno ha detto che la cecità spirituale è diversa da quella fisica: quando una persona è fisicamente cieca, lo sa; quando invece è spiritualmente cieca, non lo sa. In effetti, questo è il fondamento della cecità spirituale: non essere più consapevoli della propria condizione spirituale.

Da che cosa possiamo essere ingannati? Chi potrebbe cercare di ingannarci? Ricordiamoci sempre che Satana vuole servirsi di chiunque possa, in qualunque modo possa, per ingannare quante più persone possibile. Gli amici di Giobbe gli si voltarono contro e perfino sua moglie gli offrì le stesse parole di Satana come via d’uscita (vedi Giobbe 1;11; 2:5; e 2:9). Non dovremmo sorprenderci se ci troviamo in situazioni simili: Cristo aveva predetto che sarebbe accaduto (vedi Matteo 10:35-36; e Luca 12:53).

Non dimentichiamo mai che Dio ci ha dato alcune soluzioni chiare da seguire per evitare di essere ingannati. Badate, fratelli, che non ci sia in nessuno di voi un cuore malvagio e incredulo, che vi allontani dal Dio vivente; ma esortatevi a vicenda ogni giorno, finché si può dire: «Oggi», affinché nessuno di voi si indurisca per la seduzione del peccato. Infatti siamo diventati partecipi di Cristo, a condizione che riteniamo salda sino alla fine la fiducia che avevamo da principio; mentre è detto: «Oggi, se udite la sua voce, non indurite i vostri cuori come nel giorno della ribellione» – Ebrei 3:12-15.

Perseverare sino alla fine

Questo è uno dei passi delle Scritture più interessanti che mi vengono in mente ogni volta che si accende una discussione sul fatto che chi è stato salvato una volta sia poi salvato per sempre e quindi non possa mai perdere la salvezza. La Scrittura non ci assicura forse …che sappiate di avere la vita eterna… – 1 Giovanni 5:13. Tuttavia, Pietro ci dice di …guardare da voi, affinché, trascinati dall’errore degli scellerati, non veniate meno alla vostra fermezza – 2 Pietro 3:17.

Come possiamo dunque conciliare questi aspetti, in modo che la Scrittura sia armoniosa? Per prima cosa, dobbiamo essere salvati inizialmente, così da avere la vita eterna, che ci dà la capacità di camminare in obbedienza alla Parola di Dio. In secondo luogo, rimaniamo salvati finché continuiamo a camminare in obbedienza alle Scritture. Infine, saremo salvati per sempre, SE persevereremo fedelmente nel corso della vita sino alla fine (la fine della nostra vita qui sulla terra).

Predicare il Vangelo in tutto il mondo

Predicare il Vangelo? Sì. Forse non tutti possiamo predicare personalmente, ma ognuno può fare la propria parte per aiutare la chiesa a compiere questo mandato. Dio ha stabilito che alcuni trascorrano ore nella propria stanza di preghiera, impegnati in ferventi preghiere d’intercessione. Alcuni sono stati chiamati a contribuire con le proprie risorse economiche per sostenere altri, scelti per essere in prima linea nella predicazione del Vangelo. È un impegno collettivo. È la chiesa nel suo insieme che opera unita, con ogni chiesa locale che fa la propria parte e ciascuno che svolge la propria.

Non permettiamo che il caos e la confusione che ci circondano ci distraggano e ci disorientino. Uniamoci come fratelli e sorelle, con un obiettivo comune: non lasciarci ingannare, perseverare sino alla fine e predicare il Vangelo in tutto il mondo.

Or a colui che è potente da preservarvi da ogni caduta e farvi comparire irreprensibili e con gioia davanti alla sua gloria, all’unico Dio sapiente, nostro Salvatore, siano gloria e maestà, dominio e potenza, ora e per sempre. Amen. – Giuda 1:24-25.

“Dr. Waldron,” the woman said to me as I prepared to leave the exam room. “I have one more question. How can I lose this extra weight?”

I sighed inaudibly as I sat down to discuss the situation with her. Dealing with weight gain is not the sort of thing that is easy to tack onto the end of an office visit and there have been many lengthy books written on the subject.

Americans seem to struggle with this. They spend an average of 33 billion dollars on weight loss products every year and 65 percent of Americans are either overweight or obese.

The whole discussion is a challenging one. We want a quick fix—to take a pill or add in a fat-burning food or do a simple exercise that will melt the extra weight away simply and quickly. The reality is that while we gain weight quite easily, it is much more difficult to lose that same weight. Maintaining weight loss is harder yet.

In the Beginning

We don’t know much about life before the fall in Genesis 3. We do know that …God saw every thing that he had made, and, behold, it was very good… –Genesis 1:31.

It is safe to assume that Adam and Eve did not struggle with their weight before sin entered the world. They were created perfectly which meant that they would not have struggled with metabolism issues. They also did not have the uncontrolled appetites for food that their descendants deal with today.

Two things happened with the fall of man in the Garden of Eden. First, humans started to have physical ailments—their bodies did not work as well as they did before. Adam and Eve were still able to live much longer lives than humans today, but metabolic diseases and other illnesses began to develop. The second thing that happened was that they began to have a sin nature.

Those two things have led to a lot of problems… Among them are metabolism and weight issues.

What the Bible Says About Food

Our bodies need to eat nutritious food—without eating they would deteriorate and eventually die. There is nothing better for a man, than that he should eat and drink, and that he should make his soul enjoy good in his labour. This also I saw, that it was from the hand of God –Ecclesiastes 2:24.

The Old Testament law was restrictive regarding what the Jewish people could eat. Under Kosher Law, the number of clean animals was far outweighed by the numbers of unclean animals. More than that, the book of Proverbs mentions several times that overeating is dangerous. Be not among winebibbers; among riotous eaters of flesh: For the drunkard and the glutton shall come to poverty: and drowsiness shall clothe a man with rags –Proverbs 23:20-21.

From the New Testament we find the early church no longer required Gentile Christians to follow Jewish laws regarding their diets. The Jerusalem council specifically required …that they abstain from pollutions of idols, and from fornication, and from things strangled, and from blood –Acts 15:20. Otherwise, it seems that they were free to eat whatever they wanted.

What did not change in the New Testament was the idea of self-control. The Fruit of the Spirit lists temperance as one of the things Christians should have and Paul made it clear that he was focused on controlling his desires, lest he become a castaway (see 1 Corinthians 9:27).

What? know ye not that your body is the temple of the Holy Ghost which is in you, which ye have of God, and ye are not your own? For ye are bought with a price: therefore glorify God in your body, and in your spirit, which are God’s –1 Corinthians 6:19-20.

Know ye not that ye are the temple of God, and that the Spirit of God dwelleth in you? If any man defile the temple of God, him shall God destroy; for the temple of God is holy, which temple ye are –1 Corinthians 3:16-17.

Scripture is clear that Christians should take care of their bodies, put their desires under the control of God, and avoid things that have anything to do with idolatry.

Reasons People Gain Weight

It is easy to break down reasons for weight gain into two big categories:

  1. problems with metabolism
  2. problems with excessive calories.

When we think about metabolic issues, these include things like thyroid problems and diabetes. These disorders affect the rate at which our bodies burn calories. One of the main ways we have to increase our metabolism is to increase our activity levels, particularly exercise that increases the heart rate—cardiovascular exercise.

Excess calories mainly come from overeating. It is important to remember that people eat for lots of reasons other than because they are hungry. People eat because they are bored, lonely, sad, and yes, sometimes because they are hungry. Some medications, particularly steroids, can increase appetite and negatively affect the metabolic rate.

We call the number of calories our bodies burn while at rest, the body’s metabolic rate. There are a couple of different formulas used to calculate our basal metabolic rates. They use height, weight, age, and gender to determine how many calories your body will burn in an average day. There are a few applications and websites that will do this calculation for you. https://www.active.com/fitness/calculators/bmr The important thing to know is that this is the number of calories you should consume to maintain your current body weight. Eat fewer calories than this number and you will tend to lose weight, take in more calories than this number and you will gain weight.

Is Weight Important?

From a medical standpoint, being overweight is associated with several different things. It tends to increase insulin resistance and it can lead to diabetes. It increases blood pressure. It can lead to obstructive sleep apnea, and it worsens arthritis in the back and legs.

Being overweight is not necessarily an indication of a spiritual problem and depending on a person’s genetics, it can be difficult to get it where it should be according to the charts. Even though most people feel much better when they are close to their ideal weight, Scripture does not indicate that there is a specific weight or body mass index (BMI) that Christians should not go over.

The important thing is that our lives are to be under the control of God if we have yielded ourselves, appetites, and all, to Him. We should try to be healthy in order that we can best participate in Kingdom building. More than that, we should attempt to set an example for others of a life that is yielded to God.

Myths About Weight Loss…

There are many things that people believe about weight loss. We will look at a list of things which people repeat. While there may be a grain of truth in them, they are not completely true and may discourage activities that can help a person who is struggling with his weight.

…Vigorous exercise is the only way to lose weight.

Many people believe that the reason that they can’t lose weight is because they can’t do enough exercise. They struggle with pain, arthritis, or some heart or lung condition that makes them unable to do vigorous athletic endeavors.

Maybe they know someone who took up running and lost a bunch of weight and that seems like the right way to do it. They just don’t feel able to take that path and feel hopeless about the whole endeavor.

Exercise is important. Most medical societies recommend that people exercise at least 150 minutes a week. While exercise does boost our metabolism and helps our hearts and lungs, it still may not change a person’s weight very much.

Most people burn between 200 and 300 calories with a half hour of exercise. While this may sound like a lot, a body must burn 3500 calories to lose one pound. In addition, most of us are hungrier after we exercise, and it is awfully easy to eat an extra 200 calories that basically negates whatever was burned during the exercise time.

…Carbohydrates make you gain weight.

Carbohydrate is the medical term for sugars. The calories we consume in our diets come from one of three sources: carbohydrates, fats, and proteins. Carbohydrates are present in desserts, but they are also present in many starchy foods like rice, corn, pasta, bread, and lots of other things.

There are several diets, like the Atkins Diet and the Keto Diet, that push those who follow them to cut out as many carbohydrates as possible. People often do lose weight on these sorts of diets. Unfortunately, these diets are difficult to maintain long term as they are quite restrictive.

The healthiest thing is to eat carbohydrates moderately and steer towards the healthier options. Using whole grains and more complex carbohydrates is important. A bowl of oatmeal may have a similar number of grams of carbohydrates as compared to a sugary breakfast cereal, but it will be broken down more slowly by our bodies and is easier for them to deal with.

…Starvation is the only way to lose weight.

Starvation does result in weight loss—there were no heavy-set people who came out of the concentration camps in World War II. This certainly is not the only way to lose weight, nor is it a healthy way to lose weight.

We know that when people starve for extended periods of time, they will begin to lose muscle mass, their bones will get weaker, and their metabolism will decrease. Most people who starve themselves will end up regaining all of the weight they lost within a few years and because their metabolism has been downgraded, in the long run it will be harder for them to keep weight off.

…You just need to eat ‘___’ fat burning food to lose weight!

I specifically left the food blank above because it seems that this is always changing. Maybe you’ve read that Greek yogurt, or cinnamon, or goji berry juice will help you lose weight. Studies indicate that there is no magic food that will melt fat away.

If these foods work, it is because you have replaced something unhealthy and rich in calories with something healthier. For example, if your normal breakfast consists of 5 strips of bacon, a glass of orange juice, 2 slices of toast, and two eggs and you replace that with a glass of water and a bowl of oatmeal, you will probably lose weight. It is not because the oatmeal is “burning fat,” but rather that it has significantly fewer calories than the breakfast you were eating before.

Some foods have almost no calories and probably take as much energy to eat and digest as humans get from them. Celery, iceberg lettuce, and mushrooms all fall into this category. The problem is that if you put peanut butter on the celery, salad dressing on the lettuce, and fry the mushrooms in butter or oil, then suddenly they aren’t the low-calorie foods they purport to be. We humans are very good at fixing low-cal foods so that they both taste better and are no longer low-calorie.

…Fat free and diet foods are the key to weight loss.

There are many foods and condiments on the market that have reduced fat and claim to be lower calorie than the normal versions of themselves. These often have a lot of different chemicals and sugar substitutes in them to get the taste and texture as similar to the regular versions as possible.

Sugar substitutes seem to be healthier than sugar when used moderately, but they also seem to encourage people to crave sweeter foods. Studies have linked artificial sweeteners with the onset of glucose intolerance—something that could lead to diabetes. https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC3095502/ Dieticians seem to think that of the various sugar substitutes, Stevia is the safest.

All in all, our goal should not be to try to eat all the same foods, just with fewer calories, but rather to eat a variety of healthy foods and moderate-sized portions. This is what will lead to a better metabolism and not simply getting reduced fat versions of our favorite foods.

…The solution is diet pills.

Over time I have seen many people take medications and supplements, both prescription and over the counter varieties, to try to help them lose weight. These medications and supplements are supposed to do a number of things—reduce appetite and increase the metabolic rate are several of these.

They often work in the short term. People lose quite a bit of weight in the first few weeks and think that they have conquered their struggles. The problem is that over time, they usually get used to whatever it is that they are taking, their appetite returns, and their metabolism goes back to normal.

While these sorts of solutions may give short-term help, being healthy in the long term, means figuring out a healthy eating plan and exercise schedule, then sticking with it long term. The goal should never be simply to “take off ten pounds,” but rather to be as healthy as possible.

We’ve covered a lot of things not to do and probably reading between the lines you can see some of the things that are helpful to do as well. A second part (Lord willing) will be coming with the next issue to discuss positive things that we can do to achieve a healthy weight.

With all of this, it is important to remember that our goal is not about achieving some sort of earthly beauty. The aim, rather, is to treat our body as the Temple of the Holy Ghost (1 Corinthians 6:19). I have heard this verse used to explain why we shouldn’t drink, smoke, or get tattoos, but we need to treat it with respect when it comes to eating and exercise, as well.

As we care for our bodies, we will be better able to meet the needs of the people around us and we will be prepared to meet whatever plan God has for our lives.

“ডা. ওয়ালড্রন,” পরীক্ষাকক্ষ থেকে বেরিয়ে যাওয়ার প্রস্তুতি নেওয়ার সময় মহিলাটি আমাকে বললেন। “আমার আরেকটি প্রশ্ন আছে। এই বাড়তি ওজন কীভাবে কমাতে পারি?”

তাঁর সঙ্গে বিষয়টি নিয়ে আলোচনা করতে বসে আমি নীরবে দীর্ঘশ্বাস ফেললাম। ওজন বেড়ে যাওয়ার বিষয়টি এমন কিছু নয় যে অফিসে সাক্ষাতের শেষে সহজেই যোগ করে আলোচনা করা যায়; আর এ বিষয়ে অনেক দীর্ঘ বই লেখা হয়েছে।

আমেরিকানরা এ নিয়ে বেশ সংগ্রাম করছে বলে মনে হয়। ওজন কমানোর পণ্যের পেছনে তারা প্রতিবছর গড়ে ৩৩ বিলিয়ন ডলার খরচ করে, আর আমেরিকানদের ৬৫ শতাংশই অতিরিক্ত ওজনের বা স্থূলকায়।

বিষয়টি নিয়ে আলোচনা করাটা বেশ কঠিন। আমরা দ্রুত সমাধান চাই—একটি বড়ি খেতে, চর্বি পোড়ায় এমন কোনো খাবার যোগ করতে, অথবা এমন সহজ কোনো ব্যায়াম করতে চাই, যা দ্রুত ও সহজে বাড়তি ওজন গলিয়ে দেবে। বাস্তবতা হলো, আমাদের ওজন যেমন সহজেই বাড়ে, তেমনি সেই ওজন কমানো অনেক বেশি কঠিন। ওজন কমিয়ে তা ধরে রাখা আরও কঠিন।

আদিতে

আদিপুস্তক ৩-এ পতনের আগের জীবন সম্পর্কে আমরা খুব বেশি জানি না। তবে আমরা জানি, …ঈশ্বর আপনার নির্মিত সমস্ত বস্তু দেখিলেন, আর, দেখ, সে সকলই অতি উত্তম…—আদিপুস্তক ১:৩১।

নিরাপদেই অনুমান করা যায় যে জগতে পাপ প্রবেশ করার আগে আদম ও হবা তাঁদের ওজন নিয়ে সমস্যায় ভুগতেন না। তাঁদের নিখুঁতভাবে সৃষ্টি করা হয়েছিল; অর্থাৎ তাঁদের বিপাকক্রিয়া নিয়ে সমস্যা হতো না। তাঁদের বংশধরেরা আজ যে অনিয়ন্ত্রিত খাদ্যরুচির সঙ্গে লড়াই করেন, তাঁদেরও তা ছিল না।

এদন উদ্যানে মানুষের পতনের ফলে দুটি বিষয় ঘটেছিল। প্রথমত, মানুষের শারীরিক অসুস্থতা দেখা দিতে শুরু করল—তাদের দেহ আগের মতো ভালোভাবে কাজ করত না। আদম ও হবা তখনও আজকের মানুষের চেয়ে অনেক দীর্ঘ জীবন যাপন করতে পারতেন, কিন্তু বিপাকজনিত রোগ ও অন্যান্য অসুস্থতা দেখা দিতে শুরু করেছিল। দ্বিতীয়ত, তাদের মধ্যে পাপস্বভাব দেখা দিতে শুরু করল।

এই দুটি বিষয় বহু সমস্যার জন্ম দিয়েছে… সেগুলোর মধ্যে রয়েছে বিপাকক্রিয়া ও ওজনের সমস্যা।

খাবার সম্পর্কে বাইবেল কী বলে

আমাদের দেহের পুষ্টিকর খাবার দরকার—খাওয়া না হলে দেহ ক্ষয় হতে থাকবে এবং শেষ পর্যন্ত মারা যাবে। মানুষের পক্ষে ভোজন পান করা ও আপন পরিশ্রমে আপন প্রাণকে সুখভোগ করান অপেক্ষা আর মঙ্গল কিছুই নাই। ইহাও আমি দেখিলাম, ইহা ঈশ্বরের হস্ত হইতে হয়—উপদেশক ২:২৪।

ইহুদি লোকেরা কী খেতে পারত, সে বিষয়ে পুরাতন নিয়মের বিধান ছিল কঠোর। কোশের বিধি অনুযায়ী, শুচি প্রাণীর তুলনায় অশুচি প্রাণীর সংখ্যা ছিল অনেক বেশি। তা ছাড়া, হিতোপদেশ বইয়ে কয়েকবার বলা হয়েছে যে অতিরিক্ত খাওয়া বিপজ্জনক। তুমি মদ্যপায়ীদের মধ্যে, মাংসের অতিভোজীদের মধ্যে থাকিও না। কেননা মাতাল ও পেটুক দরিদ্র হইবে, এবং তন্দ্রা মনুষ্যকে ছিন্নবস্ত্র পরাইবে—হিতোপদেশ ২৩:২০-২১।

নতুন নিয়ম থেকে আমরা জানতে পারি, প্রাথমিক মণ্ডলী অইহুদি খ্রিস্টানদের ইহুদি খাদ্যবিধি মানতে আর বাধ্য করত না। যিরূশালেম পরিষদ বিশেষভাবে এই নির্দেশ দিয়েছিল, …তাহারা যেন প্রতিমার অপবিত্রতা হইতে, ব্যভিচার হইতে, গলা টিপিয়া মারা প্রাণীর মাংস হইতে, এবং রক্ত হইতে পৃথক থাকে—প্রেরিত ১৫:২০। অন্যথায়, তারা যা ইচ্ছা খেতে স্বাধীন ছিল বলেই মনে হয়।

নতুন নিয়মে যে বিষয়টির পরিবর্তন হয়নি, তা হলো আত্মসংযমের ধারণা। আত্মার ফলের তালিকায় সংযমকে খ্রিস্টানদের থাকা উচিত এমন গুণগুলোর একটি বলা হয়েছে, আর পৌল স্পষ্ট করে দিয়েছিলেন যে তিনি নিজের আকাঙ্ক্ষা নিয়ন্ত্রণে রাখার চেষ্টা করতেন, পাছে তিনি অগ্রাহ্য হন (দেখুন ১ করিন্থীয় ৯:২৭)।

কি? তোমরা কি জান না যে তোমাদের দেহ তোমাদের অন্তরে অবস্থিত পবিত্র আত্মার মন্দির, যাঁহাকে তোমরা ঈশ্বর হইতে পাইয়াছ, এবং তোমরা আপনাদের নও? কারণ মূল্য দিয়া তোমাদিগকে ক্রয় করা হইয়াছে; অতএব তোমাদের দেহে ঈশ্বরের গৌরব কর, তোমাদের আত্মাতেও কর, যাহা ঈশ্বরের—১ করিন্থীয় ৬:১৯-২০।

তোমরা কি জান না যে তোমরা ঈশ্বরের মন্দির, এবং ঈশ্বরের আত্মা তোমাদের অন্তরে বাস করেন? কেহ যদি ঈশ্বরের মন্দির অপবিত্র করে, তবে ঈশ্বর তাহাকে বিনষ্ট করিবেন; কেননা ঈশ্বরের মন্দির পবিত্র, আর সেই মন্দির তোমরাই—১ করিন্থীয় ৩:১৬-১৭।

শাস্ত্র স্পষ্ট করে যে খ্রিস্টানদের নিজেদের দেহের যত্ন নেওয়া, নিজেদের আকাঙ্ক্ষাকে ঈশ্বরের নিয়ন্ত্রণে সমর্পণ করা এবং মূর্তিপূজার সঙ্গে কোনোভাবে সম্পর্কিত বিষয় এড়িয়ে চলা উচিত।

মানুষের ওজন বাড়ার কারণ

ওজন বাড়ার কারণগুলোকে দুটি বড় ভাগে ভাগ করা সহজ:

  1. বিপাকক্রিয়ার সমস্যা
  2. অতিরিক্ত ক্যালোরির সমস্যা।

বিপাকজনিত সমস্যার কথা ভাবলে এর মধ্যে থাইরয়েডের সমস্যা ও ডায়াবেটিসের মতো বিষয় রয়েছে। এই রোগগুলো আমাদের দেহ যে হারে ক্যালোরি পোড়ায়, তাতে প্রভাব ফেলে। বিপাকক্রিয়া বাড়ানোর অন্যতম প্রধান উপায় হলো আমাদের কর্মতৎপরতা বাড়ানো, বিশেষ করে এমন ব্যায়াম করা যাতে হৃদ্‌স্পন্দন বেড়ে যায়—হৃদ্‌যন্ত্র ও রক্তনালির ব্যায়াম।

অতিরিক্ত ক্যালোরির প্রধান উৎস হলো অতিরিক্ত খাওয়া। মনে রাখা জরুরি যে মানুষ ক্ষুধা ছাড়াও অনেক কারণে খায়। মানুষ একঘেয়েমি, নিঃসঙ্গতা, দুঃখের কারণে খায়, আর হ্যাঁ, কখনো কখনো ক্ষুধার কারণেও খায়। কিছু ওষুধ, বিশেষ করে স্টেরয়েড, ক্ষুধা বাড়াতে পারে এবং বিপাকের হারকে নেতিবাচকভাবে প্রভাবিত করতে পারে।

বিশ্রামের সময় আমাদের দেহ যে সংখ্যক ক্যালোরি পোড়ায়, তাকে দেহের বিপাকের হার বলা হয়। আমাদের মূল বিপাকীয় হার হিসাব করার জন্য কয়েকটি ভিন্ন সূত্র রয়েছে। সেগুলো উচ্চতা, ওজন, বয়স ও লিঙ্গ ব্যবহার করে হিসাব করে যে একটি গড় দিনে আপনার দেহ কত ক্যালোরি পোড়াবে। কয়েকটি অ্যাপ্লিকেশন ও ওয়েবসাইট আপনার হয়ে এই হিসাব করে দেবে। https://www.active.com/fitness/calculators/bmr গুরুত্বপূর্ণ বিষয় হলো, বর্তমান দেহের ওজন ধরে রাখতে আপনার যত ক্যালোরি খাওয়া উচিত, এ সংখ্যাটি সেটাই। এ সংখ্যার চেয়ে কম ক্যালোরি খেলে আপনার ওজন কমার প্রবণতা থাকবে; আর এ সংখ্যার চেয়ে বেশি ক্যালোরি গ্রহণ করলে ওজন বাড়বে।

ওজন কি গুরুত্বপূর্ণ?

চিকিৎসাবিজ্ঞানের দৃষ্টিতে, অতিরিক্ত ওজনের সঙ্গে বেশ কিছু বিষয়ের সম্পর্ক রয়েছে। এতে ইনসুলিন প্রতিরোধ বাড়ার প্রবণতা থাকে এবং এর ফলে ডায়াবেটিস হতে পারে। এটি রক্তচাপ বাড়ায়। এর ফলে অবস্ট্রাকটিভ স্লিপ অ্যাপনিয়া হতে পারে, এবং পিঠ ও পায়ের বাত আরও খারাপ হয়।

অতিরিক্ত ওজন থাকলেই যে তা আধ্যাত্মিক সমস্যার ইঙ্গিত, এমন নয়; আর ব্যক্তির জিনগত বৈশিষ্ট্যের ওপর নির্ভর করে, তালিকা অনুযায়ী ওজন যথাযথ পর্যায়ে নিয়ে যাওয়া কঠিন হতে পারে। অধিকাংশ মানুষ আদর্শ ওজনের কাছাকাছি থাকলে অনেক ভালো বোধ করেন ঠিকই, কিন্তু খ্রিস্টানদের একটি নির্দিষ্ট ওজন বা দেহভর সূচক (BMI) অতিক্রম করা উচিত নয়—এমন কোনো ইঙ্গিত শাস্ত্রে নেই।

গুরুত্বপূর্ণ বিষয় হলো, আমরা যদি নিজেদের, আমাদের ক্ষুধা-আকাঙ্ক্ষাসহ সবকিছু, তাঁর কাছে সমর্পণ করে থাকি, তবে আমাদের জীবন ঈশ্বরের নিয়ন্ত্রণে থাকা উচিত। আমাদের সুস্থ থাকার চেষ্টা করা উচিত, যাতে আমরা রাজ্য-নির্মাণে যথাসম্ভব অংশ নিতে পারি। তার চেয়েও বেশি, ঈশ্বরের কাছে সমর্পিত জীবনের দৃষ্টান্ত অন্যদের সামনে তুলে ধরার চেষ্টা করা উচিত।

ওজন কমানো নিয়ে ভ্রান্ত ধারণা…

ওজন কমানো সম্পর্কে মানুষ অনেক কিছু বিশ্বাস করে। লোকেরা যে কথাগুলো বারবার বলে, তার একটি তালিকা আমরা দেখব। এসবের মধ্যে সত্যের কিছু অংশ থাকতে পারে, কিন্তু এগুলো পুরোপুরি সত্য নয় এবং ওজন নিয়ে সংগ্রামরত কাউকে সাহায্য করতে পারে এমন কাজ থেকে তাকে নিরুৎসাহিত করতে পারে।

…ওজন কমানোর একমাত্র উপায় কঠোর ব্যায়াম।

অনেকে বিশ্বাস করেন, তাঁরা ওজন কমাতে পারেন না কারণ যথেষ্ট ব্যায়াম করতে পারেন না। তাঁরা ব্যথা, বাত, অথবা হৃদ্‌যন্ত্র বা ফুসফুসের কোনো সমস্যায় ভোগেন, যার কারণে কঠোর ক্রীড়ামূলক ব্যায়াম করা তাঁদের পক্ষে সম্ভব হয় না।

হয়তো তাঁরা এমন কাউকে চেনেন, যিনি দৌড়ানো শুরু করে অনেক ওজন কমিয়েছেন, আর তাই এটাই ওজন কমানোর সঠিক উপায় বলে মনে হয়। কিন্তু তাঁরা নিজেরা এ পথ অনুসরণ করতে সক্ষম বোধ করেন না এবং পুরো প্রচেষ্টা নিয়েই হতাশ হয়ে পড়েন।

ব্যায়াম গুরুত্বপূর্ণ। অধিকাংশ চিকিৎসা-সংস্থা সুপারিশ করে, মানুষ যেন সপ্তাহে অন্তত ১৫০ মিনিট ব্যায়াম করে। ব্যায়াম আমাদের বিপাকক্রিয়া বাড়ায় এবং হৃদ্‌যন্ত্র ও ফুসফুসকে সাহায্য করে ঠিকই, কিন্তু তবুও এতে কারও ওজনে খুব বেশি পরিবর্তন নাও হতে পারে।

অধিকাংশ মানুষ আধা ঘণ্টা ব্যায়াম করে ২০০ থেকে ৩০০ ক্যালোরি পোড়ায়। এটা অনেক মনে হতে পারে, কিন্তু এক পাউন্ড ওজন কমাতে দেহকে ৩৫০০ ক্যালোরি পোড়াতে হয়। তা ছাড়া, ব্যায়ামের পর আমাদের অধিকাংশেরই ক্ষুধা বেড়ে যায়, আর ব্যায়ামের সময় পোড়ানো ক্যালোরি কার্যত পুষিয়ে দেওয়ার মতো অতিরিক্ত ২০০ ক্যালোরি খেয়ে ফেলা খুবই সহজ।

…শর্করা ওজন বাড়ায়।

শর্করা হলো চিনির চিকিৎসাবৈজ্ঞানিক পরিভাষা। আমাদের খাদ্য থেকে পাওয়া ক্যালোরি আসে তিনটি উৎসের কোনো একটি থেকে: শর্করা, চর্বি ও প্রোটিন। মিষ্টান্নে শর্করা থাকে, তবে ভাত, ভুট্টা, পাস্তা, রুটি এবং আরও অনেক শ্বেতসারযুক্ত খাবারেও তা থাকে।

অ্যাটকিন্স ডায়েট ও কিটো ডায়েটের মতো বেশ কিছু খাদ্যাভ্যাস আছে, যেগুলো অনুসরণকারীদের যতটা সম্ভব শর্করা বাদ দিতে বলে। এ ধরনের খাদ্যাভ্যাসে মানুষ প্রায়ই ওজন কমায়। দুর্ভাগ্যবশত, এগুলো দীর্ঘমেয়াদে বজায় রাখা কঠিন, কারণ এগুলো বেশ কঠোরভাবে সীমাবদ্ধ।

সবচেয়ে স্বাস্থ্যকর উপায় হলো পরিমিত পরিমাণে শর্করা খাওয়া এবং স্বাস্থ্যকর বিকল্পের দিকে ঝোঁকা। পূর্ণশস্য ও আরও জটিল শর্করা গ্রহণ করা গুরুত্বপূর্ণ। এক বাটি ওটমিলে শর্করার পরিমাণ হয়তো চিনিযুক্ত সকালের নাশতার সিরিয়ালের কাছাকাছি, কিন্তু আমাদের দেহ ওটমিল আরও ধীরে ভাঙে এবং তা সামলানো দেহের পক্ষে সহজ।

…ওজন কমানোর একমাত্র উপায় অনাহারে থাকা।

অনাহারে থাকলে ওজন কমে—দ্বিতীয় বিশ্বযুদ্ধের কনসেনট্রেশন ক্যাম্প থেকে কোনো স্থূলকায় মানুষ বেরিয়ে আসেনি। কিন্তু ওজন কমানোর এটাই যে একমাত্র উপায়, তা নয়; আর এটি ওজন কমানোর স্বাস্থ্যকর উপায়ও নয়।

আমরা জানি, মানুষ দীর্ঘ সময় অনাহারে থাকলে তাদের পেশির ভর কমতে শুরু করে, হাড় দুর্বল হয়ে যায় এবং বিপাকের হার কমে যায়। যারা নিজেদের অনাহারে রাখেন, তাঁদের অধিকাংশই কয়েক বছরের মধ্যে হারানো সব ওজন আবার ফিরে পাবেন; আর তাঁদের বিপাকের হার কমে যাওয়ার কারণে দীর্ঘমেয়াদে ওজন ধরে রাখা তাঁদের জন্য আরও কঠিন হবে।

…ওজন কমাতে শুধু ‘___’ চর্বি পোড়ানো খাবার খেতে হবে!

ওপরের ফাঁকা স্থানে আমি ইচ্ছা করেই খাবারের নাম বসাইনি, কারণ মনে হয় এটি সব সময় বদলায়। হয়তো আপনি পড়েছেন যে গ্রিক দই, দারুচিনি অথবা গোজি বেরির রস ওজন কমাতে সাহায্য করবে। গবেষণা বলছে, চর্বি গলিয়ে দেওয়ার মতো কোনো জাদুকরী খাবার নেই।

এই খাবারগুলো যদি কাজ করে, তবে তার কারণ হলো আপনি অস্বাস্থ্যকর ও ক্যালোরিসমৃদ্ধ কিছু খাবারের বদলে স্বাস্থ্যকর কিছু খাচ্ছেন। উদাহরণস্বরূপ, আপনার নিয়মিত সকালের খাবারে যদি থাকে বেকনের ৫ টুকরো, এক গ্লাস কমলার রস, ২ টুকরো পাউরুটি এবং দুটি ডিম, আর এর বদলে আপনি এক গ্লাস পানি ও এক বাটি ওটমিল খান, তাহলে সম্ভবত আপনার ওজন কমবে। এর কারণ ওটমিল “চর্বি পোড়ায়” তা নয়; বরং আগে যে সকালের খাবার খেতেন, তার চেয়ে এতে ক্যালোরি উল্লেখযোগ্যভাবে কম।

কিছু খাবারে প্রায় কোনো ক্যালোরি থাকে না এবং মানুষ সেগুলো থেকে যত শক্তি পায়, সেগুলো খেতে ও হজম করতে সম্ভবত ততটাই শক্তি ব্যয় হয়। সেলারি, আইসবার্গ লেটুস ও মাশরুম এই শ্রেণিতে পড়ে। সমস্যা হলো, সেলারিতে পিনাট বাটার, লেটুসে সালাদ ড্রেসিং, আর মাশরুম মাখন বা তেলে ভেজে দিলে তখন হঠাৎ করেই সেগুলো কথিত কম-ক্যালোরির খাবার থাকে না। আমরা মানুষ কম-ক্যালোরির খাবারকে এমনভাবে তৈরি করতে খুব দক্ষ, যাতে সেগুলোর স্বাদ ভালো হয় এবং সেগুলো আর কম-ক্যালোরির না থাকে।

…চর্বিমুক্ত ও ডায়েট খাবারই ওজন কমানোর মূল চাবিকাঠি।

বাজারে এমন অনেক খাবার ও মসলা আছে, যেগুলোতে চর্বি কমানো হয়েছে এবং দাবি করা হয় যে সেগুলো একই খাবারের সাধারণ সংস্করণের চেয়ে কম ক্যালোরিযুক্ত। স্বাদ ও গঠন যেন নিয়মিত সংস্করণের যতটা সম্ভব কাছাকাছি হয়, সে জন্য এসব খাবারে প্রায়ই নানা ধরনের রাসায়নিক ও চিনির বিকল্প ব্যবহার করা হয়।

পরিমিতভাবে ব্যবহার করলে চিনির বিকল্পগুলো চিনির চেয়ে স্বাস্থ্যকর বলে মনে হয়, কিন্তু এগুলো মানুষকে আরও মিষ্টি খাবারের প্রতি আকাঙ্ক্ষী করে তোলে বলেও মনে হয়। গবেষণায় কৃত্রিম মিষ্টিকারকের সঙ্গে গ্লুকোজ অসহিষ্ণুতার সূচনার যোগসূত্র পাওয়া গেছে—যা ডায়াবেটিসের দিকে নিয়ে যেতে পারে। https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC3095502/ খাদ্যবিশেষজ্ঞদের ধারণা, বিভিন্ন চিনির বিকল্পের মধ্যে স্টিভিয়া সবচেয়ে নিরাপদ।

সার্বিকভাবে, আমাদের লক্ষ্য হওয়া উচিত নয় কম ক্যালোরিযুক্ত একই খাবারগুলোই খাওয়ার চেষ্টা করা; বরং নানা ধরনের স্বাস্থ্যকর খাবার এবং পরিমিত পরিমাণে খাবার খাওয়া উচিত। এতে বিপাকক্রিয়া ভালো হবে; কেবল আমাদের প্রিয় খাবারের কম-চর্বিযুক্ত সংস্করণ পেলেই তা হবে না।

…সমাধান হলো ডায়েট বড়ি।

সময়ের সঙ্গে আমি অনেক মানুষকে ওজন কমাতে সাহায্যের জন্য প্রেসক্রিপশনে দেওয়া ওষুধ এবং প্রেসক্রিপশন ছাড়া পাওয়া ওষুধ ও পরিপূরক—দুই ধরনেরই—ব্যবহার করতে দেখেছি। এসব ওষুধ ও পরিপূরকের উদ্দেশ্য কয়েকটি বিষয় করা—ক্ষুধা কমানো ও বিপাকের হার বাড়ানো তার মধ্যে কয়েকটি।

স্বল্পমেয়াদে এগুলো প্রায়ই কাজ করে। প্রথম কয়েক সপ্তাহে মানুষ বেশ খানিকটা ওজন কমান এবং ভাবেন যে তাঁদের সংগ্রাম জয় করেছেন। সমস্যা হলো, সময়ের সঙ্গে তাঁরা সাধারণত যে ওষুধ বা পরিপূরকই নিচ্ছেন, তাতে অভ্যস্ত হয়ে পড়েন; ক্ষুধা ফিরে আসে এবং বিপাকক্রিয়া আবার স্বাভাবিক হয়ে যায়।

এ ধরনের সমাধান স্বল্পমেয়াদে সাহায্য করতে পারে ঠিকই, কিন্তু দীর্ঘমেয়াদে সুস্থ থাকতে হলে স্বাস্থ্যকর খাদ্য পরিকল্পনা ও ব্যায়ামের সময়সূচি ঠিক করে তা দীর্ঘমেয়াদে মেনে চলতে হয়। লক্ষ্য কখনোই শুধু “দশ পাউন্ড ওজন কমানো” হওয়া উচিত নয়; বরং যতটা সম্ভব সুস্থ থাকা উচিত।

কী করা উচিত নয়, সে বিষয়ে আমরা অনেক কথা বলেছি; আর সম্ভবত কথার ফাঁকে আপনি কী কী করা উপকারী, তার কিছুটা বুঝতে পেরেছেন। সুস্থ ওজন অর্জনে আমরা কী কী ইতিবাচক পদক্ষেপ নিতে পারি, তা নিয়ে আলোচনা করতে দ্বিতীয় পর্বটি (প্রভু চাইলে) পরবর্তী সংখ্যায় প্রকাশিত হবে।

এসবের মধ্যে মনে রাখা জরুরি যে আমাদের লক্ষ্য কোনো পার্থিব সৌন্দর্য অর্জন করা নয়। বরং উদ্দেশ্য হলো আমাদের দেহকে পবিত্র আত্মার মন্দির হিসেবে বিবেচনা করা (১ করিন্থীয় ৬:১৯)। আমি এই পদটি এমনভাবে ব্যবহার করতে শুনেছি যে কেন আমাদের মদ্যপান, ধূমপান বা উল্কি করানো উচিত নয় তা বোঝানো হয়; কিন্তু খাওয়া ও ব্যায়ামের ক্ষেত্রেও আমাদের এই পদটির প্রতি সম্মান দেখাতে হবে।

আমরা যখন আমাদের দেহের যত্ন নিই, তখন চারপাশের মানুষের প্রয়োজন মেটাতে আরও সক্ষম হই, এবং ঈশ্বর আমাদের জীবনের জন্য যে পরিকল্পনাই করে থাকুন না কেন, তা পূরণে প্রস্তুত থাকি।

“Let’s ask my mom if we can go on a walk to the creek. I want to go wading.” Angie told her friend Melissa.

“That sounds like fun,” Melissa said, following Angie to the kitchen. There was always something fun to do whenever Melissa visited her friend’s house.

After getting permission, the two girls stepped out into the hot, humid, sunny day. They had to cross a pasture to get to the creek, so Angie pushed apart the fence wires and stepped through. Then she held the wires apart so Melissa could also get through the fence into the goat pasture.

The girls walked across the pasture, through another fence, and into the woods. They walked down a dirt path to the stream. They lifted their skirts and stepped into the gurgling water. The two friends talked and laughed as they walked further downstream to a special spot in the creek where they always loved to go.

It was at this spot that the creek bed was filled with some unusual rocks. When these rocks were dry, they were grey, but when they got wet, they turned a very pretty blue.

After spending some time admiring the blue rocks, Melissa turned to Angie and said, “Let’s go walk through that big culvert under the road.”

“Yes, let’s do that and then we can walk along the road back to the driveway.”

They stepped out of the cool water and walked through the woods to the tunnel-like culvert. The girls went through the dark tunnel to the other side and Melissa scrambled up the steep bank to the gravel road.

Suddenly, realizing she was alone, Melissa turned around and saw that Angie was still at the entrance of the tunnel looking into a pool of water. She moved a rock, then screamed and scrambled up the bank to join Melissa. “There was a crayfish under there!” she exclaimed.

The girls’ dress hems were damp from the creek but soon dried in the hot sun as they walked back towards the house. When they were halfway in the lane, Angie said, “Do you want to take the boat out on the pond? We have some oars that are fun to use.”

Melissa grinned in excitement, “That would be lots of fun!” She followed Angie into the barn to help get the oars and life jackets.

The girls snapped on their orange life jackets and pushed the boat out into the pond water. Soon they had paddled out to the middle of the pond and sat there, watching the water slowly ripple around them.

“Hey, I know what we should do now!” Angie said. “Let’s bang the water with our oars to make splashes. Like this.” Angie slapped the surface of the pond with her oar. Melissa followed her example and began splashing on her side of the boat.

Their splashes got bigger and bigger. They were having a lot of fun seeing who could make the biggest splash. Melissa lifted her oar into the air and hit the water extra hard. As expected, the water splashed, but when Melissa lifted her oar, all she had was the handle. The paddle end had broken off and was floating just under the surface of the water next to the boat. She reached into the water, grabbed the broken paddle, and placed both pieces of the oar in the boat.

For a moment, Angie and Melissa looked at each other in silence. Melissa felt guilty for breaking the oar and Angie felt bad for suggesting that they splash in the water.

“Let’s go back to shore and put the oars in the barn,” Angie said. “It doesn’t matter that it broke. They’re just old ones anyway,” she finished, somewhat uncertainly.

Melissa thought that was a good idea and helped Angie pull the boat out of the water. They picked up the life jackets and the oars and carried them into the barn.

Melissa felt bad but she did not want to tell anyone that she had broken the oar. They passed the pile of sweet-smelling hay bales and the noisy goat pen, but Melissa hardly noticed them. All she could think about was that she had broken the oar and that she was going to hide what she had done. Her conscience was bothering her because she knew that her parents and God wanted her to always be honest and to never hide anything.

Just as the girls stepped out of the barn onto the lawn, Angie’s big brother jumped out from behind the barn where he had been hiding. “I saw you and I know what you did!” he told them. “You broke the oar. And guess what!? I followed you the whole time you were in the creek and down by the road too. I’m going to tell Mom that you broke the oar.” He grinned, then ran toward the basement door, disappearing inside.

Angie and Melissa were a little upset that he had been sneaking around watching them (it wasn’t the first time he had done that). But in a strange way, Melissa felt a lot better. She did not need to worry anymore about someone finding out that she had broken the oar, because someone knew already. When Angie’s parents were told about the broken oar, they forgave Melissa for breaking it. Melissa was always very glad that it had not been kept a secret after all.

“Tumwombe mama yangu ruhusa ya kutembea hadi kijito. Nataka kuingia majini.” Angie alimwambia rafiki yake Melissa.

“Hilo linafurahisha,” Melissa alisema, akimfuata Angie hadi jikoni. Kila mara Melissa alipomtembelea rafiki yake nyumbani, kulikuwa na jambo la kufurahisha la kufanya.

Baada ya kupata ruhusa, wasichana hao wawili walitoka nje kwenye siku yenye joto, unyevunyevu na jua kali. Ilibidi wavuke malisho ili kufika kwenye kijito, kwa hiyo Angie alisukuma nyaya za uzio zitengane na kupenya katikati. Kisha akazishikilia nyaya zitengane ili Melissa pia aweze kupita kwenye uzio na kuingia kwenye malisho ya mbuzi.

Wasichana hao walivuka malisho, wakapita kwenye uzio mwingine, na kuingia msituni. Walitembea kwenye njia ya udongo hadi kwenye kijito. Walinyanyua marinda yao na kuingia kwenye maji yaliyokuwa yakibubujika. Marafiki hao wawili walizungumza na kucheka walipokuwa wakitembea kuelekea sehemu ya chini ya kijito hadi mahali maalumu walipopenda kwenda daima.

Mahali hapo, kitanda cha kijito kilikuwa kimejaa mawe yasiyo ya kawaida. Mawe hayo yalipokuwa makavu, yalikuwa ya kijivu, lakini yalipolowa, yaligeuka na kuwa ya samawati maridadi sana.

Baada ya kutumia muda fulani kuyastaajabia mawe hayo ya samawati, Melissa alimgeukia Angie na kusema, “Twende tukatembee kwenye lile bomba kubwa la kupitisha maji chini ya barabara.”

“Ndiyo, tufanye hivyo, halafu tunaweza kutembea kando ya barabara kurudi kwenye njia ya kuingia nyumbani.”

Walitoka kwenye maji baridi na kutembea msituni hadi kwenye bomba hilo la kupitisha maji lililofanana na handaki. Wasichana hao walipita kwenye handaki lenye giza hadi upande wa pili, na Melissa akapanda kwa haraka ukingo mkali hadi kwenye barabara ya changarawe.

Ghafla, alipotambua kuwa alikuwa peke yake, Melissa aligeuka na kuona kwamba Angie alikuwa bado kwenye mlango wa handaki, akiangalia dimbwi la maji. Angie alisogeza jiwe, kisha akapiga kelele na kupanda ukingo kwa haraka ili aungane na Melissa. “Kulikuwa na kaa-mdogo wa maji baridi chini yake!” akasema kwa mshangao.

Pindo za marinda ya wasichana hao zilikuwa zimelowa kwa sababu ya kijito, lakini zilikauka upesi kwenye jua kali walipokuwa wakitembea kurudi nyumbani. Walipokuwa katikati ya njia, Angie alisema, “Ungependa kutoa mashua kwenye bwawa? Tuna makasia ambayo ni ya kufurahisha kutumia.”

Melissa alitabasamu kwa furaha, “Hilo litafurahisha sana!” Alimfuata Angie hadi ghalani ili kumsaidia kuchukua makasia na jaketi za kuokoa maisha.

Wasichana hao walivaa jaketi zao za rangi ya chungwa za kuokoa maisha na kusukuma mashua majini kwenye bwawa. Punde walikuwa wamepiga makasia hadi katikati ya bwawa na kuketi hapo, wakitazama maji yakitengeneza mawimbi madogo polepole kuzunguka mashua yao.

“Lo, najua tunachopaswa kufanya sasa!” Angie alisema. “Tuyapige maji kwa makasia yetu ili yatapakaze. Kama hivi.” Angie alikipiga kwa nguvu kijuujuu cha maji ya bwawa kwa kasia lake. Melissa akamwiga na kuanza kutapakaza maji upande wake wa mashua.

Mikupuo ya maji ilizidi kuwa mikubwa. Walifurahia sana kuona ni nani angeweza kutengeneza mkupuo mkubwa zaidi. Melissa aliinua kasia lake juu na kupiga maji kwa nguvu zaidi. Kama ilivyotarajiwa, maji yaliruka hewani, lakini Melissa alipoinua kasia lake, alibaki na mpini tu. Sehemu ya kasia iliyokuwa kama pala ilikuwa imevunjika na kuelea chini kidogo ya uso wa maji kando ya mashua. Aliingiza mkono majini, akaichukua sehemu ya kasia iliyovunjika, na kuweka vipande vyote viwili vya kasia ndani ya mashua.

Kwa muda mfupi, Angie na Melissa walitazamana kimya kimya. Melissa alijihisi mwenye hatia kwa kuvunja kasia, na Angie alijisikia vibaya kwa kupendekeza watapakaze maji.

“Turudi ufukweni na kuweka makasia ghalani,” Angie alisema. “Haidhuru kwamba limevunjika. Hata hivyo, hayo ni makasia ya zamani tu,” alimalizia, bila kuwa na uhakika kabisa.

Melissa alifikiri hilo lilikuwa wazo zuri na akamsaidia Angie kuiburuta mashua kutoka majini. Walichukua jaketi za kuokoa maisha na makasia, kisha wakavipeleka ghalani.

Melissa alijisikia vibaya, lakini hakutaka kumwambia mtu yeyote kwamba alikuwa amevunja kasia. Walipita karibu na lundo la marobota ya nyasi yenye harufu nzuri na zizi la mbuzi lenye kelele, lakini Melissa hakuyatilia maanani sana. Alikuwa akifikiria tu kwamba alikuwa amevunja kasia na kwamba angeficha alichokuwa amefanya. Dhamiri yake ilimsumbua kwa sababu alijua kwamba wazazi wake na Mungu walitaka awe mkweli kila wakati na asifiche jambo lolote.

Wasichana hao walipotoka tu ghalani na kuingia kwenye nyasi za uani, kaka mkubwa wa Angie aliruka kutoka nyuma ya ghala, alipokuwa amejificha. “Niliwaona na najua mlichofanya!” akawaambia. “Mmevunja kasia. Na mnajua nini!? Niliwafuata muda wote mlipokuwa kwenye kijito na hata chini kando ya barabara. Nit amwambia Mama kwamba mmevunja kasia.” Alitabasamu kwa ushindi, kisha akakimbia kuelekea kwenye mlango wa orofa ya chini ya nyumba na kutoweka ndani.

Angie na Melissa walikasirika kidogo kwa sababu alikuwa akiwafuatilia kisiri na kuwatazama (haikuwa mara ya kwanza kufanya hivyo). Lakini kwa namna ya ajabu, Melissa alijisikia nafuu sana. Hakuhitaji tena kuwa na wasiwasi kwamba mtu angegundua kuwa alikuwa amevunja kasia, kwa sababu tayari kuna mtu alijua. Wazazi wa Angie walipoambiwa kuhusu kasia iliyovunjika, walimsamehe Melissa kwa kuivunja. Melissa alifurahi sana sikuzote kwamba jambo hilo halikufichwa baada ya yote.

“Could you come with me to visit my sister and her husband?” a friend asked my husband. “They’re having serious marriage problems. My brother-in-law saw how God is working in our marriage and asked me how it happened. Can you tell them how God could change their marriage, too?”

At dusk that evening, my husband, and I, waited with our friend outside his sister’s home. Half an hour later a dilapidated red pickup chugged up and shuddered to a stop. An overweight man with grease-covered clothes and a perpetual smile heaved himself out from behind the steering wheel, while his pretty, fashionably dressed wife hopped out of the passenger seat.

“Come in! Come in!” they invited, guiding us to the stairway which led to their living quarters.

“Excuse the mess,” the wife apologized, swiping clothes from the couches so we could take seats. The room was elaborately furnished but dirty. A deep layer of dust covered the top of the large-screen television set, the end tables… everything.

“Lord, give us wisdom,” I silently implored as we took seats across from the couple. How could we connect with folks we scarcely knew, and who did not have God in their lives?

The husband talked. His wife had failed him miserably and had cheated on him many times. She was presently meeting with a new boyfriend, a young chap she had learned to know on the street. “But I’ll forgive you all that,” promised the husband, “If you are willing to start over, be my wife, and be a mom to our children. I know you’ve failed, but we all fail. Let’s start over, Dear.”

The wife sat in stony silence. Our friend talked, pleading with his sister and brother-in-law to be reconciled. My husband talked about God and His plan for marriage, urging them to turn to Him.

Finally, the wife opened her mouth. Bitterness poured out; dishonor; old dirt. “You never show me that you care. You never buy me anything. Why should I try to please you anymore?”

The husband joined the fray. Both talked at once, on and on, louder and louder.

We sat with sagging hearts, listening, praying, thinking. I tried to imagine how the wife must have felt. She was pretty and young. Why stay at home to clean, cook, and wash clothes for a hulk of a husband who spent his days leaning over greasy motors and crawling under dirty cars? Why, when she could have fun on the street with a cool, young fellow who made her feel so-o-o special?

Finally, the couple ran out of steam. We sat in sad silence. “I’m sorry,” my husband stated finally, “but we can’t help you. The only one who can help you is God. And if you don’t want His help, there’s no hope for your marriage.”

“Yeah, I really should go to church,” mumbled the husband.

“Ha, ha,” sneered the wife. “Just see you become a Mennonite yet!” We rose and shook hands, promised our prayers, and left.

After we left that evening, more harsh words flew between the couple. Their two children came upon the scene and, siding with their father, drove their mother from the house.

From far in the distance came a sound of music—and what else? Singing. Joyful shouting. A wife threw open the shutter from a window facing the street, leaned out, and peered up the road. Oh, yes, today is the day my husband went to bring the Ark of the Covenant home. But why are they making such a ruckus over it?

Into the city danced the parade, singing, shouting, and blowing trumpets. David danced with all his might, his heart overflowing with thanks to God. After agonizing years of fleeing from Saul, God had established him as king. And now the Ark of the Lord was finally returning to its proper dwelling place… God be praised!

As David leaped and shouted his way up the street, his wife looked down from her perch at the window with a dark scowl on her face. Just look at how his robe flies around as he dances. Doesn’t he have any shame?! And hollering like that… what a way for a king to act! Doesn’t he care what others think?!

David returned home several hours later—tired, but happy—to bless his household. It had been a good day. He could tell his wife, Michal, all about it at the supper table.

But she beat him to the subject. [“My, but didn’t you act gloriously today,”] were her frosty words. David must have looked confused. [“I mean, jumping around like that in front of the maidens, just like a vain fellow from off the streets!”]

David must have been smitten. [“I was doing it to the Lord, to the one who chose me to be king instead of your father.”]

I imagine Michal wincing. Ouch! [“Why do you have to throw that in my face?”]

[“I know I am low in your esteem,”]* continued David, [“but those maidens you mentioned, they esteem me.”]

I think of the wayward lady in town who was chased from home by her children, and I wonder who will care for her forty years from now when her pretty face is wrinkled, and her back is bent.

I picture Michal’s lonely old age. The account ends by saying she had no children until her dying day. I doubt if her king-husband bothered to stop in with her anymore. Why would he? He received honor aplenty from others. I also wonder if Michal’s dishonor and their fall-out weakened King David. Several chapters later tell of his eyes roving to a neighbor’s wife and the resulting sin.

All wives are tempted to dishonor their husbands. We are tempted to dishonor regardless of whether our husband is a king or a mechanic, godly or ungodly.

Every day I choose to honor or dishonor the husband God gave me. I can skip alongside him, supporting with enthusiasm, or I can hang out the window, watching with scorn in my heart. I can focus on what he does well and compliment him, or I can nag about what he does wrong. My choice determines the reciprocating favor or loss. My choice affects, not only my husband and me, but also a cloud of witnesses… my children, my sisters in Christ, and my neighbors.

“And the wife see that she reverence her husband.”
(Ephesians 5:33b)

* This is how the Spanish Bible says it; the thought is clearer than in the English translation.

„Könntest du mich begleiten, wenn ich meine Schwester und ihren Mann besuche?“, fragte ein Freund meinen Mann. „Sie haben ernsthafte Eheprobleme. Mein Schwager hat gesehen, wie Gott in unserer Ehe wirkt, und mich gefragt, wie es dazu gekommen ist. Kannst du ihnen erzählen, wie Gott auch ihre Ehe verändern könnte?“

An diesem Abend warteten mein Mann und ich in der Dämmerung mit unserem Freund vor dem Haus seiner Schwester. Eine halbe Stunde später knatterte ein heruntergekommener roter Pickup heran und kam ruckelnd zum Stehen. Ein übergewichtiger Mann in ölverschmierter Kleidung zwängte sich hinter dem Lenkrad hervor. Ein beständiges Lächeln lag auf seinem Gesicht. Seine hübsche, modisch gekleidete Frau sprang auf der Beifahrerseite heraus.

„Kommt herein! Kommt herein!“, luden sie uns ein und führten uns die Treppe hinauf zu ihren Wohnräumen.

„Entschuldigt das Durcheinander“, sagte die Frau entschuldigend und räumte Kleidung von den Sofas, damit wir uns setzen konnten. Der Raum war aufwendig eingerichtet, aber schmutzig. Eine dicke Staubschicht bedeckte den großen Fernseher, die Beistelltische … einfach alles.

„Herr, gib uns Weisheit“, flehte ich still, als wir dem Paar gegenübersaßen. Wie konnten wir eine Verbindung zu Menschen herstellen, die wir kaum kannten und die Gott nicht in ihrem Leben hatten?

Der Mann erzählte. Seine Frau habe ihn schrecklich enttäuscht und ihn viele Male betrogen. Im Moment treffe sie sich mit einem neuen Freund, einem jungen Burschen, den sie auf der Straße kennengelernt hatte. „Aber ich verzeihe dir das alles“, versprach der Mann. „Wenn du bereit bist, noch einmal von vorn anzufangen, meine Frau zu sein und für unsere Kinder eine Mutter zu sein. Ich weiß, dass du versagt hast, aber wir alle versagen. Lass uns noch einmal von vorn anfangen, Liebes.“

Die Frau saß reglos und schwieg. Unser Freund redete und flehte seine Schwester und seinen Schwager an, sich zu versöhnen. Mein Mann sprach über Gott und seinen Plan für die Ehe und ermutigte sie, sich an ihn zu wenden.

Schließlich öffnete die Frau den Mund. Verbitterung strömte hervor; Vorwürfe; alter Groll. „Du zeigst mir nie, dass dir etwas an mir liegt. Du kaufst mir nie etwas. Warum sollte ich mir noch Mühe geben, dir zu gefallen?“

Der Mann stieg in den Streit ein. Beide redeten gleichzeitig, immer weiter und immer lauter.

Wir saßen mit schwerem Herzen da, hörten zu, beteten und dachten nach. Ich versuchte mir vorzustellen, wie sich die Frau fühlen musste. Sie war hübsch und jung. Warum sollte sie zu Hause bleiben, um für einen Hünen von einem Mann zu putzen, zu kochen und Wäsche zu waschen, der seine Tage damit verbrachte, sich über ölige Motoren zu beugen und unter schmutzige Autos zu kriechen? Warum, wenn sie doch draußen auf der Straße mit einem coolen jungen Kerl Spaß haben konnte, der ihr das Gefühl gab, so-o-o besonders zu sein?

Schließlich ging dem Paar die Luft aus. Wir saßen in traurigem Schweigen. „Es tut mir leid“, sagte mein Mann schließlich, „aber wir können euch nicht helfen. Der Einzige, der euch helfen kann, ist Gott. Und wenn ihr seine Hilfe nicht wollt, gibt es für eure Ehe keine Hoffnung.“

„Ja, ich sollte wirklich in die Kirche gehen“, murmelte der Mann.

„Ha, ha“, höhnte die Frau. „Wart nur, du wirst noch Mennonit!“ Wir standen auf, schüttelten ihnen die Hände, versprachen, für sie zu beten, und gingen.

Nachdem wir an jenem Abend gegangen waren, flogen zwischen dem Paar weitere harte Worte hin und her. Ihre beiden Kinder kamen dazu und ergriffen Partei für ihren Vater; sie trieben ihre Mutter aus dem Haus.

Aus weiter Ferne war Musik zu hören – und was noch? Gesang. Freudige Jubelrufe. Eine Frau riss den Fensterladen eines zur Straße gerichteten Fensters auf, beugte sich hinaus und spähte die Straße entlang. Ach ja, heute ist der Tag, an dem mein Mann die Bundeslade nach Hause holen ging. Aber warum machen sie so einen Aufstand darum?

Der Festzug tanzte singend, jubelnd und Trompeten blasend in die Stadt. David tanzte mit aller Kraft; sein Herz war übervoll vor Dankbarkeit gegenüber Gott. Nach qualvollen Jahren auf der Flucht vor Saul hatte Gott ihn als König eingesetzt. Und nun kehrte die Lade des Herrn endlich an ihren rechten Platz zurück … Gott sei gepriesen!

Als David hüpfend und jubelnd die Straße hinaufzog, blickte seine Frau von ihrem Platz am Fenster mit finsterer Miene auf ihn hinunter. Sieh nur, wie sein Gewand beim Tanzen herumflattert. Schämt er sich denn gar nicht?! Und dieses Gebrüll … was für ein Benehmen für einen König! Ist ihm egal, was andere denken?!

Einige Stunden später kam David nach Hause zurück – müde, aber glücklich –, um seinen Haushalt zu segnen. Es war ein guter Tag gewesen. Beim Abendessen konnte er seiner Frau Michal alles davon erzählen.

Doch sie kam ihm zuvor. [„Na, heute hast du dich ja wirklich großartig aufgeführt“,] waren ihre frostigen Worte. David sah wohl verwirrt aus. [„Ich meine, wie du vor den jungen Frauen herumgesprungen bist, wie irgendein eitler Kerl von der Straße!“]

David muss getroffen gewesen sein. [„Ich tat es für den Herrn, für den, der mich anstelle deines Vaters zum König erwählt hat.“]

Ich stelle mir vor, wie Michal zusammenzuckte. Autsch! [„Warum musst du mir das unter die Nase reiben?“]

[„Ich weiß, dass ich in deinen Augen wenig gelte“,]* fuhr David fort, [„aber die jungen Frauen, von denen du gesprochen hast, halten viel von mir.“]

Ich denke an die Frau aus der Stadt, die von ihren eigenen Kindern aus dem Haus gejagt wurde, und frage mich, wer sich in vierzig Jahren um sie kümmern wird, wenn ihr hübsches Gesicht voller Falten ist und ihr Rücken sich beugt.

Ich stelle mir Michals einsames Alter vor. Der Bericht endet mit der Aussage, dass sie bis zu ihrem Tod keine Kinder hatte. Ich bezweifle, dass ihr Königsgemahl noch einmal bei ihr vorbeischaute. Warum sollte er auch? Von anderen erhielt er mehr als genug Ehre. Ich frage mich auch, ob Michals Missachtung und ihr Zerwürfnis König David schwächten. Einige Kapitel später wird erzählt, wie seine Augen auf der Frau eines Nachbarn ruhten und welche Sünde daraus folgte.

Alle Ehefrauen sind versucht, ihre Männer zu missachten. Wir sind versucht, sie zu missachten, ganz gleich, ob unser Mann ein König oder ein Mechaniker ist, gottesfürchtig oder gottlos.

Jeden Tag entscheide ich mich, den Mann, den Gott mir gegeben hat, zu ehren oder zu missachten. Ich kann fröhlich neben ihm herhüpfen und ihn begeistert unterstützen, oder ich kann mich aus dem Fenster lehnen und mit Verachtung im Herzen zusehen. Ich kann mich darauf konzentrieren, was er gut macht, und ihn dafür loben, oder ich kann an dem herumnörgeln, was er falsch macht. Meine Entscheidung beeinflusst, ob Zuneigung erwidert wird oder verloren geht. Meine Entscheidung betrifft nicht nur meinen Mann und mich, sondern auch eine Wolke von Zeugen … meine Kinder, meine Schwestern in Christus und meine Nachbarn.

„Und die Frau soll ihren Mann achten.“
(Epheser 5:33b)

* So steht es in der spanischen Bibel; der Gedanke ist klarer als in der englischen Übersetzung.

There He was, the King Himself, standing before Pilate, awaiting His death sentence. A large crowd had gathered outside. There was no mistaking it, these people were angry. They wanted this man, Jesus of Nazareth, dead. “Crucify him! Crucify him!” was all that could be heard. This man must have done something terrible. But who were these people that were so angry at the Son of God? Maybe they were rapists, thieves, and murderers. Possibly they were the local liars, drunks, or some other evildoers. Actually, they were the religious people, the church goers, the ones claiming to be God’s people.

Ever since that infamous day, history has repeated itself. People claiming to be God’s people have seen those who love Jesus and try to follow His teachings as their enemies and have persecuted them any way they could. From the Jews, to the Roman Catholics, to the Protestants, the mainstream church of the day has always been the enemy of those who try to govern their everyday lives by the simple clarity of the Scriptures.

I am concerned that we have signed a deal with the mainstream church of our day—a deal for peace at all costs.

Any Scripture that teaches rebuke, reproof, or correction is considered out-of-date and is not allowed to be used to help shape the faith and practice of today’s Christian. Many individuals, church leaders, and even whole churches have begun to believe that love and acceptance alone is a better way to point others to Christ. Those who would raise a voice of warning are seen to be critical and stirring unrest, so they are quickly silenced.

As we search the Scriptures, we see that Jesus, then the disciples, then the early church, had nothing good to say or think about the false church.

While out witnessing or talking to people about the Lord, I’m amazed at the backlash from the mainstream church of our day. Mainly, the Protestant church.

A simple man walked up to a Christian concert holding a sign reading ‘Jesus saves from sin’. Without him ever saying a word, he was attacked. “Quit judging us!” “You don’t know our hearts!” “You’re a disgrace!” “Bigot!” The man slowly walked away.

Many times, the people who get angry when discussions involving God come up are actually folks who claim to know Jesus. The sinners seem to let the message penetrate their hearts. If you were to go to an intersection in a city and simply hold a sign proclaiming something about Christ, you would soon see that this is true.

As I was standing in line at a fast-food restaurant, I noticed that the young man preparing my sandwich had many interesting tattoos. Some were of tombstones, skulls, and other graphic designs. I calmly asked him if he could explain what the tattoos meant to him. He began going into detail about each one. I then asked the young man if he knew Jesus. He got sober and explained that he wanted to believe in God but couldn’t. I quoted a few Bible verses and told him that God was waiting for him. I noticed that God’s Word was having a great effect on the young man.

Meanwhile, I also noticed that the lady behind me was beginning to get frustrated. Finally, she interrupted our conversation and told the man, “Jesus loves you just the way you are. You don’t have to change for this man.” This lady later told me what church she went to and how judgmental she thought that I had acted. I was amazed. I had only told the young man about the Savior!

Before I left the restaurant, I walked back over to the young man to bid him farewell. As I approached, he looked up with tears in his eyes. “Thank you”, he said “I can tell that you truly care about me. I will go home and really think about what you said.”

That night, as I reflected on the day’s events, I wondered why that professing Christian woman had such a problem with my interaction with the young man. Why did she get so angry? I felt like the Lord gave me an answer: No man can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. Ye cannot serve God and mammon –Matthew 6:24.

She was a nice young lady. And, yes, she professed that she was a Christian, but she clearly did not live a life that was in obedience to God’s Word. Rather, outside of going to church, one would not be able to tell at all that she was a follower of Christ. I’m sure if I would have met her at the park, we could have had a nice chat. I’m sure she would have been courteous and polite. I’m sure she would have presented herself as a good citizen and nice person. But when it came to being excited about Jesus, sharing the gospel, and talking about God’s Word, her true colors came out.

Am I saying that a person must be an Anabaptist to make it to heaven? Absolutely not, but I am saying we must obey the Bible and follow Christ to make it to heaven. Most professing Christians are super nice and seem godly, until you start talking about God.

Since when has the definition of a Christian been ‘a nice person’, or ‘a good citizen’? Is that all there is to it anymore—simply do what you want, find a fun church that doesn’t require anything from you, get a good job, get married, have a few children and just like that you’re a ‘Christian’? God help us!

When He was having a discussion with a group of people about whether or not they were true followers of God, Jesus said, …If ye were Abraham’s children, ye would do the works of Abraham. But now ye seek to kill me, a man that hath told you the truth … Ye do the deeds of your father … Ye are of your father the devil… –John 8:39-44.

Has the true church slipped so far as to not be able to call things as they are? God’s Word gives us clear understanding on the matter: Proving what is acceptable unto the Lord. And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather reprove them. For it is a shame even to speak of those things which are done of them in secret. But all things that are reproved are made manifest by the light: for whatsoever doth make manifest is light –Ephesians 5:10-13.

Jesus says Ye are the light of the world. A city that is set on an hill cannot be hid –Matthew 5:14. Do we expose sin and heresy in the same way that light exposes darkness? Or are we too attached to a comfortable life with no enemies? We do not need to be scared of the world, or of the false church, because we know that we have what they need! For years the mainstream churches have been getting farther and farther away from the truth of God’s Word. Are we afraid to recognize this? Are we afraid to separate ourselves from this? Will we stand up against it like the early church did?

There is a reason why the Protestant reformer, Martin Luther, died hating the Anabaptist people—because they rejected his interpretation of the Scriptures. The Anabaptist people were not respecters of people. Rather their only respect was for God and His Word, and that without compromise. It was for this that they were persecuted. It would have been much easier for those godly young men to just be quiet and try to get along with the Catholics and Protestants, but they refused and both groups sought to extinguish them. Still, they lived on, trusting only in their God. When we joined the church of Jesus Christ didn’t we promise to continue fighting the same fight—the same fight that Jesus fought; the same fight the early church fought—the fight against the false church? Or have we agreed to get along, for the sake of peace? After all isn’t it better for business, for friendships, and for reputation?! God forbid!

We can live a life that seems to be without sin, but still be living in disobedience. The Bible calls us to action! We are called to be lights, to be witnesses, to pursue godliness, and to live uprightly, not just to put on a good show. I believe this is what has become popular in our day. Lying, cheating, stealing, and killing are attributes that even the world rejects. It’s the ‘in thing’ to be respectable, to make a nice living, and to be upstanding citizens. But is this the life of a born-again believer? Should we fit in with the American dream? Should the only thing that’s different between us and the Protestant church be a head covering? I think we should prayerfully consider this move, the move to join hands with the mainstream church.

I personally know many Protestant Christians. I’m not trying to say they are bad people; many are good folks. But that is not what we are talking about. I believe we need to draw a line and slow down this draw to join them in any compromising manner. Let’s look at just a few of the differences between the Protestants and Anabaptists.

War

Can you believe in war, killing your enemies, and still be a New Testament Christian? Most Protestants are supporters of fighting for our freedoms and our rights. Many will go as far as calling Anabaptist people cowards for not fighting.

Years ago, a group of professing Christians gathered around the biggest bomb ever made. This bomb was about to be sent into a foreign land to destroy an entire city; this bomb was meant to kill everything in its path. Men, women, and children alike would perish because of this bomb; that was the plan. As this group was gathered around this bomb they began to pray, they asked God’s blessing on this bombing mission. They then thanked Him for its success—killing nearly one quarter of a million souls.

Jesus calls us to love our enemies. This topic clearly separated the churches during the various wars. Most of the ‘Christian’ churches in the world supported the war effort of their country. The Anabaptists would not, and they were sorely persecuted for it. So, can we be a Christian and continue to support war? If we support war, where will it stop? Will we also prepare to defend ourselves and our families against violence and lawlessness? The American church calls ‘defending ourselves’, our families, and our country, heroism or bravery; the Bible calls it.

Entertainment

It seems that most Christians in America have no problem watching as many ballgames and sports events as they desire. Movies and television are found in nearly every home. Going to the beach, casinos, and festivals are commonplace. Spending thousands on big hunting trips and expensive vacations is completed without a second thought. To be honest, there really are no limits to what the Christian in America can do, as long as it seems right to them. Jesus tells us multiple times to deny ourselves. It seems that we look for any loophole possible to indulge in all the self-gratifying activities we want! It’s no wonder the church is struggling with pornography and many other sins of the flesh. When we learn how to deny ourselves, pick up the cross, and follow Jesus, then we will start to see a clear, distinct, and large separation between us and the mainstream church of our day.

Non-conformity

It is common to conform to one’s surroundings. This is one reason we don’t send our children to public schools. Jesus is also very clear that we need to come out from among them and be separate, to say “No” to evil communication and the ways of this world, and to not be afraid of identifying ourselves with the people of God. It almost seems that dress is really the only thing that separates many of us, and that is changing also.

Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If any man love the world, the love of the Father is not in him. For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father, but is of the world –1 John 2:15-16. Where are the people that hate the world? Where are the people that want to be as separated as possible? Where are the people that are not afraid to be laughed at? Where are the people that are not afraid to be different? Oh, where are God’s people?! If history repeats itself, there will soon be no difference between the church and the world. Oh, where are the men?!

I’ve heard many Anabaptist people say they can’t say that those in the worldly church are not Christians; they just don’t want to go in that direction. Is that truthful? Is that the message we want to send to our youth, and to our children? I don’t believe so. The Bible says that few will make it. If we pass on to our children that the Protestant church is also ok, and that they just do things differently, we are destroying everything that Jesus preached. We are saying that we do what we do, not because the Bible says, but rather we decide what we do based on our circumstances and what others around us think! No wonder our children are more interested in the modern church of today than ever before—there’s no line drawn!

There was a modern church that caught my attention. They seemed to be on fire for the Lord! The pastor preached as a dying man. They were very interested in reaching the lost. But there were so many Bible teachings that they simply ignored! I finally took it to the Lord. “What is going on here God!” It was as if God told me to ‘just wait’.

Soon after that, the pastor was released from his position because he was having an affair. Then it all became clear to me—you can have a nice church, you can preach a good message, and you can help the poor, but if you’re not willing to obey ALL of the New Testament teachings, you’re not a true Christian, and you will not find victory. It’s easy to take Christianity so far, but it is not easy to sell all that you have, put your all on the altar, and follow your Master. I know this is bold, but it is the truth of God’s Word.

I was speaking to a young lady in a Protestant setting, who wanted to give her life to the Lord. She was ready to do what it took, or so she said. I asked her if she was ready to suffer for Jesus, if she was ready to separate herself from her old friends, if she was ready to be hated by the world, and ready to be different. I asked her if she was willing to change how she looked. It didn’t take long before she shockingly responded with an emphatic “No!” “I want to start going to church, but not all that other stuff.” I later noticed her with her friends pointing and laughing at me. Being cool does not define a true Christian but being rejected for the sake of the Gospel does.

This is a tough article to write. It’s not a popular message and not very encouraging. But I think it’s a message we must consider today, not only for our sake, but for our children’s sake, and that of the church of tomorrow. We must draw clear lines of separation, without any compromise. We must honestly evaluate the modern church of our day with the clear teachings of the New Testament. We must call sin, sin. We must call disobedience, sin. We must call compromise, sin. We must once again choose to suffer with the true people of God. This does not mean that we shun people or act distasteful towards them, but with love in our hearts, and a message on our lips, we point the masses to Christ!

For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ: for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth; to the Jew first, and also to the Greek –Romans 1:16.
